			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 15, Interactable = false,
		})
		local progFill = mk("Frame", progBg, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, ZIndex = 16, Interactable = false})
		-- [v30] glowing head riding the tip of the progress bar
		local progDot = mk("Frame", progFill, {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7),
			BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 17, Interactable = false,
		})
		Util.Instance("UICorner", progDot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		local skipBtn = mk("TextButton", stage, {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 30),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code,
			TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>  OPEN UI", ZIndex = 30, AutoButtonColor = false,
		})
		local skipStroke = mk("UIStroke", skipBtn, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.2})
		conns[#conns + 1] = skipBtn.Activated:Connect(doSkip)
		-- [v30] bubbly skip button: overshoot hover, squish press, elastic release
		local skipScale = Util.Instance("UIScale", skipBtn)
		skipBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			tween(skipScale, 0.2, Back, EOut, {Scale = 1.12})
			tween(skipStroke, 0.2, Quad, EOut, {Thickness = 2})
		end)
		skipBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			tween(skipScale, 0.3, Back, EOut, {Scale = 1})
			tween(skipStroke, 0.25, Quad, EOut, {Thickness = 1})
		end)
		skipBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if isPress(input) then
				tween(skipScale, 0.07, Quad, EOut, {Scale = 0.88})
			end
		end)
		skipBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if isPress(input) then
				tween(skipScale, 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, EOut, {Scale = 1})
			end
		end)
		local flash = mk("Frame", stage, {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 40, Interactable = false,
		})

		-- ── beat engine ──
		local pulse, beatN, lastBeat, avgL, lastLoudAt = 0, 0, -1, 40, 0
		local shake, glitch, lastRing = 0, 0, -1
		local invert, edgeFlash = 0, 0
		local function beatNow(t, strength)
			beatN = beatN + 1
			lastBeat = t
			pulse = 1
			shake = math.max(shake, 4 + 6 * (strength or 1))
			glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.5)
			edgeFlash = math.max(edgeFlash, 0.4 + 0.45 * (strength or 1))
			if beatN % 4 == 0 then invert = 1 end
			tri.pulse = math.max(tri.pulse or 0, 0.55)
			if t - lastRing > 0.34 and t > 3 then
				lastRing = t
				FX.Ring(world, accent(), 260 + 90 * math.random(), 0.7, 2)
			end
		end
		local function pollBeat(dt, t)
			local l = loudness()
			if l > 1 then lastLoudAt = t end
			avgL = avgL + (l - avgL) * math.min(1, dt * 2.5)
			if t - lastLoudAt < 1.5 and l > 1 then
				if l > math.max(avgL * 1.28, 45) and t - lastBeat > 0.2 then
					beatNow(t, math.min(1.5, l / math.max(avgL, 1) - 0.6))
				end
			elseif t > 1.5 and t - lastBeat > 0.469 then
				beatNow(t, 0.8) -- metronome fallback (128 BPM)
			end
		end

		-- ── scene helpers ──
		local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
		local sy = sw.Y
		local function setBig(s)
			lblM.Text, lblR.Text, lblB.Text = s, s, s
		end
		local function placeBig(cyScale, hPx, wScale)
			box.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * cyScale)
			box.Size = UDim2.new(wScale or 0.92, 0, 0, hPx)
		end
		local function bigAlpha(a, extra)
			lblM.TextTransparency = a
			lblR.TextTransparency = math.min(1, 0.35 + a * 0.65 + (extra or 0))
			lblB.TextTransparency = math.min(1, 0.35 + a * 0.65 + (extra or 0))
		end
		local function chroma(off)
			lblR.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -off, 0.5, 0)
			lblB.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, off, 0.5, 0)
		end
		local function layoutTri(k)
			pcall(function()
				local L = tri.Layer
				local sm = sy * 0.4
				L.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(lerp(sw.X, sm, k), lerp(sw.Y, sm, k))
				L.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, lerp(0.5, 0.27, k), 0)
			end)
		end
		local function hideCardStuff()
			plate.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			roleL.TextTransparency = 1
			detL.TextTransparency = 1
			ul.Visible = false
		end
		local function hideRows()
			for _, r in ipairs(E.rows) do
				r.role.TextTransparency = 1
				r.name.TextTransparency = 1
			end
			hdr.TextTransparency = 1
		end
		local function showCard(card, lt, len, col)
			local e = easeOutCubic(clamp01(lt / 0.3))
			local ex = clamp01((lt - (len - 0.2)) / 0.2)
			local a = math.max(1 - e, ex)
			local bigH = math.clamp(sy * 0.15, 34, 92)
			local cy = sy * 0.66
			placeBig(0.66, bigH, 0.94)
			box.Visible = true
			local s = scr(card.name, lt / 0.35)
			setBig(s)
			bigAlpha(a)
			chroma((1 - e) * 16 + pulse * 5 + (math.random() < 0.05 and 7 or 0))
			boxScale.Scale = 1 + (1 - e) * 0.7 + pulse * 0.04 + ex * 0.35
			plate.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, cy)
			plate.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, bigH * 1.55)
			plate.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(0.45, a)
			roleL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, cy - bigH * 0.5 - 16)
			roleL.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.045, 12, 20))
			roleL.Text = spaced(scr(card.role, lt / 0.3))
			roleL.TextColor3 = col
			roleL.TextTransparency = math.max(1 - clamp01(lt / 0.2), ex)
			detL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, cy + bigH * 0.5 + 18)
			detL.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.04, 11, 17))
			detL.Text = scr(card.detail, (lt - 0.25) / 0.5)
			detL.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 215, 225)
			detL.TextTransparency = math.max(1 - clamp01((lt - 0.2) / 0.25), ex)
			ul.Visible = true
			ul.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, cy + bigH * 0.8)
			ul.Size = UDim2.new(0.5 * easeOutCubic(clamp01((lt - 0.3) / 0.5)) * (1 - ex), 0, 0, 2)
			ul.BackgroundColor3 = col
		end
		local function showPage(page, lt, len, col)
			local ex = clamp01((lt - (len - 0.25)) / 0.25)
			local rowH = math.clamp(sy * 0.075, 17, 34)
			local step = rowH * 1.3
			local y0 = sy * 0.52 + 22
			hdr.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.52)
			hdr.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.04, 11, 16))
			hdr.Text = spaced("THE CREW")
			hdr.TextColor3 = col
			hdr.TextTransparency = math.max(1 - clamp01(lt / 0.25), ex)
			for i, r in ipairs(E.rows) do
				local data = page[i]
				if data then
					local st = 0.12 + (i - 1) * 0.33
					local k = clamp01((lt - st) / 0.3)
					local e = easeOutCubic(k)
					local a = math.max(1 - e, ex)
					local y = y0 + (i - 1) * step
					local slide = (1 - e) * sw.X * 0.25
					r.role.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -10 - slide, 0, y)
					r.name.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 10 + slide, 0, y)
					r.role.Size = UDim2.new(0.46, 0, 0, rowH * 0.8)
					r.name.Size = UDim2.new(0.46, 0, 0, rowH)
					r.role.Text = scr(data[1], k)
					r.name.Text = scr(data[2], k)
					r.name.TextColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and WHITE or col
					r.role.TextTransparency = math.min(1, a + 0.1 * (1 - e))
					r.name.TextTransparency = a
				else
					r.role.TextTransparency = 1
					r.name.TextTransparency = 1
				end
			end
		end

		-- ── timeline ──
		local T1, T2, T3, T4, T5 = 3.2, 8.8, 20.7, 30.0, 36.0
		local CARD_LEN, PAGE_LEN = 1.7, 3.1
		local tEnd, flashLen = DUR, 0.5
		local termLines = {
			"UH//BIOS " .. tostring(UhhhhhhVersion) .. "  by " .. CREATOR,
			"CHECKING MEMORY ........ OK",
			"MOUNTING UhhhhhhReanim/ ........ OK",
			"LOADING CREATOR.EXE",
			"> " .. CREATOR,
			"> ORIGINAL CREATOR DETECTED",
			"> INITIATING CINEMATIC",
		}
		local lastWord, wordT, chaosWord = 0, 0, DATA.chaos[1]
		local bloomed, slammed, readyFired = false, false, false
		local bootLines, lastCard = 0, 0
		local lastScene = 0

		local function run()
			do -- wait (max 3.2s) for the song to actually start, so the cinematic begins on the first note
				local w0 = os.clock()
				while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < 3.2 and not skipped do
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end
				began = os.clock()
			end
			while true do
				local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				local t = os.clock() - began
				if skipped and tEnd == DUR then
					tEnd = t + 0.35
					flashLen = 0.35
				end
				if t >= tEnd or t > DUR + 8 then break end
				sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
				sy = sw.Y
				local col = accent()
				local maxR = math.sqrt(sw.X * sw.X + sw.Y * sw.Y) * 0.5
				pollBeat(dt, t)
				pulse = math.max(0, pulse - dt * 7)
				invert = math.max(0, invert - dt * 9)
				glitch = math.max(0, glitch - dt * 3)
				edgeFlash = math.max(0, edgeFlash - dt * 3.2)

				local scene = (t < T1 and 1) or (t < T2 and 2) or (t < T3 and 3) or (t < T4 and 4) or (t < T5 and 5) or 6
				if scene ~= lastScene then
					lastScene = scene
					if scene >= 2 then
						shake = math.max(shake, 14)
						glitch = 1
						FX.Ring(world, col, 620, 0.8, 4)
						pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 8, 0.06, 0.5)
					end
					if scene ~= 3 then hideCardStuff() end
					if scene ~= 4 then hideRows() end
					if scene == 5 then tri.yawVel = 22 end
				end

				-- stage background: black, strobing in the chaos act
				if scene == 5 and invert > 0.5 then
					stage.BackgroundColor3 = col
				else
					stage.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end

				-- warp field
				local warp = ({0.4, 1.6, 1.0, 0.8, 5.5, 3.0})[scene] + pulse * 2.2
				for _, s in ipairs(E.stars) do
					s.r = s.r + s.v * dt * (0.5 + warp)
					if s.r > 1.05 then
						s.r = math.random() * 0.05
						s.a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
					end
					local d = s.r * maxR
					s.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(s.a) * d, 0.5, math.sin(s.a) * d)
					s.f.Rotation = math.deg(s.a)
					s.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 + s.r * warp * 14, 2)
					s.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(1, s.r * 3) * (scene == 1 and 0.3 or 0.75)
					s.f.BackgroundColor3 = (s.i % 5 == 0) and col or WHITE
				end

				-- [v30] dust motes drift
				for _, m in ipairs(E.motes) do
					m.x = (m.x + m.vx * dt) % 1
					m.y = (m.y + m.vy * dt) % 1
					m.f.Position = UDim2.new(m.x, math.sin(t * 1.6 + m.ph) * 7, m.y, 0)
					m.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(m.s, m.s)
					m.f.BackgroundColor3 = (m.s == 2) and col or WHITE
					m.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.62 + 0.28 * math.sin(t * 2.2 + m.ph) - pulse * 0.3, 0, 1)
				end

				-- [v30] film grain flicker
				local gAmt = 0.05 + glitch * 0.3 + (scene == 5 and 0.14 or 0)
				for _, f in ipairs(E.grain) do
					if math.random() < gAmt then
						f.Visible = true
						f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.random(), math.random())
						f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8 + math.random() * 0.15
					else
						f.Visible = false
					end
				end

				-- rays
				local rayOn = CFG.IntroRays and (scene == 2 or scene == 5 or scene == 6)
				local rayK = rayOn and (0.55 + 0.45 * pulse) or 0
				for _, r in ipairs(E.rays) do
					r.f.Visible = rayK > 0.01
					if rayK > 0.01 then
						r.f.Rotation = math.deg(r.a + t * r.w * (scene == 5 and 3 or 1))
						r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(maxR * rayK, r.th)
						r.f.BackgroundColor3 = (r.i % 3 == 0) and col or WHITE
					end
				end

				-- scanline + letterbox
				if CFG.IntroScan then
					local sp = (t % 2.6) / 2.6
					scan.Visible = scene ~= 1
					scan.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, sp * 1.15 - 0.1, -60)
					scan.BackgroundColor3 = col
					local b = (0.085 + 0.012 * pulse) * easeOutCubic(math.min(1, t / 0.8))
					barTop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, b, 0)
					barBot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, b, 0)
				else
					scan.Visible = false
				end

				-- triangle layout / behaviour per scene
				local emblemK = 0
				if scene == 3 or scene == 4 then
					emblemK = easeOutCubic(clamp01((t - (scene == 3 and T2 or T3)) / 0.6))
					if scene == 4 then emblemK = 1 end
				elseif scene == 5 then
					emblemK = 1 - easeOutCubic(clamp01((t - T4) / 0.4))
				elseif scene == 2 then
					emblemK = 0
				end
				layoutTri(emblemK)
				pcall(function()
					tri.Layer.Visible = t >= 2.6
				end)
				if scene <= 2 then
					local asm = easeOutCubic(clamp01((t - T1) / 2.4))
					tri.env, tri.extra = 1 - asm, 1 - asm
					tri.yawVel = 2 + (1 - asm) * 14
					tri.scaleBase = 0.6 + 0.4 * asm
					tri.chargeVis = clamp01((t - 4.2) / 1.6)
				elseif scene == 3 or scene == 4 then
					tri.env, tri.extra = 0, 0
					tri.scaleBase = 1.05 + 0.18 * pulse
					tri.chargeVis = 0.3
				elseif scene == 5 then
					tri.env, tri.extra = 0, 0
					tri.scaleBase = 1.0 + 0.9 * easeOutCubic(clamp01((t - T4) / 0.5)) + 0.5 * pulse
					tri.chargeVis = 1
				else
					tri.env, tri.extra = 0, 0
					tri.scaleBase = 1.1 + (t - T5) * 0.06 + 0.2 * pulse
					tri.chargeVis = 0.6
				end

				-- ═════ scene 1 : BOOT ═════
				if scene == 1 then
					local shown = {}
					for i, line in ipairs(termLines) do
						local st = 0.15 + (i - 1) * 0.4
						local n = math.floor((t - st) * 38)
						if n > 0 then
							shown[#shown + 1] = line:sub(1, n)
						end
					end
					if #shown > bootLines then -- [v30] tick as each boot line lands
						bootLines = #shown
						itick(1.9, 0.35)
					end
					local cursor = (math.floor(t * 6) % 2 == 0) and "_" or " "
					term.Text = table.concat(shown, "\n") .. cursor
					term.TextSize = math.clamp(math.floor(sy * 0.045), 11, 20)
					term.Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, sy * 0.22)
					term.Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, sy * 0.5)
					term.TextColor3 = col
					term.TextTransparency = clamp01((t - 2.9) / 0.3)
				else
					term.Text = ""
				end

				-- ═════ scene 2 : AWAKEN ═════
				if scene == 2 then
					local CUE = 5.9
					placeBig(0.78, math.clamp(sy * 0.15, 34, 90), 0.94)
					if t < CUE then
						box.Visible = false
						roleL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.8)
						roleL.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.045, 12, 20))
						roleL.Text = spaced(scr("A SCRIPT BY", (t - 3.8) / 1.2))
						roleL.TextColor3 = col
						roleL.TextTransparency = 1 - easeOutCubic(clamp01((t - 3.6) / 0.5))
					else
						if not slammed then
							slammed = true
							FX.Ring(world, WHITE, 760, 0.8, 5)
							FX.Ring(world, col, 520, 0.9, 4)
							pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12, 0.07, 0.7)
							shake = 24
							glitch = 1
						end
						if not bloomed and t >= CUE then
							bloomed = true
							pcall(function() tri:Bloom() end)
						end
						local lt = t - CUE
						local e = easeOutCubic(clamp01(lt / 0.35))
						local ex = clamp01((t - (T2 - 0.25)) / 0.25)
						box.Visible = true
						setBig(scr(NAME, lt / 0.5))
						bigAlpha(math.max(1 - e, ex))
						chroma((1 - e) * 20 + pulse * 6 + (math.random() < 0.06 and 8 or 0))
						boxScale.Scale = 1 + (1 - e) * 0.6 + pulse * 0.05 + ex * 0.5
						roleL.Text = spaced("THE ORIGINAL CREATOR")
						roleL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.78 + math.clamp(sy * 0.15, 34, 90) * 0.6 + 12)
						roleL.TextTransparency = math.max(1 - easeOutCubic(clamp01((lt - 0.7) / 0.5)), ex)
						ul.Visible = true
						ul.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.78 + math.clamp(sy * 0.15, 34, 90) * 0.5 + 2)
						ul.Size = UDim2.new(0.5 * easeOutCubic(clamp01((lt - 0.3) / 0.7)) * (1 - ex), 0, 0, 2)
						ul.BackgroundColor3 = col
					end
				end

				-- ═════ scene 3 : THE CREATOR (cards) ═════
				if scene == 3 then
					local idx = math.min(#DATA.cards, math.floor((t - T2) / CARD_LEN) + 1)
					local lt = (t - T2) - (idx - 1) * CARD_LEN
					if idx ~= lastCard then -- [v30] card change: sparkle burst + tick + pip counter
						lastCard = idx
						FX.Sparks(world, col, 12, 150, 0.7)
						itick(1.5, 0.5)
					end
					showCard(DATA.cards[idx], lt, CARD_LEN, col)
					chyron.Text = spaced(string.format("%d / %d", idx, #DATA.cards))
					chyron.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.035, 10, 15))
					chyron.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.9)
					chyron.TextColor3 = col
					chyron.TextTransparency = 0.4
				end

				-- ═════ scene 4 : THE CREW ═════
				if scene == 4 then
					box.Visible = false
					ul.Visible = false
					roleL.TextTransparency = 1
					detL.TextTransparency = 1
					plate.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					local idx = math.min(#DATA.pages, math.floor((t - T3) / PAGE_LEN) + 1)
					local lt = (t - T3) - (idx - 1) * PAGE_LEN
					showPage(DATA.pages[idx], lt, PAGE_LEN, col)
					chyron.Text = spaced("ORIGINAL CREATOR  /  " .. CREATOR)
					chyron.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.04, 11, 16))
					chyron.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.1)
					chyron.TextColor3 = col
					chyron.TextTransparency = (math.random() < 0.04) and 0.7 or 0.15
				else
					if scene ~= 3 and scene ~= 6 and scene ~= 5 then chyron.Text = "" end
				end

				-- ═════ scene 5 : CHAOS DROP ═════
				if scene == 5 then
					hideRows()
					plate.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					roleL.TextTransparency = 1
					detL.TextTransparency = 1
					ul.Visible = false
					if beatN ~= lastWord or t - wordT > 0.5 then
						lastWord = beatN
						wordT = t
						chaosWord = DATA.chaos[math.random(1, #DATA.chaos)]
						box.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.random(-24, 24), 0, sy * (0.4 + math.random() * 0.22))
						boxScale.Scale = 0.75 + math.random() * 0.5
					end
					local h = math.clamp(sy * 0.2, 40, 120)
					box.Size = UDim2.new(0.98, 0, 0, h)
					box.Visible = true
					setBig(chaosWord)
					bigAlpha(0)
					lblM.TextColor3 = (invert > 0.5) and Color3.new(0, 0, 0) or WHITE
					chroma(6 + pulse * 22 + (math.random() < 0.3 and 10 or 0))
					boxScale.Scale = boxScale.Scale + (1 - boxScale.Scale) * math.min(1, dt * 6) + pulse * 0.02
					chyron.Text = spaced("ORIGINAL CREATOR  /  " .. CREATOR)
					chyron.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.04, 11, 16))
					chyron.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.1)
					chyron.TextColor3 = (invert > 0.5) and Color3.new(0, 0, 0) or col
					chyron.TextTransparency = (math.floor(t * 8) % 2 == 0) and 0 or 0.6
					glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.35)
					if E.marq then
						local mh = sy * 0.1
						E.marq.Visible = true
						E.marq.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(mh * E.marqRatio, mh)
						local wpx = mh * E.marqRatio
						local x = sw.X - ((t - T4) * sy * 1.8) % (wpx + sw.X)
						E.marq.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0.86, 0)
					end
				else
					if E.marq then E.marq.Visible = false end
					lblM.TextColor3 = WHITE
				end

				-- ═════ scene 6 : TITLE + HAND-OFF ═════
				if scene == 6 then
					chyron.TextTransparency = 1
					local lt = t - T5
					local e = easeOutCubic(clamp01(lt / 0.4))
					local h = math.clamp(sy * 0.15, 34, 92)
					box.Visible = true
					placeBig(0.5, h, 0.96)
					setBig(scr("NOOBY'S UH MODDED REANIMATION", lt / 0.7))
					bigAlpha(1 - e)
					chroma((1 - e) * 18 + pulse * 5)
					boxScale.Scale = 1 + (1 - e) * 0.8 + pulse * 0.03
					roleL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.5 + h * 0.5 + 16)
					roleL.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.045, 12, 19))
					local subText = (CFG.IntroSub ~= "" and tostring(CFG.IntroSub):gsub("[^\32-\126]", ""):sub(1, 80))
						or ("REMASTERED  //  " .. tostring(UhhhhhhVersion) .. "  //  ORIGINAL BY " .. CREATOR)
					roleL.Text = scr(subText, (lt - 0.4) / 0.6)
					roleL.TextColor3 = col
					roleL.TextTransparency = 1 - clamp01((lt - 0.3) / 0.3)
					detL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.5 + h * 0.5 + 40)
					detL.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.04, 11, 16))
					detL.Text = "UI READY  -  MODULES LOAD IN THE BACKGROUND  -  YOU CAN REANIMATE NOW"
					detL.TextColor3 = WHITE
					detL.TextTransparency = (lt > 2.0) and (math.floor(t * 4) % 2 == 0 and 0 or 0.45) or 1
					-- [v30] READY stamp slams in just before the hand-off
					if lt > 2.3 then
						if not readyFired then
							readyFired = true
							FX.Ring(world, col, 420, 0.6, 3)
							itick(0.7, 0.9)
						end
						local rp = easeOutBack(clamp01((lt - 2.3) / 0.35))
						hdr.Text = "READY"
						hdr.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.5 - h * 0.5 - 34)
						hdr.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.055, 15, 26) * math.max(0.05, rp))
						hdr.TextColor3 = col
						hdr.TextTransparency = 0
					else
						hdr.TextTransparency = 1
					end
					ul.Visible = false
				end

				-- glitch tears
				local g = math.max(glitch, pulse * 0.6)
				for i, f in ipairs(E.tear) do
					if g > 0.05 and math.random() < g * 0.5 then
						f.Visible = true
						f.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.random(-30, 30) * g, 0, math.random(0, math.max(1, math.floor(sy))))
						f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.random(2, 3 + math.floor(26 * g)))
						f.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and col or WHITE
						f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + math.random() * 0.45
					else
						f.Visible = false
					end
				end

				-- camera shake
				shake = math.max(0, shake - dt * 40)
				world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * shake * INTENSITY, 0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * shake * INTENSITY)
				world.Rotation = (scene == 5 or scene == 6) and ((math.random() - 0.5) * shake * 0.12 * INTENSITY) or 0

				-- HUD
				local hin = easeOutCubic(clamp01((t - 0.2) / 0.9))
				local inset = 22 + (1 - hin) * 80
				for _, b in ipairs(E.hud) do
					b.host.Position = UDim2.new(b.ax, b.ax == 0 and inset or -inset, b.ay, b.ay == 0 and inset or -inset)
					local tr = 1 - hin
					if math.random() < 0.04 then tr = math.min(1, tr + 0.5) end
					b.h.BackgroundTransparency, b.v.BackgroundTransparency = tr, tr
					b.h.BackgroundColor3, b.v.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
				end
				local hudA = 1 - hin * 0.85
				tcL.Text = string.format("REC  %05.2f / %05.2f", math.min(t, DUR), DUR)
				nowL.Text = "NOW PLAYING: DUBMOOD - CHANGE (RADIO EDIT)"
				ctrL.Text = string.format("SYS.INIT  %03d%%", math.floor(clamp01(t / DUR) * 100))
				modL.Text = modStatus()
				for _, l in ipairs({tcL, nowL, modL, ctrL}) do
					l.TextColor3 = col
					l.TextTransparency = hudA
				end
				progFill.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / DUR), 0, 1, 0)
				progFill.BackgroundColor3 = col
				skipStroke.Color = col
				skipBtn.TextColor3 = col
				-- [v30] glowing progress head, breathing skip button, beat edge-flash
				progDot.BackgroundColor3 = col
				progDot.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.15 - pulse * 0.3, 0, 1)
				local dotS = 6 + pulse * 5
				progDot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(dotS, dotS)
				skipStroke.Transparency = 0.2 + 0.22 * math.sin(t * 3)
				for _, f in ipairs(E.edge) do
					f.BackgroundColor3 = col
					f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - edgeFlash * 0.55
					f.Visible = edgeFlash > 0.02
				end

				-- hand-off flash
				local fa = clamp01((t - (tEnd - flashLen)) / flashLen)
				flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - fa * math.clamp(INTENSITY, 0.4, 1)
			end
		end
		local ok, err = pcall(run)
		if not ok then
			warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
		end

		-- finale: always runs (even after a skip or an error)
		for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
			pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
		end
		pcall(function() tri:Destroy() end)
		pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
		FX.IntroActive = false
		pcall(function()
			local fl = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(INTENSITY, 0, 1) * 0.9,
				BorderSizePixel = 0, Interactable = false, ZIndex = 256,
			})
			tween(fl, 1, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
			Debris:AddItem(fl, 1.1)
			FX.Ring(MainFrame, accent(), 1000, 0.9, 6)
			FX.Ring(MainFrame, WHITE, 700, 0.7, 3)
			FX.BlurPulse(16, 0.04, 1.0)
		end)
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ 3D LOADING SCREEN ═════════════════════════
	function FX.BuildLoader(host, env)
		local L = {Visible = false, p = 0, target = 0}
		local showToken = 0
		local capT = 0

		local root = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
		root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		root.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		root.BorderSizePixel = 0
		root.Visible = false
		root.ZIndex = 40
		root.ClipsDescendants = true

		local function label(size, ax, ay, pos, sz)
			local l = Util.Instance("TextLabel", root)
			l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
			l.Position = pos
			l.Size = sz
			l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			l.Font = Enum.Font.Code
			l.TextSize = size
			l.TextColor3 = env.UITextColor and env.UITextColor.Value or WHITE
			l.ZIndex = 5
			l.Text = ""
			return l
		end
		local hint = label(12, 0.5, 0, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 14))
		hint.Text = "tap anywhere to open the UI now  ·  triangle: drag / tap / hold 5s"
		hint.TextTransparency = 0.55
		local cap = label(14, 0.5, 1, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -50), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16))
		local status = label(13, 0.5, 1, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -20), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16))
		status.Text = "Loading modules..."
		if env.UITextColor then
			env.UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(v)
				hint.TextColor3, cap.TextColor3, status.TextColor3 = v, v, v
			end)
		end

		local chargeTrack = Util.Instance("Frame", root)
		chargeTrack.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
		chargeTrack.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -44)
		chargeTrack.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 2)
		chargeTrack.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		chargeTrack.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		chargeTrack.BorderSizePixel = 0
		chargeTrack.ZIndex = 5
		local chargeFill = Util.Instance("Frame", chargeTrack)
		chargeFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		chargeFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		chargeFill.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		chargeFill.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		chargeFill.ZIndex = 6

		local track = Util.Instance("Frame", root)
		track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
		track.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -10)
		track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 3)
		track.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		track.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
		track.BorderSizePixel = 0
		track.ZIndex = 5
		local fill = Util.Instance("Frame", track)
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fill.ZIndex = 6

		local tri = FX.NewTriangle3D(root, {
			Interactive = true, ZIndex = 2, Ring = true, Track = true, RingSize = 176,
			HitSize = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 150),
			IsVisible = function() return root.Visible end,
			OnAction = function(name, n)
				cap.Text = (n > 0 and (n .. "/5  ") or "") .. name
				capT = 1.4
				cap.TextTransparency = 0
			end,
		})
		tri:SetActive(false)
		L.Triangle = tri

		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			if not L.Visible and root.BackgroundTransparency >= 0.999 then return end
			local t = env.Time and env.Time() or os.clock()
			if env.GetUIBGColor then root.BackgroundColor3 = env.GetUIBGColor(t) end
			local c = env.GetUIColor and env.GetUIColor(t) or WHITE
			fill.BackgroundColor3 = c
			chargeFill.BackgroundColor3 = c
			L.p = L.p + (L.target - L.p) * (1 - math.exp(-8 * dt))
			fill.Size = UDim2.new(L.p, 0, 1, 0)
			local ch = tri.charge
			chargeFill.Size = UDim2.new(ch, 0, 1, 0)
			chargeFill.BackgroundTransparency = ch > 0.02 and 0 or 1
			chargeTrack.BackgroundTransparency = ch > 0.02 and 0.8 or 1
			if ch > 0.03 and tri.phase == "idle" then
				cap.Text = string.format("HOLD  %d%%", math.floor(ch * 100))
				capT = 0.4
			end
			capT = math.max(0, capT - dt)
			cap.TextTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(capT / 0.4, 0, 1)
		end)

		function L.Show()
			if L.Visible then return end
			L.Visible = true
			showToken = showToken + 1
			L.p, L.target = 0, 0
			root.Visible = true
			tri:SetActive(true)
			tri.scaleBase = 1
			tri:PopIn()
			tween(root, 0.35, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.08})
			FX.BlurPulse(6, 0.12, 0.4)
			FX.Play("open", 1, 0.8)
		end
		function L.Hide()
			if not L.Visible then return end
			L.Visible = false
			showToken = showToken + 1
			local my = showToken
			L.target = 1
			tri:Finale()
			FX.BlurPulse(5, 0.1, 0.5)
			task.delay(0.45, function()
				if my ~= showToken then return end
				tween(root, 0.45, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
				task.delay(0.5, function()
					if my ~= showToken then return end
					root.Visible = false
					tri:SetActive(false)
				end)
			end)
		end
		function L.SetStatus(text, prog)
			if typeof(text) == "string" then status.Text = text end
			if type(prog) == "number" then
				L.target = math.clamp(prog, 0, 1)
			end
		end
		return L
	end
	function FX.LoaderStatus(text, prog)
		if FX.Loader and FX.Loader.Visible then
			FX.Loader.SetStatus(text, prog)
		end
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ HOME-SCREEN HERO TRIANGLE ═════════════════════════
	-- The cool-scene triangle is now the real interactive 3D one: tap = 5 actions (cycles),
	-- drag = rotate, hold 5s = overload -> explode -> reform. Leans toward the cursor and
	-- pulses with the music. Click anywhere ELSE on the scene to enter (as before).
	function FX.MountHero(frame, textColor, music)
		local cap = Util.Instance("TextLabel", frame)
		cap.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		cap.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 7)
		cap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
		cap.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cap.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		cap.TextSize = 14
		cap.TextColor3 = textColor and textColor.Value or WHITE
		cap.TextTransparency = 1
		cap.Text = ""
		cap.ZIndex = 6
		cap.Interactable = false
		if textColor then
			textColor.Changed:Connect(function(v)
				cap.TextColor3 = v
			end)
		end

		-- HUD: corner brackets + live FPS readout
		local brackets = {}
		for _, c in ipairs({{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, 1}, {1, 1}}) do
			local ax, ay = c[1], c[2]
			for k = 1, 2 do
				local f = Util.Instance("Frame", frame)
				f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
				f.Position = UDim2.new(ax, ax == 0 and 6 or -6, ay, ay == 0 and 6 or -6)
				f.Size = (k == 1) and UDim2.fromOffset(14, 1) or UDim2.fromOffset(1, 14)
				f.BorderSizePixel = 0
				f.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
				f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
				f.ZIndex = 6
				f.Interactable = false
				brackets[#brackets + 1] = f
			end
		end
		local stat = Util.Instance("TextLabel", frame)
		stat.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		stat.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 8)
		stat.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 12)
		stat.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		stat.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		stat.TextSize = 11
		stat.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		stat.TextColor3 = textColor and textColor.Value or WHITE
		stat.TextTransparency = 0.5
		stat.Text = ""
		stat.ZIndex = 6
		stat.Interactable = false
		if textColor then
			textColor.Changed:Connect(function(v)
				stat.TextColor3 = v
			end)
		end
		local fps, fpsT = 60, 0

		local capT, used = 0, false
		local hero
		hero = FX.NewTriangle3D(frame, {
			Interactive = true, ZIndex = 2, Ring = true, Track = true, Music = music,
			RingSize = 176,
			HitSize = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 150),
			IsVisible = function()
				return Util.IsGuiVisible(frame)
			end,
			OnAction = function(name, n)
				used = true
				cap.Text = (n > 0 and (n .. "/5  ") or "") .. name
				capT = 1.6
			end,
		})

		local stuck = 0
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			if not frame.Parent then return end
			-- watchdog: a page transition whose Completed never fired used to leave this scene
			-- permanently Interactable=false (dead triangle + dead click-to-start)
			if frame.Visible and not frame.Interactable and frame.Position == UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0) then
				stuck = stuck + dt
				if stuck > 0.9 then
					frame.Interactable = true
					stuck = 0
				end
			else
				stuck = 0
			end
			if not Util.IsGuiVisible(frame) then return end
			fps = fps + (1 / math.max(dt, 1e-3) - fps) * 0.08
			fpsT = fpsT + dt
			if fpsT > 0.25 then
				fpsT = 0
				stat.Text = string.format("%d FPS", math.floor(fps + 0.5))
			end
			local accent = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
			for _, f in ipairs(brackets) do
				f.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			end
			if hero.charge > 0.03 and hero.phase == "idle" then
				cap.Text = string.format("HOLD  %d%%", math.floor(hero.charge * 100))
				capT = 0.4
			end
			capT = math.max(0, capT - dt)
			if capT > 0 then
				cap.TextTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(capT / 0.4, 0, 1)
			elseif not used then
				cap.Text = "tap  ·  drag  ·  hold 5s"
				cap.TextTransparency = 0.55 + math.sin(os.clock() * 2) * 0.12
			else
				cap.TextTransparency = 1
			end
		end)
		hero:PopIn()
		FX.Hero = hero
		return hero
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ WINDOW BOOT-UP ═════════════════════════
	-- PreBoot collapses the window to a small title bar the moment it is created (no one-frame flash);
	-- Chrome then expands it. Failsafe restores the size if anything goes wrong.
	function FX.PreBoot(win)
		FX.BootFull = win.Size
		win.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 30)
		task.spawn(function() -- [v23] the intro now runs in parallel, so the safety net only starts once it is over
			while FX.IntroActive do task.wait(0.25) end
			task.wait(12)
			if win.Parent and win.Size.X.Offset == 44 and win.Size.Y.Offset == 30 then
				win.Size = FX.BootFull
			end
		end)
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ CHROME / AMBIENT LAYER ═════════════════════════
	function FX.Chrome(env)
		local win, content = env.UIMainWindow, env.WindowContent
		local music = env.UISound and env.UISound.Music
		if not win or not content then return end
		local S = FX.Settings
		local function guard(name, f)
			local ok, e = pcall(f)
			if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(e)) end
		end

		local topBar
		for _, c in ipairs(win:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("Frame") and c.Size.Y.Offset == 30 and c.Size.X.Scale == 1 then
				topBar = c
				break
			end
		end

		-- ANIM · boot-up: title bar stretches open, then the body unfolds with an overshoot
		task.spawn(function()
			guard("boot", function()
				while FX.IntroActive do task.wait(0.1) end -- [v23] unfold the window right as the intro hands over
				local full = FX.BootFull or win.Size
				if win.Size.X.Offset > 60 then return end
				if not S.Transitions then
					win.Size = full
					return
				end
				tween(win, 0.32, Quint, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(full.X.Offset, 30)})
				task.wait(0.32)
				FX.Play("open", 0.9)
				tween(win, 0.6, Back, EOut, {Size = full})
			end)
		end)

		-- top bar: live 3D logo + periodic light shimmer
		guard("topbar", function()
			if not topBar then return end
			local label
			for _, c in ipairs(topBar:GetChildren()) do
				if c:IsA("TextLabel") then
					label = c
					break
				end
			end
			if label then
				label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0.5, 0)
				label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -66, 1, 0)
			end
			local logo = FX.NewTriangle3D(topBar, {
				ZIndex = 5, LayerSize = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 30),
				IsVisible = function()
					return Util.IsGuiVisible(topBar)
				end,
			})
			logo.baseSpin = 1.6
			logo.scaleBase = 1.25
			FX.Logo = logo

			local shim = Util.Instance("Frame", topBar)
			shim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			shim.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
			shim.BorderSizePixel = 0
			shim.ZIndex = 0
			shim.Interactable = false
			local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", shim)
			g.Rotation = 20
			g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.86),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
			})
			g.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)
			task.spawn(function()
				while shim.Parent do
					task.wait(5 + math.random() * 3)
					if S.Ambient and S.Transitions and Util.IsGuiVisible(topBar) then
						g.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)
						tween(g, 0.9, Quad, EInOut, {Offset = Vector2.new(1, 0)})
					end
				end
			end)
		end)

		-- underglow strip along the bottom edge of the window
		local glow, glowGrad
		guard("underglow", function()
			glow = Util.Instance("Frame", win)
			glow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
			glow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -1)
			glow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 2)
			glow.BorderSizePixel = 0
			glow.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
			glow.ZIndex = 4
			glow.Interactable = false
			glowGrad = Util.Instance("UIGradient", glow)
			glowGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, 0.15),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 0.15),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
			})
		end)

		-- depth vignette: content fades into the title bar / window edge instead of being cut off
		local vig = {}
		guard("vignette", function()
			for _, top in ipairs({true, false}) do
				local f = Util.Instance("Frame", content)
				f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, top and 0 or 1)
				f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, top and 0 or 1)
				f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
				f.BorderSizePixel = 0
				f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				f.ZIndex = 50
				f.Interactable = false
				local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
				g.Rotation = top and 90 or -90
				g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
				vig[#vig + 1] = f
			end
		end)

		-- ANIM · beat pulse: window border + underglow breathe with the music
		local stroke = win:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		local last, pulse = 0, 0
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			if not win.Parent then return end
			pcall(function()
				local t = env.Time and env.Time() or os.clock()
				local bg, col = FX.GetBG(), FX.GetColor()
				for _, f in ipairs(vig) do
					f.BackgroundColor3 = bg
					f.Visible = S.Ambient
				end
				if S.Ambient and music then
					local pbl = music.PlaybackLoudness
					if pbl - last > 20 then pulse = 1 end
					last = pbl
				end
				pulse = math.max(0, pulse - dt * 3.2)
				if stroke then
					stroke.Thickness = S.Ambient and (1 + pulse * 1.8) or 1
				end
				if glow then
					glow.Visible = S.Ambient
					glow.BackgroundColor3 = col
					glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 - pulse * 0.3
					glowGrad.Offset = Vector2.new(math.sin(t * 0.7) * 0.45, 0)
				end
			end)
		end)

		-- ANIM · click shockwave: a ring leaves the cursor on every press inside the window
		guard("shockwave", function()
			UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if not S.Ambient or not win.Visible then return end
				local ty = input.UserInputType
				if ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
				local m
				if ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
					m = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
				else
					m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
				end
				local ap, as = win.AbsolutePosition, win.AbsoluteSize
				if m.X < ap.X or m.Y < ap.Y or m.X > ap.X + as.X or m.Y > ap.Y + as.Y then return end
				FX.Ring(win, FX.GetColor(), 64, 0.45, 2, UDim2.fromOffset(m.X - ap.X, m.Y - ap.Y))
			end)
		end)
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ HOOK EVERYTHING UP ═════════════════════════
	function FX.Bind(env)
		local SaveData = env.SaveData
		FX.UISound = env.UISound
		FX.Window = env.UIMainWindow
		FX.Content = env.WindowContent
		FX.GetColor = function()
			return env.GetUIColor(env.Time and env.Time() or os.clock())
		end
		FX.GetBG = function()
			return env.GetUIBGColor(env.Time and env.Time() or os.clock())
		end
		if SaveData then
			FX.Settings.Blur = SaveData.FXBlur ~= false
			FX.Settings.Transitions = SaveData.FXTransitions ~= false
			FX.Settings.ExtraSounds = SaveData.FXSounds ~= false
			FX.Settings.Ambient = SaveData.FXAmbient ~= false
		end
		if env.CracktroFrame then
			assignStyle(env.CracktroFrame, 2)
		end
		task.defer(function()
			local ok, e = pcall(FX.Chrome, env)
			if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] chrome: " .. tostring(e)) end
		end)

		local UI = env.UI
		if UI then
			local origPage, origButton = UI.CreatePage, UI.CreateButton
			UI.CreatePage = function(...)
				local p = origPage(...)
				if p then assignStyle(p) end
				return p
			end
			UI.CreateButton = function(...)
				local b, txt = origButton(...)
				if b then pcall(FX.EnhanceButton, b) end
				return b, txt
			end
		end

		local oldNotify = Util.UINotify
		if oldNotify then
			Util.UINotify = function(text, prog)
				pcall(FX.LoaderStatus, text, prog)
				return oldNotify(text, prog)
			end
		end

		if env.CracktroFrame and env.IsLoaded then
			FX.Loader = FX.BuildLoader(env.CracktroFrame, env)
			task.spawn(function()
				while true do
					local ok, loaded = pcall(env.IsLoaded)
					if ok then
						if not loaded and not FX.Loader.Visible then
							FX.Loader.Show()
						elseif loaded and FX.Loader.Visible then
							FX.Loader.Hide()
						end
					end
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	return FX
end)()

Util.LoopedHSV = function(h, s, v)
	h %= 1
	s = math.clamp(s, 0, 1)
	v = math.clamp(v, 0, 1)
	return Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
end
Util.Instance = function(cl, p)
	local i = Instance.new(cl)
	i.Name = Util.RandomString()
	i.Parent = p
	return i
end
Util.LinkDestroyI2C = function(a, b)
	a.Destroying:Once(function()
		b:Disconnect()
	end)
end
Util.LinkDestroyI2I = function(a, b)
	Util.LinkDestroyI2C(b, a.Destroying:Once(function()
		task.defer(b.Destroy, b)
	end))
end
Util.ClearAllChildrenGui = function(a)
	for _,v in a:GetChildren() do
		if v:IsA("GuiObject") then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end
end
Util.GetTransparency = function(part)
	return 1 - (1 - part.Transparency) * (1 - part.LocalTransparencyModifier)
end
Util.ScaleCFrame = function(cf, scale)
	return cf + cf.Position * (scale - 1)
end
Util.IsGuiVisible = function(guiObject)
	if not guiObject or not guiObject:IsA("GuiObject") then return false end
	while guiObject do
		if not guiObject.Visible then
			return false
		end
		guiObject = guiObject:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("GuiObject")
	end
	return true
end
Util.IsGuiInteractable = function(guiObject)
	if not guiObject or not guiObject:IsA("GuiObject") then return false end
	while guiObject do
		if not guiObject.Visible or not guiObject.Interactable then
			return false
		end
		guiObject = guiObject:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("GuiObject")
	end
	return true
end
Util.WillGuiSinkInput = function(guiObject)
	return Util.IsGuiInteractable(guiObject) and (guiObject.Active or guiObject:IsA("GuiButton"))
end
Util.UDim2ToVector2Scale = function(x)
	return Vector2.new(x.X.Scale, x.Y.Scale)
end
Util.UDim2ToVector2Offset = function(x)
	return Vector2.new(x.X.Offset, x.Y.Offset)
end
Util.Vector2ToUDim2Scale = function(x)
	return UDim2.fromScale(x.X, x.Y)
end
Util.Vector2ToUDim2Offset = function(x)
	return UDim2.fromOffset(x.X, x.Y)
end
Util.ForceTextSize = function(inst)
	if inst:IsA("TextLabel") then
		local original = inst.TextSize
		local conn conn = RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
			local size = GuiService.PreferredTextSize.Name
			if size == "Medium" then
				inst.TextSize = original
			elseif size == "Large" then
				inst.TextSize = original - 4
			elseif size == "Larger" then
				inst.TextSize = original - 9
			elseif size == "Largest" then
				inst.TextSize = original - 14
			end
		end)
		Util.LinkDestroyI2C(inst, conn)
	end
end
Util.QueryPlayerSelector = function(query, excludespeaker)
	if #query == 0 then return end
	query = query:lower()
	local t = {}
	for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if player ~= Player or not excludespeaker then
			local a = player.DisplayName:lower():find(query)
			local b = player.Name:lower():find(query)
			if a then table.insert(t, {player, 1, a}) end
			if b then table.insert(t, {player, 0, b}) end
		end
	end
	table.sort(t, function(a, b)
		if a[2] == b[2] then
			return a[3] < b[3]
		end
		return a[2] < b[2]
	end)
	if t[1] then
		return t[1][1]
	end
	return nil
end

Util.GetCDNAsset = function(filename)
	local path = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. filename
	local s, id = pcall(isfile, path)
	if s and id then
		s, id = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
		if s then return id end
	end
	return ""
end

Util.MakeTriforce = function(tris, color, dur)
	dur = dur or 8
	local function CreateTriangle(parent, radius, width, rotation, color)
		local height = (math.sqrt(3) / 2) * width
		local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
		pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		pivot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
		pivot.Rotation = rotation
		local tri = Util.Instance("ImageLabel", pivot)
		tri.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
		tri.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5 - radius, 0)
		tri.Size = UDim2.new(width, 0, height, 0)
		tri.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tri.BorderSizePixel = 0
		tri.Image = Util.GetCDNAsset("letriangul.graphic.png")
		local grey = math.max(color.R, color.G, color.B) * 0.5
		tri.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(grey, grey, grey)
		TweenService:Create(tri, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			ImageColor3 = color
		}):Play()
	end
	local radius = 0.1
	local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame")
	pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	local width = 2 * radius * math.sin(math.pi / tris) * 2
	for i=1, tris do
		CreateTriangle(pivot, radius, width, (i / tris) * 360, color)
	end
	return pivot
end
Util.MakeText = function(text)
	text = text:upper()
	local ls = "BCDEIKOPQRSTUVYZ\\_`N^MJ"
	local lt = ""
	-- !, ", #, $, %, &, ', (, ), *, +, ,, -, ., /
	lt ..= "DDDDD@DFF@@@@@FSFSFSF@@@@@@@@@@@@@@EMMUKKTDD@@@@@DEEEEEDDBBBBBD@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@DE@@@G@@@@@@@@@DABBDEEI"
	-- numbers
	lt ..= "GJJJJJGDVDDDDSGJAGIISRAAGAARWJJSAAASIIRAARGIIRJJGSAABBDDGJJGJJGGJJHAAG"
	-- :, ;, <, =, >, ?, @
	lt ..= "@DD@DD@@DD@DE@@BDEDB@@@G@G@@@EDBDE@GJABD@D@@@@@@@"
	-- capital letters
	lt ..= "DFJSJJJRJJRJJRGJIIIJGRJJJJJRSIIRIISSIIRIIIHIILJJHJJJSJJJGDDDDDGAAAAAJHJKMOMKJIIIIIISJQNJJJJJJPNLJJGJJJJJGRJJRIIIGJJJNGCRJJRMKJGJIGAJGSDDDDDDJJJJJJGJJJJJFDJJJNQJJJJFDFJJJJFDDDDSABDEIS"
	local pixs = {}
	local totalsize = 0
	for i=0, 6 do
		local row = {}
		for j=1, text:len() do
			local c = text:byte(j, j)
			local w = 0
			if c ~= 0x20 then
				local k = (c - 33) * 7 + i
				w = lt:byte(k + 1, k + 1)
				if w ~= nil and w > 64 then
					w = ls:byte(w - 64, w - 64) - 65
				else
					w = 0
				end
			end
			for k=0, 5 do
				local h = (j - 1) * 6 + (4 - k)
				totalsize = math.max(totalsize, h + 1)
				local p = (w // math.pow(2, k)) % 2
				if p > 0 then
					row[h] = true
				end
			end
		end
		pixs[i] = row
	end
	local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame")
	pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	pivot.Size = UDim2.new(0, totalsize, 0, 7)
	pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	for i=0, 6 do
		local row = pixs[i]
		local olde = nil
		local olds = 0
		for j=0, totalsize - 1 do
			local pix = row[j]
			if pix == true then
				if olde ~= nil then
					olds += 1
					olde.Size = UDim2.new(olds / totalsize, 0, 1 / 7, 0)
				else
					olde = Util.Instance("Frame", pivot)
					olde.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
					olde.Position = UDim2.new(j / totalsize, 0, i / 7, 0)
					olde.Size = UDim2.new(1 / totalsize, 0, 1 / 7, 0)
					olde.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					olde.BorderSizePixel = 0
					olds = 1
				end
			else
				olde = nil
				olds = 0
			end
		end
	end
	return pivot
end
Util.SetTextColor = function(text, color, tran)
	for _,v in text:GetChildren() do
		v.BackgroundColor3 = color
		v.BackgroundTransparency = tran
	end
end

}
pcall(function()
	local future = table.clone(MusicPlayer.Database)
	if isfile("UhhhhhhReanim/Muzik/nobuiltin") then
		table.clear(future)
	end
	for _,file in listfiles("UhhhhhhReanim/Muzik") do
		if isfile(file) and file:sub(-4, -1) == ".mp3" then
			table.insert(future, {file, file:sub(21, -5)})
		end
	end
	if #future > 0 then
		MusicPlayer.Database = future
	end
end)
MusicPlayer.Switching = false
MusicPlayer.Last = 1
MusicPlayer.PlayMusic = function(i)
	if MusicPlayer.Switching then return end
	MusicPlayer.Switching = true
	local last = MusicPlayer.LastMusic
	if not i then
		i = last
		while i == last do
			i = math.random(1, #MusicPlayer.Database)
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	MusicPlayer.LastMusic = i
	local hi = MusicPlayer.Database[i]
	local soundid, soundname = hi[1], hi[2]
	local s, id = pcall(isfile, soundid)
	if s and id then
		s, id = pcall(getcustomasset, soundid)
		if s then
			soundid = id
		else
			soundid = ""
		end
	else
		soundid = ""
	end
	if #soundid == 0 then
		MusicPlayer.Switching = false
		return MusicPlayer.PlayMusic()
	end
	UISound.Music.SoundId = soundid
	UISound.Music.Name = soundname
	UISound.Music:Stop()
	task.wait()
	UISound.Music.TimePosition = 0
	task.wait()
	UISound.Music:Play()
	task.wait()
	MusicPlayer.Switching = false
end
UISound.Music.Ended:Connect(function()
	MusicPlayer.PlayMusic()
end)

-- ═════ DYNAMIC COLOUR SYSTEM (v24) ═════
-- One live palette (Accent / Secondary / Tertiary / Bg / Text) that every UI element, the minigame HUDs and the Arcade follow.
-- Modes: 1 Theme, 2 Picked, 3 Rainbow, 4 Harmony cycle, 5 Aurora, 6 Music reactive, 7 Day/Night.  No hex typing needed: use the colour picker.
Util.Color = (function()
	local C = {}
	local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	C.Modes = {"Theme (follow UI theme)", "Picked color", "Rainbow", "Harmony cycle", "Aurora", "Music reactive", "Day / Night"}
	C.Harmonies = {"Analogous", "Complementary", "Triadic", "Split complementary", "Monochrome"}
	C.Cur = WHITE
	C.ThemeCol = WHITE
	local function cfg() return (Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg) or {} end
	local function hsv(c) return c:ToHSV() end
	local function clamp(x, a, b) if x < a then return a elseif x > b then return b end return x end
	local function hueLerp(a, b, k)
		local d = ((b - a + 0.5) % 1) - 0.5
		return (a + d * k) % 1
	end
	function C.Init()
		local st = Util.FX and Util.FX.Store
		if st and st.AccentMode == nil and type(st.UIAccent) == "string" and st.UIAccent ~= "" then
			Util.FX.SetCfg("AccentMode", 2) -- v23 users who had picked an accent keep it
		end
	end
	function C.Base()
		local c = cfg()
		return Util.ParseHex(c.UIAccent or "") or C.ThemeCol
	end
	function C.HarmonyHues(h)
		local m = cfg().HarmonyMode or 1
		if m == 2 then return {h, (h + 0.5) % 1}
		elseif m == 3 then return {h, (h + 1 / 3) % 1, (h + 2 / 3) % 1}
		elseif m == 4 then return {h, (h + 0.42) % 1, (h + 0.58) % 1}
		elseif m == 5 then return {h}
		end
		return {h, (h + 0.08) % 1, (h - 0.08) % 1}
	end
	local function music()
		local ok, v = pcall(function()
			local s = Util.FX and Util.FX.UISound and Util.FX.UISound.Music
			if s and s.IsPlaying ~= false then return s.PlaybackLoudness end
			return 0
		end)
		return ok and v or 0
	end
	-- t = time, theme = the colour the selected UI theme would use. Returns the accent colour for this frame.
	function C.Resolve(t, theme)
		local c = cfg()
		C.ThemeCol = theme or C.ThemeCol
		local mode = c.AccentMode or 1
		local sp = c.ColorSpeed or 1
		local out = C.ThemeCol
		local base = C.Base()
		local bh, bs, bv = base:ToHSV()
		if mode == 2 then
			out = Util.ParseHex(c.UIAccent or "") or C.ThemeCol
		elseif mode == 3 then
			out = Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.1 * sp) % 1, 0.8, 1)
		elseif mode == 4 then
			local hues = C.HarmonyHues(bh)
			local pos = (t * 0.12 * sp) % #hues
			local i = math.floor(pos)
			local k = pos - i
			k = k * k * (3 - 2 * k)
			local h = hueLerp(hues[i + 1], hues[(i + 1) % #hues + 1], k)
			out = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.max(bs, 0.55), math.max(bv, 0.85))
		elseif mode == 5 then
			local h = bh + 0.12 * math.sin(t * 0.5 * sp) + 0.07 * math.sin(t * 0.31 * sp + 1.7)
			out = Color3.fromHSV(h % 1, math.max(bs, 0.6), 0.9 + 0.1 * math.sin(t * 0.8 * sp))
		elseif mode == 6 then
			local l = clamp(music() / 700, 0, 1)
			C._ml = (C._ml or 0) + (l - (C._ml or 0)) * 0.25
			out = Color3.fromHSV((bh + C._ml * 0.28) % 1, math.max(bs, 0.6), 0.7 + 0.3 * C._ml)
		elseif mode == 7 then
			local hr = tonumber(os.date("%H")) + tonumber(os.date("%M")) / 60
			local stops = {{0, 0.64, 0.7}, {5, 0.62, 0.8}, {7, 0.06, 1}, {12, 0.53, 1}, {17, 0.08, 1}, {19.5, 0.92, 0.9}, {22, 0.7, 0.75}, {24, 0.64, 0.7}}
			local a, b = stops[1], stops[2]
			for i = 1, #stops - 1 do if hr >= stops[i][1] and hr <= stops[i + 1][1] then a, b = stops[i], stops[i + 1] end end
			local k = (hr - a[1]) / math.max(0.001, b[1] - a[1])
			out = Color3.fromHSV(hueLerp(a[2], b[2], k), 0.75, a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * k)
		end
		if (c.ColorSat or 1) == 1 and (c.ColorBright or 1) == 1 then C.Cur = out return out end
		local h, s, v = out:ToHSV()
		out = Color3.fromHSV(h, clamp(s * (c.ColorSat or 1), 0, 1), clamp(v * (c.ColorBright or 1), 0, 1))
		C.Cur = out
		return out
	end
	function C.Palette(t)
		local a = C.Cur
		local h, s, v = a:ToHSV()
		local hues = C.HarmonyHues(h)
		local m = cfg().HarmonyMode or 1
		local sec, ter
		if m == 5 then
			sec = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.6, math.max(0.35, v * 0.7))
			ter = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.4, 1)
		else
			sec = Color3.fromHSV(hues[2] or h, s, v)
			ter = Color3.fromHSV(hues[3] or ((h + 0.25) % 1), s * 0.85, v)
		end
		return {Accent = a, Secondary = sec, Tertiary = ter, Bg = Color3.fromHSV(h, clamp(s * 0.55, 0, 0.6), 0.07), Text = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(a, 0.12)}
	end
	return C
end)()


Util.FX.InitCustom(SaveData) -- [custom] load saved customization before the intro runs
pcall(Util.Color.Init)

-- [uh admin ext] FLOATING COMMAND TRIANGLE (standalone launcher)
-- Built right here, BEFORE the intro / module loading / admin core, so it can never be blocked by them.
-- It is its own ScreenGui, completely outside the reanimation UI: it works before, during and after reanimating.
-- tap = open the command bar | drag = move (mouse + touch) | hold ~0.7s = hide (tab at the top edge brings it back)
do
	local okL, errL = pcall(function()
		local FX = Util.FX
		Util.UhAdmin = Util.UhAdmin or {
			Tris = {},
			State = {open = false, hover = false, boost = 0, flash = 0, shake = 0, shown = false},
		}
		local U = Util.UhAdmin
		U.Tris = U.Tris or {}
		U.State = U.State or {open = false, hover = false, boost = 0, flash = 0, shake = 0, shown = false}
		local S = U.State
		local SIZE, TRI = 56, 42
		local UIS = UserInputService

		local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		sg.Name = "UhAdminButton"
		sg.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
		sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
		sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		sg.DisplayOrder = 2147483647
		pcall(function() sg.ClipToDeviceSafeArea = false end)
		pcall(function() sg.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None end)
		local parented = false
		if gethiddengui then
			parented = pcall(function() sg.Parent = gethiddengui() end)
		end
		if not parented then
			parented = pcall(function() sg.Parent = CoreGui end)
		end
		if not parented then
			sg.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
		end
		U.ButtonGui = sg

		-- themed objects (colors are refreshed by the driver below)
		local accents, bgs, texts = {}, {}, {}
		local function mk(class, props, parent, theme)
			local o = Instance.new(class)
			for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
			o.Parent = parent
			if theme == "accent" then accents[#accents + 1] = o
			elseif theme == "bg" then bgs[#bgs + 1] = o
			elseif theme == "text" then texts[#texts + 1] = o end
			return o
		end
		local function round(parent, r)
			mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = r or UDim.new(1, 0)}, parent)
		end

		local root = mk("Frame", {
			Name = "UhTriRoot", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SIZE, SIZE), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false,
		}, sg)
		local scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 0}, root)

		-- pulsing aura + faint orbit ring behind the button
		local aura = mk("Frame", {
			Name = "Aura", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SIZE + 14, SIZE + 14), BackgroundTransparency = 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1,
		}, root, "accent")
		round(aura)
		local orbit = mk("Frame", {
			Name = "Orbit", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SIZE + 8, SIZE + 8), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2,
		}, root)
		round(orbit)
		mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.7, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, orbit, "accent")

		-- the button: dark disc with a comet border that keeps circling
		local btn = mk("TextButton", {
			Name = "UhAdminButton", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.12, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Active = true, ZIndex = 3,
		}, root, "bg")
		round(btn)
		local stroke = mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2.4, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, btn, "accent")
		local grad = mk("UIGradient", {
			Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, 0.8),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 0.8), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
			}),
		}, stroke)

		-- three dots orbiting the button
		local dots = {}
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local px = i == 1 and 6 or 4
			local d = mk("Frame", {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(px, px),
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4,
			}, root, "accent")
			round(d)
			dots[i] = d
		end

		-- name tag under the triangle
		local label = mk("TextLabel", {
			Name = "Label", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 12),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 12, Text = "UH ADMIN  \u{2022}  tap = commands  \u{2022}  hold = hide", TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 5,
		}, root, "text")
		local function flashLabel(secs)
			task.spawn(function()
				TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
				task.wait(secs)
				TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.6), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
			end)
		end

		-- fallback glyph (only shown if the 3D triangle engine fails, so something is ALWAYS visible)
		local glyph = mk("TextLabel", {
			Name = "Glyph", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "\u{25B2}", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 28, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Visible = false, ZIndex = 9,
		}, btn)

		-- the 3D triangle (same engine as the hero triangle on the home page)
		local tri
		local okTri, errTri = pcall(function()
			tri = FX.NewTriangle3D(btn, {
				Interactive = false,
				ZIndex = 9,
				LayerAnchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				LayerPos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				LayerSize = UDim2.fromOffset(TRI, TRI),
				IsVisible = function() return S.shown end,
			})
			tri.baseSpin = 1.2
			tri.scaleBase = 1.2
			table.insert(U.Tris, {tri = tri, mult = 1, scale = 1.2})
			U.ButtonTri = tri
		end)
		if not okTri or not tri then
			glyph.Visible = true
			warn("[UhAdmin] 3D triangle failed, using the flat one: " .. tostring(errTri))
		end

		btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() S.hover = true end)
		btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() S.hover = false end)

		-- ── position / drag (mouse + touch) ──
		local function vpSize()
			local v = sg.AbsoluteSize
			if v.X < 50 or v.Y < 50 then v = Util.GetScreenSize() end
			return v
		end
		local function placeAt(cx, cy) -- pixel centre, clamped so the triangle can never be lost off screen
			local v = vpSize()
			local half = SIZE / 2 + 10
			cx = math.clamp(cx, half, math.max(half, v.X - half))
			cy = math.clamp(cy, half, math.max(half, v.Y - half - 14))
			root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(cx / v.X, cy / v.Y)
		end
		local function loadPos()
			local sx, sy = tostring(FX.Cfg.AdminTriPos or ""):match("^([%d%.]+),([%d%.]+)$")
			sx, sy = tonumber(sx), tonumber(sy)
			if sx and sy then
				root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(sx, 0.03, 0.97), math.clamp(sy, 0.03, 0.95))
			else
				root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) -- default: middle of the screen
			end
		end
		U.ResetTriPos = function()
			FX.SetCfg("AdminTriPos", "")
			loadPos()
		end
		loadPos()

		local function isPress(i)
			return i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		end
		local dragInput, dragStart, startCX, startCY
		local moved, swallow, holdToken, suppressUntil = false, false, 0, 0

		btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if not isPress(input) then return end
			local v = vpSize()
			dragInput, dragStart, moved, swallow = input, input.Position, false, false
			startCX = root.Position.X.Scale * v.X
			startCY = root.Position.Y.Scale * v.Y
			holdToken += 1
			local mine = holdToken
			task.delay(0.7, function() -- held still = hide the triangle
				if holdToken == mine and dragInput == input and not moved then
					dragInput, moved, swallow = nil, true, true
					FX.SetCfg("AdminTriHidden", true)
					pcall(Util.Notify, FX.Cfg.AdminTriTab ~= false
						and "Command triangle hidden. Tap the little tab at the top edge (or type showtri) to bring it back."
						or "Command triangle hidden. Type showtri (prefix + showtri) or use the Customization page to bring it back.")
				end
			end)
		end)
		UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if not dragInput then return end
			local same = input == dragInput
				or (dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)
			if not same then return end
			local d = input.Position - dragStart
			if not moved and d.Magnitude > 8 then moved = true end
			if moved then placeAt(startCX + d.X, startCY + d.Y) end
		end)
		UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if not dragInput then return end
			local same = input == dragInput
				or (dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
			if not same then return end
			holdToken += 1
			if moved then
				suppressUntil = os.clock() + 0.3 -- a drag never counts as a tap
				FX.SetCfg("AdminTriPos", string.format("%.4f,%.4f", root.Position.X.Scale, root.Position.Y.Scale))
			end
			dragInput = nil
		end)

		-- tap = open the command bar (the admin core plugs U.OpenBar in once it is ready)
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if swallow or os.clock() < suppressUntil then return end
			if U.OpenBar then
				local ok, e = pcall(U.OpenBar)
				if not ok then warn("[UhAdmin] open bar failed: " .. tostring(e)) end
			else
				S.shake = 1
				if U.CoreError then
					pcall(Util.Notify, "Commands failed to load at '" .. tostring(U.Stage) .. "': " .. tostring(U.CoreError):sub(1, 180))
				else
					pcall(Util.Notify, "Commands are still loading (" .. tostring(U.Stage or "waiting") .. "), tap again in a moment.")
				end
			end
		end)

		-- tiny restore tab at the top edge while the triangle is hidden
		local tab = mk("TextButton", {
			Name = "UhRestoreTab", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false,
			Text = "\u{25BC}", TextSize = 9, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 3,
		}, sg, "accent")
		round(tab, UDim.new(0, 8))
		U.RestoreTab = tab
		tab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			FX.SetCfg("AdminTriHidden", false)
		end)

		-- hide / show (cfg AdminTriHidden: Customization switch + hidetri / showtri / tri commands)
		S.applied = nil
		local function applyHidden(hidden)
			if S.applied == hidden then return end
			local first = S.applied == nil
			S.applied = hidden
			if hidden then
				S.shown = false
				S.hover = false
				if first then
					scale.Scale = 0
					root.Visible = false
					if tri then tri:SetActive(false) end
				else
					TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = 0}):Play()
					task.delay(0.37, function()
						if S.applied == true then
							root.Visible = false
							if tri then tri:SetActive(false) end
						end
					end)
				end
			else
				root.Visible = true
				S.shown = true
				if tri then
					tri:SetActive(true)
					tri:PopIn()
				end
				TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
				pcall(FX.Ring, btn, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 90, 0.6, 2)
				flashLabel(3)
			end
		end

		-- live theme (follows the UI color / accent override)
		local themeT = 0
		local function applyTheme(t)
			if t - themeT < 0.05 then return end
			themeT = t
			local cfg = FX.Cfg
			local a, b, c
			if U.GetTheme then
				local ok, x, y, z = pcall(U.GetTheme, t)
				if ok and x then a, b, c = x, y, z end
			end
			a = a or Util.LoopedHSV(t / 10, 0.8, 1)
			b = b or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			c = c or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			if cfg.UIAccent and cfg.UIAccent ~= "" then a = Util.ParseHex(cfg.UIAccent) or a end
			for _, o in ipairs(accents) do
				if o:IsA("UIStroke") then o.Color = a else o.BackgroundColor3 = a end
			end
			for _, o in ipairs(bgs) do o.BackgroundColor3 = b end
			for _, o in ipairs(texts) do o.TextColor3 = c end
		end

		-- one driver for everything that moves (also drives the command bar's comet border + scan line)
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				local t = os.clock()
				applyHidden(FX.Cfg.AdminTriHidden == true)
				local showTab = S.applied == true and FX.Cfg.AdminTriTab ~= false
				tab.Visible = showTab
				if showTab then
					tab.Position = UDim2.new(root.Position.X.Scale, 0, 0, 0)
					tab.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + math.sin(t * 2.5) * 0.15
				end
				applyTheme(t)

				S.boost = math.max(0, S.boost - dt * 1.6)
				S.flash = math.max(0, S.flash - dt * 2.2)
				S.shake = math.max(0, S.shake - dt * 3)

				-- every registered triangle (button + bar logo) spins faster the more is going on
				local want = 0.9 + (S.hover and 1.1 or 0) + (S.open and 1.6 or 0) + S.boost * 2.5 + S.flash * 3
				for _, e in ipairs(U.Tris) do
					local T = e.tri
					if T and T.active then
						T.baseSpin = T.baseSpin + (want * e.mult - T.baseSpin) * (1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
						T.scaleBase = e.scale * (1 + 0.05 * math.sin(t * 2.3) + 0.12 * S.flash)
					end
				end

				if S.shown then
					local speed = 1.4 + (S.open and 1.6 or 0) + S.boost * 3 + S.flash * 5
					U.orbitA = (U.orbitA or 0) + dt * speed
					local R = (SIZE + 8) / 2
					for i, d in ipairs(dots) do
						local a = U.orbitA + (i - 1) * (math.pi * 2 / 3)
						d.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(a) * R, 0.5, math.sin(a) * R)
					end
					U.btnGrad = ((U.btnGrad or 0) + dt * (90 + S.boost * 220 + (S.open and 120 or 0))) % 360
					grad.Rotation = U.btnGrad
					local pulse = SIZE + 14 + math.sin(t * 2) * 4 + S.flash * 18
					aura.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(pulse, pulse)
					aura.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 - S.flash * 0.35 - (S.open and 0.07 or 0)
					btn.Rotation = S.shake > 0 and math.sin(t * 55) * 7 * S.shake or 0
					if glyph.Visible then glyph.Rotation = (t * 80 * want) % 360 end
				end

				-- command bar: rotating comet border, thicker while typing / running, scan line while open
				local g, bs = U.BarGrad, U.BarStroke
				if g and g.Parent then
					U.barGradA = ((U.barGradA or 0) + dt * (70 + (S.open and 90 or 0) + S.boost * 260)) % 360
					g.Rotation = U.barGradA
					bs.Thickness = 1.4 + S.boost * 1.2 + S.flash * 1.4
				end
				local sc = U.BarScan
				if sc and sc.Parent and S.open then
					U.scanT = ((U.scanT or 0) + dt / 1.5) % 1
					sc.Position = UDim2.new(0, -70 + U.scanT * 320, 1, 0)
				end
			end)
			if not ok and not U.tickWarned then
				U.tickWarned = true
				warn("[UhAdmin] driver error: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end)

		applyHidden(FX.Cfg.AdminTriHidden == true)
	end)
	if not okL then
		warn("[UhAdmin] triangle launcher failed: " .. tostring(errL))
	end
end

 task.spawn(function()
 local okCore, errCore = xpcall(function()

 --[============================================================================[]--

 -- [uh integration] notifications routed through the mod's own notification system
 local Notification = {}
 Notification.Notify = function(t)
	 t = t or {}
	 local desc = tostring(t.Description or "")
	 local title = tostring(t.Title or "")
	 local msg = desc
	 if title ~= "" and title ~= "Nameless Admin" then
		 msg = title .. ": " .. desc
	 end
	 pcall(Util.Notify, msg)
 end
 local Notify = Notification.Notify

 -- [uh admin ext] shared state + helpers for the command triangle, command-bar FX, fling removal, hide/show.
 -- Everything lives in Util.UhAdmin so the admin core doesn't gain extra locals (Lua's 200-local limit).
 Util.UhAdmin = Util.UhAdmin or {
	 Tris = {},
	 State = {open = false, hover = false, boost = 0, flash = 0, shake = 0, shown = false},
 }
 -- extra command names to drop on top of the "anything with 'fling' in its name" rule below
 Util.UhAdmin.BlockedCmds = {punch = true}
 -- theme colours (accent, background, text). Uses the mod's live theme once it exists, a rainbow/black/white fallback before.
 Util.UhAdmin.Theme = function(t)
	 local th = Util.UhAdmin.GetTheme
	 if th then
		 local ok, a, b, c = pcall(th, t)
		 if ok and a then return a, b or Color3.new(0, 0, 0), c or Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
	 end
	 return Util.LoopedHSV(t / 10, 0.8, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
 end
	 Util.UhAdmin.IsBlocked = function(aliases)
		 local allowed = {walkfling = true, wfling = true, unwalkfling = true, unwfling = true}
		 for _, n in ipairs(aliases) do
			 local l = tostring(n):lower()
			 if Util.UhAdmin.BlockedCmds[l] then return true end
			 if l:find("fling", 1, true) and not allowed[l] then return true end
		 end
		 return false
	 end
	 Util.UhAdmin.RegisterTri = function(tri, mult, scale)
	 if tri then
		 table.insert(Util.UhAdmin.Tris, {tri = tri, mult = mult or 1, scale = scale or 1})
	 end
 end
 -- events from the bar / list: open, close, type, run, unknown. Every registered triangle reacts.
 Util.UhAdmin.Fire = function(ev)
	 local U = Util.UhAdmin
	 local S = U.State
	 local function each(f)
		 for _, e in ipairs(U.Tris) do
			 if e.tri and e.tri.active then pcall(f, e.tri) end
		 end
	 end
	 if ev == "open" then
		 S.open = true
		 each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 8 t.pulse = math.max(t.pulse, 0.7) end)
		 pcall(Util.FX.Play, "open", 1.2)
	 elseif ev == "close" then
		 S.open = false
	 elseif ev == "type" then
		 S.boost = math.min(1, S.boost + 0.3)
		 each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 2.2 end)
	 elseif ev == "run" then
		 S.flash = 1
		 each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 16 t.pulse = 1 t.prism = 1 end)
		 pcall(Util.FX.Play, "hit", 1.3)
	 elseif ev == "unknown" then
		 S.shake = 1
		 each(function(t)
			 t.yawVel = t.yawVel - 12
			 if not t.flipT then t.flipT = 0 end
		 end)
		 pcall(Util.FX.Play, "release", 0.8)
	 end
 end

 -- [uh integration] live theme engine for the rebuilt admin UI.
 -- Uses CollectionService tags so cloned template elements (autofill entries,
 -- command list rows, chat log lines) keep following the theme automatically.
 local UhCollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
 local UH_TAG_ACCENT = "UhAdmin_Accent"
 local UH_TAG_BG     = "UhAdmin_BG"
 local UH_TAG_TEXT   = "UhAdmin_Text"
 local function uhTag(obj, kind)
	 local tagName = (kind == "accent" and UH_TAG_ACCENT) or (kind == "bg" and UH_TAG_BG) or UH_TAG_TEXT
	 UhCollectionService:AddTag(obj, tagName)
 end
 do
	 local uhThemeLast = 0
	 game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		 local now = os.clock()
		 if now - uhThemeLast < 0.1 then return end
		 uhThemeLast = now
		 local cfg = Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg
		 local accent, bg, textCol = Util.UhAdmin.Theme(now)
		 if cfg and cfg.UIAccent and cfg.UIAccent ~= "" then
			 accent = Util.ParseHex(cfg.UIAccent) or accent
		 end
		 for _, o in ipairs(UhCollectionService:GetTagged(UH_TAG_ACCENT)) do
			 if o:IsA("UIStroke") then
				 o.Color = accent
			 elseif o:IsA("GuiObject") then
				 o.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			 end
		 end
		 for _, o in ipairs(UhCollectionService:GetTagged(UH_TAG_BG)) do
			 if o:IsA("GuiObject") then
				 o.BackgroundColor3 = bg
			 end
		 end
		 for _, o in ipairs(UhCollectionService:GetTagged(UH_TAG_TEXT)) do
			 if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then
				 o.TextColor3 = textCol
			 end
		 end
	 end)
 end

 -- [uh integration] programmatic rebuild of the Nameless Admin UI in the Uh theme.
 -- Keeps the exact instance hierarchy the command logic expects
 -- (CmdBar.CenterBar.Input, CmdBar.Autofill.Cmd, ChatLogs.Container.Logs, ...)
 -- so every original gui.* function works untouched, minus the remote UI model.
 local function uhNew(class, props, parent)
	 local o = Instance.new(class)
	 for k, v in pairs(props) do
		 o[k] = v
	 end
	 o.Parent = parent
	 return o
 end

 --[[ COMMAND FUNCTIONS ]]--
 commandcount = 0
 cmd = {}
 cmd._lastError = nil
 cmd.add = function(...)
	local vars = {...}
	local aliases, info, func = vars[1], vars[2], vars[3]
	if type(aliases) ~= "table" or type(func) ~= "function" then return false end
	if Util.UhAdmin.IsBlocked(aliases) then return false end
	local registration = {func, info or {}}
	local primary = aliases[1]
	if type(primary) ~= "string" or primary == "" then return false end
	Commands[primary:lower()] = registration
	for i = 2, #aliases do
		local alias = aliases[i]
		if type(alias) == "string" and alias ~= "" then Aliases[alias:lower()] = registration end
	end
	commandcount = commandcount + 1
	return true
 end

 cmd.run = function(args)
	cmd._lastError = nil
	if type(args) ~= "table" then cmd._lastError = "Invalid command arguments"; return false, cmd._lastError end
	local caller = type(args[1]) == "string" and args[1]:lower() or nil
	if not caller or caller == "" then cmd._lastError = "No command specified"; return false, cmd._lastError end
	local registration = Commands[caller] or Aliases[caller]
	if not registration then cmd._lastError = "Unknown command: " .. tostring(args[1]); return false, cmd._lastError end
	local arguments = {}
	for i = 2, #args do arguments[#arguments + 1] = args[i] end
	local success, err = _native_pcall(function() registration[1](table.unpack(arguments)) end)
	if not success then cmd._lastError = tostring(err); return false, cmd._lastError end
	return true
 end

 local wait = function(int)
	 if not int then int = 0 end
	 local t = tick()
	 repeat
		 RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(0)
	 until (tick() - t) >= int
	 return (tick() - t), t
 end

 -- [[ FUNCTION TO GET A PLAYER ]] --
 local getPlr = function(Name)
	if type(Name) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local query = Name:lower():gsub("%s", "")
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	if query == "random" then if #players == 0 then return nil end; return players[math.random(1, #players)] end
	if query == "" then return nil end
	local prefixMatch, containsMatch
	for _, x in ipairs(players) do
		local user = x.Name:lower()
		local display = x.DisplayName:lower():gsub("%s", "")
		if user == query or display == query then return x end
		if not prefixMatch and (user:sub(1, #query) == query or display:sub(1, #query) == query) then prefixMatch = x end
		if not containsMatch and user:find(query, 1, true) then containsMatch = x end
	end
	return prefixMatch or containsMatch
end

function sFLY(vfly, requestedSpeed)
	speedofthefly = math.clamp(tonumber(requestedSpeed) or tonumber(speedofthefly) or 10, 1, 200)
	speedofthevfly = math.clamp(tonumber(requestedSpeed) or tonumber(speedofthevfly) or 10, 1, 200)
	pcall(unvfly)

	local player = cmdlp or Players.LocalPlayer
	if not player then return false end

	local keyboardControl = {F = 0, B = 0, L = 0, R = 0, Q = 0, E = 0}
	local jumpUntil = 0
	local activeSpeed = tonumber(vfly and speedofthevfly or speedofthefly) or 10

	_G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_BEGAN = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if gp then return end
		local k = input.KeyCode
		if k == Enum.KeyCode.W then keyboardControl.F = 1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.S then keyboardControl.B = -1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.A then keyboardControl.L = -1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.D then keyboardControl.R = 1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Y then keyboardControl.Q = 1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.T then keyboardControl.E = -1
		end
	end)

	_G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_ENDED = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		local k = input.KeyCode
		if k == Enum.KeyCode.W then keyboardControl.F = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.S then keyboardControl.B = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.A then keyboardControl.L = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.D then keyboardControl.R = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Y then keyboardControl.Q = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.T then keyboardControl.E = 0
		end
	end)

	local function getChar()
		local char = player.Character
		return char, char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end

	local function apply(root, hum)
		local bg = root:FindFirstChild("UHAdminFlyGyro") or Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		bg.Name = "UHAdminFlyGyro"
		bg.P = 100000
		bg.D = 1000
		bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
		bg.Parent = root

		local bv = root:FindFirstChild("UHAdminFlyVelocity") or Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "UHAdminFlyVelocity"
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
		bv.P = 10000
		bv.Parent = root

		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local cf = camera and camera.CFrame or root.CFrame

		local move = Vector3.zero
		move = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
		local right = Vector3.new(cf.RightVector.X, 0, cf.RightVector.Z)
		if move.Magnitude > 0.001 then move = move.Unit else move = Vector3.new(0,0,-1) end
		if right.Magnitude > 0.001 then right = right.Unit else right = Vector3.new(1,0,0) end
		move = move * (keyboardControl.F + keyboardControl.B)
			+ right * (keyboardControl.R + keyboardControl.L)
			+ Vector3.new(0, keyboardControl.Q + keyboardControl.E, 0)

		if move.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			bv.Velocity = move.Unit * activeSpeed
		else
			bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		end

		local flatLook = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
		if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			flatLook = flatLook.Unit
		else
			flatLook = Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
		end
		bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + flatLook, Vector3.yAxis)

		hum.AutoRotate = false
		if not vfly then
			hum.PlatformStand = true
		else
			hum.PlatformStand = false
		end
	end

	FLYING = true
	_G.__UH_FLY_MODE = "standard"

	_G.__UH_FLY_STEP = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not FLYING then return end
		local char, hum, root = getChar()
		if char and hum and root and hum.Health > 0 then
			apply(root, hum)
		end
	end)

	local _, hum, root = getChar()
	if hum then hum.AutoRotate = false end
	if root then apply(root, hum) end

	return true
end

function unvfly()
	FLYING=false
	if _G.__UH_FLY_MODE == "standard" then _G.__UH_FLY_MODE = nil end
	pcall(function() if _G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_BEGAN then _G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_BEGAN:Disconnect() end end); pcall(function() if _G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_ENDED then _G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_ENDED:Disconnect() end end); pcall(function() if _G.__UH_FLY_JUMP then _G.__UH_FLY_JUMP:Disconnect() end end); pcall(function() if _G.__UH_FLY_STEP then _G.__UH_FLY_STEP:Disconnect() end end)
	_G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_BEGAN,_G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_ENDED,_G.__UH_FLY_JUMP,_G.__UH_FLY_STEP=nil,nil,nil,nil
	local char=cmdlp and cmdlp.Character; local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if hum then hum.PlatformStand=false end
	local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if root then for _,n in ipairs({"UHAdminFlyGyro","UHAdminFlyVelocity","VelocityHandler","GyroHandler"}) do local obj=root:FindFirstChild(n); if obj then obj:Destroy() end end end
end

 -- [[ LIB FUNCTIONS ]] --
 lib.lock = function(instance, par)
	 locks[instance] = true
	 instance.Parent = par or instance.Parent
	 instance.Name = "RightGrip"
 end
 lock = lib.lock
