				v:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
	if viewing ~= nil and player == viewing then
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		viewing = nil
		if viewDied then
			viewDied:Disconnect()
			viewChanged:Disconnect()
		end
		notify('Spectate','View turned off (player left)')
	end
	eventEditor.FireEvent("OnLeave", player.Name)
end)

		end
	end)
end

-- [v23] 40 second cinematic intro. It ALWAYS plays Dubmood - Change (Radio Edit) and runs on its own thread, so the
-- UI keeps building / module loading keeps going underneath it and the intro has a SKIP button that opens the UI.
Util.IntroTrackFile = "dm_change.ft2.mp3"
Util.RunIntro = function(preview)
	if Util.IntroRunning then return end
	Util.IntroRunning = true
	Util.IntroMusicReady = false
	Util.FX.IntroActive = true -- the window boot animation waits for this, so it unfolds right when the intro ends
	task.spawn(function() -- the song loads in parallel; the cinematic clock starts on its first note
		pcall(function()
			UISound.Music.Volume = 0
			local idx = nil
			for i, entry in ipairs(MusicPlayer.Database) do
				if type(entry[1]) == "string" and entry[1]:find(Util.IntroTrackFile, 1, true) then
					idx = i
					break
				end
			end
			if not idx then -- custom Muzik folder replaced the built-in list: put the intro song back at the front
				table.insert(MusicPlayer.Database, 1, {"UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. Util.IntroTrackFile, "Dubmood - Change (Radio Edit)"})
				idx = 1
			end
			MusicPlayer.PlayMusic(idx)
			local waited = os.clock()
			repeat RunService.RenderStepped:Wait() until UISound.Music.IsLoaded or os.clock() - waited > 3
			UISound.Music:Stop()
			task.wait()
			UISound.Music.TimePosition = 0
			UISound.Music:Play()
			UISound.Music.Volume = 1
		end)
		Util.IntroMusicReady = true
	end)
	local okAll, errAll = pcall(Util.FX.Intro, UIMainFrame, UISound.Music, Util.FX.MarqueeText(""), {
		Preview = preview,
		Ready = function() return Util.IntroMusicReady end,
		ClickSnd = UISound.Click, -- [v30] lets the intro play its little tick sounds
	})
	if not okAll then
		warn("[Uhhhhhh] intro failed (UI is unaffected): " .. tostring(errAll))
	end
	Util.FX.IntroActive = false
	if SaveData.MuteUIMusic then
		TweenService:Create(UISound.Music, TweenInfo.new(3, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			Volume = 0
		}):Play()
	else
		UISound.Music.Volume = 1
	end
	Util.IntroRunning = false
end

if SaveData.SkipIntro then
	MusicPlayer.PlayMusic()
	if SaveData.MuteUIMusic then
		UISound.Music.Volume = 0
	end
else
	task.spawn(Util.RunIntro, false)
end

local StylizedObjs = {}
local function Stylize(obj, options)
	options = options or {}
	local Cor = Util.Instance("UICorner", obj)
	Cor.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, Util.FX.Cfg.UIRound)
	local Out = Util.Instance("UIStroke", obj)
	Out.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	Out.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Out.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
	Out.Thickness = Util.FX.Cfg.UIBorder
	Out.Transparency = 0
	Out.Enabled = true
	obj.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local Glos = {}
	if options.Glow == true then
		local GloF = Util.Instance("Frame", UIMainFrame)
		Util.LinkDestroyI2I(obj, GloF)
		GloF.Interactable = false
		GloF.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		local function update()
			GloF.AnchorPoint = obj.AnchorPoint
			GloF.Position = obj.Position - Util.Vector2ToUDim2Offset((obj.AnchorPoint * 2 - Vector2.one) * 5)
			GloF.Size = obj.Size - UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
			GloF.Visible = obj.Visible
			GloF.ZIndex = obj.ZIndex - 2
		end
		update()
		obj.Changed:Connect(update)
		local tex = Util.GetCDNAsset("lightinursoul.graphic.png")
		for x=0, 2 do
			for y=0, 2 do
				local Glo = Util.Instance("ImageLabel", GloF)
				Glo.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1 - math.min(x, 1), 1 - math.min(y, 1))
				Glo.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.max(x - 1, 0), math.max(y - 1, 0))
				Glo.Size = UDim2.new(1 - math.abs(x - 1), x == 1 and 0 or 32, 1 - math.abs(y - 1), y == 1 and 0 or 32)
				Glo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				Glo.Image = tex
				Glo.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(math.min(x, 1) * 256, math.min(y, 1) * 256)
				Glo.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(x == 1 and 0 or 256, y == 1 and 0 or 256)
				table.insert(Glos, Glo)
			end
		end
	end
	table.insert(StylizedObjs, {
		obj = obj,
		Cor = Cor,
		Out = Out,
		Glos = Glos,
		options = options,
	})
end
local ForceUIColor = nil
local ForceUIBGColor = nil
local function GetUIColor(t)
	if ForceUIColor then
		local si = math.sin(math.pi * 2 * t / 10)
		local h, s, v = ForceUIColor:ToHSV()
		if s < 0.2 then
			v *= 0.8 + si * 0.2
		else
			h += si * 0.01
		end
		return Util.LoopedHSV(h, s, v)
	end
	return Util.LoopedHSV(t / 10, 0.8, 1)
end
local function GetUIBGColor(t)
	if ForceUIBGColor then
		local si = math.sin(math.pi * 2 * t / 10)
		local h, s, v = ForceUIBGColor:ToHSV()
		if s < 0.2 then
			if v > 0.5 then
				v *= 0.95 + si * 0.05
			else
				v *= 1.05 + si * 0.05
			end
		else
			h += si * 0.01
		end
		return Util.LoopedHSV(h, s, v)
	end
	return Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
end
local UITextColor = Util.Instance("Color3Value")
UITextColor.Value = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
if Util.UhAdmin then Util.UhAdmin.GetTheme = function(t) return GetUIColor(t), GetUIBGColor(t), UITextColor.Value end end
local function RegisterTextLabel(obj)
	if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
		obj.TextColor3 = UITextColor.Value
		Util.LinkDestroyI2C(obj, UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(val)
			obj.TextColor3 = val
		end))
	end
	if obj:IsA("TextBox") then
		local h, s, v = UITextColor.Value:ToHSV()
		obj.TextColor3 = UITextColor.Value
		obj.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, 0.5 + (v - 0.5) * 0.4)
		Util.LinkDestroyI2C(obj, UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(val)
			h, s, v = val:ToHSV()
			obj.TextColor3 = val
			obj.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, 0.5 + (v - 0.5) * 0.4)
		end))
	end
end
local function UpdateGrads(t)
	local CFG = Util.FX.Cfg
	local c = Util.Color.Resolve(t, GetUIColor(t)) -- [v24] dynamic colour system (modes, harmony, picker)
	local bgc = GetUIBGColor(t)
	local h, s, v = bgc:ToHSV()
	local bgcd = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v * 0.9)
	local h2, s2, v2 = c:ToHSV()
	local glc = c
	if v > v2 then
		glc = bgc
	end
	for _,grad in StylizedObjs do
		local obj, Out, Glos, options = grad.obj, grad.Out, grad.Glos, grad.options
		Out.Color = c
		if grad.thick ~= CFG.UIBorder then
			grad.thick = CFG.UIBorder
			Out.Thickness = CFG.UIBorder
		end
		if grad.Cor and grad.round ~= CFG.UIRound then
			grad.round = CFG.UIRound
			grad.Cor.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, CFG.UIRound)
		end
		if options.BgTr and grad.btr ~= CFG.UIBgTr then
			grad.btr = CFG.UIBgTr
			obj.BackgroundTransparency = CFG.UIBgTr
		end
		if options.Depthed then
			obj.BackgroundColor3 = bgcd
		else
			obj.BackgroundColor3 = bgc
		end
		for _,v in Glos do
			v.ImageColor3 = glc
			v.Visible = CFG.UIGlow
		end
	end
end

		{Fore = Color3.fromHex("75284B"), Back = Color3.fromHex("F7ABE8"), Text = Color3.fromHex("75284B")},
		-- Cherry Blossom Inverted
		{Fore = Color3.fromHex("F7ABE8"), Back = Color3.fromHex("75284B"), Text = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)},
		-- Tommorow Night 80s
		{Fore = Color3.fromHex("272727"), Back = Color3.fromHex("2D2D2D"), Text = Color3.fromHex("BEBEBE"), SndClick = "rbxassetid://86097124503088"},
	}
	local theme = {nil, nil, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), "rbxassetid://118806752369227"}
	local function processtable(t)
		if typeof(t.Fore) == "Color3" then
			theme[1] = t.Fore
		end
		if typeof(t.Back) == "Color3" then
			theme[2] = t.Back
		end
		if typeof(t.Text) == "Color3" then
			theme[3] = t.Text
		end
		if typeof(t.Fore) == "string" then
			theme[1] = Color3.fromHex(t.Fore)
		end
		if typeof(t.Back) == "string" then
			theme[2] = Color3.fromHex(t.Back)
		end
		if typeof(t.Text) == "string" then
			theme[3] = Color3.fromHex(t.Text)
		end
		if typeof(t.Text) == "string" then
			theme[3] = Color3.fromHex(t.Text)
		end
		if typeof(t.SndClick) == "string" then
			theme[4] = t.SndClick
		end
	end
	if index == #UIThemes + 1 then
		if type(_G.UhhhhhhTheme) == "table" and getmetatable(_G.UhhhhhhTheme) == nil then
			processtable(_G.UhhhhhhTheme)
			SaveData.UIThemeUserDefined = {
				Fore = theme[1] and theme[1]:ToHex(),
				Back = theme[2] and theme[2]:ToHex(),
				Text = theme[3] and theme[3]:ToHex() or "FFFFFF",
				SndClick = theme[4],
			}
		elseif type(SaveData.UIThemeUserDefined) == "table" then
			processtable(SaveData.UIThemeUserDefined)
		end
	elseif UIThemes[index] then
		processtable(UIThemes[index])
	end
	if theme then
		ForceUIColor = theme[1]
		ForceUIBGColor = theme[2]
		UITextColor.Value = theme[3]
		UISound.Click.SoundId = theme[4]
	end
end
SaveData.UITheme = SaveData.UITheme or 1
SetUITheme(SaveData.UITheme)

local _funcrefreshes = {}
local function AddToRenderStep(func, linkto)
	table.insert(_funcrefreshes, func)
	if linkto then
		linkto.Destroying:Connect(function()
			local i = table.find(_funcrefreshes, func)
			if i then
				table.remove(_funcrefreshes, i)
			end
		end)
	end
	return func
end
local _totalrendertime = 0
RunService:BindToRenderStep("Uhhhhhh_Render" .. Util.RandomString(), Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value - 69, function(dt)
	_totalrendertime += dt
	UpdateGrads(_totalrendertime)
	WindowContent.Visible = UIMainWindow.Size.Y.Offset > 35
	for _,func in _funcrefreshes do
		local s, e = pcall(func, _totalrendertime, dt)
		if not s then warn(e) end
	end
end)

		local CFG = Util.FX.Cfg
		if CFG.NotifMode == 4 then return end -- silent

			if prog == nil or prog >= 1 then
				pcall(function()
					StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
						Title = CFG.NotifTitle ~= "" and CFG.NotifTitle or "Nooby's Uh Modded Reanimation",
						Text = tostring(text),
						Duration = CFG.NotifDuration + 1,
					})
				end)
			end
			return
		end
		uinotif.Text, uinotif.Progress = text, prog or 1
		uinotif.LastNotif = _totalrendertime
		if CFG.NotifSound and (prog == nil or prog >= 1) then
			pcall(function()
				UISound.Click:Play()
			end)
		end
	end
	local UINotifyFrame = Instance.new("Frame", UIMainFrame)

	NotifyText.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	NotifyText.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	NotifyText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)

	NotifyText.ClipsDescendants = true
	NotifyText.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	NotifyText.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	NotifyText.TextSize = 18
	NotifyText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	NotifyText.Text = ""
	RegisterTextLabel(NotifyText)
	AddToRenderStep(function(t, dt)
		local CFG = Util.FX.Cfg
		if CFG.NotifMode >= 3 then
			UINotifyFrame.Visible = false
			return
		end
		if t - uinotif.LastNotif < CFG.NotifDuration or uinotif.Progress < 1 then
			uinotif.Animation = math.max(0, uinotif.Animation - dt * 2 * CFG.NotifSpeed)
		else
			uinotif.Animation = math.min(1, uinotif.Animation + dt * 2 * CFG.NotifSpeed)
		end
		if uinotif.Animation < 1 then
			UINotifyFrame.Visible = true
			local nh = math.max(30, CFG.NotifSize + 12)
			UINotifyFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, CFG.NotifWidth, 0, nh)
			NotifyText.TextSize = CFG.NotifSize
			NotifyText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, nh)
			local slide = math.pow(uinotif.Animation, 3)
			local pos = CFG.NotifPos
			if pos == 2 then -- above the window
				UINotifyFrame.Position = UIMainWindow.Position + UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -UIMainWindow.Size.Y.Offset / 2 - 10 - nh + slide * (nh + 10))
			elseif pos == 3 then -- top of the screen
				UINotifyFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 10 - slide * (nh + 20))
			elseif pos == 4 then -- bottom of the screen
				UINotifyFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -(nh + 10) + slide * (nh + 20))
			else -- below the window (default)
				UINotifyFrame.Position = UIMainWindow.Position + UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, UIMainWindow.Size.Y.Offset / 2 + 10 + slide * -(nh + 10))
			end
			if uinotif.Progress >= 1 then
				Progress.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(t - uinotif.LastNotif, 0.5) * 2 * 0.3 + 0.7
			else
				Progress.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			end
			local c = GetUIColor(t)
			if CFG.NotifColor ~= "" then
				c = Util.ParseHex(CFG.NotifColor) or c
			end
			local s = math.sin(t * 3) * 0.5 + 0.5
			if uinotif.Progress > 0 then
				uinotif.ProgressSm = uinotif.Progress + (uinotif.ProgressSm - uinotif.Progress) * math.exp(-16 * dt)
				ProgressTop.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				ProgressBot.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				ProgressTop.Size = UDim2.new(uinotif.ProgressSm, 0, 0, 4)
				ProgressBot.Size = UDim2.new(uinotif.ProgressSm, 0, 0, 4)
			else
				uinotif.ProgressSm = 1
				ProgressTop.BackgroundTransparency = s
				ProgressBot.BackgroundTransparency = s
				ProgressTop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4)
				ProgressBot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4)
			end
			ProgressTop.BackgroundColor3 = c
			ProgressBot.BackgroundColor3 = c
			if not CFG.NotifProgress then
				Progress.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				ProgressTop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				ProgressBot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			end
			NotifyText.Text = uinotif.Text
		else
			UINotifyFrame.Visible = false
		end
	end, UINotifyFrame)
end

local CracktroFrame = Util.Instance("Frame", WindowContent)
CracktroFrame.Active = true
CracktroFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
CracktroFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
CracktroFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 205)
CracktroFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
CracktroFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
CracktroFrame.BorderSizePixel = 1
CracktroFrame.BorderColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
CracktroFrame.ZIndex = 10
CracktroFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
AddToRenderStep(function(t)
	CracktroFrame.BorderColor3 = GetUIColor(t)
	CracktroFrame.BackgroundColor3 = GetUIBGColor(t)
	CracktroFrame.BackgroundTransparency = Util.FX.Cfg.UIBgTr
end, CracktroFrame)

do -- homepage
	local TriforceClip = Util.Instance("CanvasGroup", CracktroFrame)
	TriforceClip.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	TriforceClip.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	TriforceClip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	TriforceClip.ZIndex = 0

	local Glowy = Util.Instance("ImageLabel", CracktroFrame)
	Glowy.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	Glowy.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	Glowy.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 260)
	Glowy.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Glowy.Image = Util.GetCDNAsset("lightinursoul.graphic.png")
	Glowy.ImageColor3 = UITextColor.Value
	Glowy.ImageTransparency = 0.7
	Glowy.ZIndex = -2

	local Triforce = Util.MakeTriforce(3, Color3.new(1, 0.7, 0), 0)
	Triforce.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	Triforce.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	Triforce.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 160)
	Triforce.Parent = TriforceClip
	TriforceClip.Visible = false -- replaced by the interactive 3D hero triangle
	pcall(Util.FX.MountHero, CracktroFrame, UITextColor, UISound.Music)

	local particles = {}
	local ps = 128
	local psc = Color3.new(1, 0.9, 0)
	for i=1, ps do
		local r = (i / ps) * 2 * math.pi
		local p = Util.Instance("Frame", CracktroFrame)
		p.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		p.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)
		p.BackgroundColor3 = psc
		p.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		p.BorderSizePixel = 0
		p.ZIndex = -1
		p.Visible = false
		table.insert(particles, {
			p, Vector2.new(math.sin(r), math.cos(r)) * 8,
			Vector2.new(math.random(-128, 128), math.random(-128, 128)),
			math.random() * 2 - 1, false, -1
		})
	end

	local trivel = 360
	local oldpbl = 0

	local text = Util.MakeText(CracktroFrameText)
	text.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	text.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -25)
	text.ZIndex = 3
	text.Parent = CracktroFrame
	local text0 = Util.MakeText("Discord: discord.gg/NASNUKRBVM")
	text0.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	text0.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -17)
	text0.ZIndex = 3
	text0.Parent = CracktroFrame
	local text1 = Util.MakeText("Made by STEVETHEREALONE, modded by Nooby :" .. (math.random() < 0.333 and "3" or (math.random() < 0.5 and "D" or "P")))
	text1.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	text1.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -17)
	text1.ZIndex = 3
	text1.Parent = CracktroFrame
	local text2 = Util.MakeText("Tap outside to start!")
	text2.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	text2.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -17)
	text2.ZIndex = 3
	text2.Parent = CracktroFrame
	Util.SetTextColor(text, UITextColor.Value, 0)
	Util.SetTextColor(text0, UITextColor.Value, 0)
	Util.SetTextColor(text1, UITextColor.Value, 0)
	Util.SetTextColor(text2, UITextColor.Value, 0)
	local quotes = {
		"\"EVERY CLIENT ORBITS A SERVER...\"",
		Player.Name .. ", how is your " .. os.date("%A") .. "?",
		"A great " .. os.date("%A") .. " today, eh?",
		"Hello, " .. Player.Name .. ".",
		"What makes you play at " .. os.date("%I %p") .. "?",
		"You are going to love Nooby's Uh Modded Reanimation, I just know it.",
		"This script is very \"verbose\".",
		"Written mostly on a mobile phone.",
		"I am pretty new in this community! :D",
		"\"Dreams come true!\"",
		"Idea originated from a dream.",
		"If you love this program, join my Discord!",
		"boredgal was here..",
		"gugu gaga ultimate",
		"Kleiner me to start!",
		"Spongebob squarepants",
		"I'm a Razor 1911 'fan' btw!",
	}
	local text3 = nil
	local text3mustchange = false
	local function changequote()
		if text3 then text3:Destroy() end
		text3 = Util.MakeText(quotes[math.random(1, #quotes)])
		text3.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
		text3.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -17)
		text3.ZIndex = 3
		text3.Parent = CracktroFrame
		Util.SetTextColor(text3, UITextColor.Value, 0)
	end
	changequote()
	UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(val)
		Util.SetTextColor(text, val, 0)
		Util.SetTextColor(text0, val, 0)
		Util.SetTextColor(text1, val, 0)
		Util.SetTextColor(text2, val, 0)
		Util.SetTextColor(text3, val, 0)
	end)

	local PositionProcessor = {
		function(i, v, dt, pbl, spike)
			local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
			local d = pos.Magnitude
			if d > 0 then
				local r = math.atan2(pos.X / d, pos.Y / d)
				local a = math.pi * 0.375
				local out = Vector2.new(math.sin(r + a), math.cos(r + a))
				local tp = out * (40 + pbl / 12)
				local tv = (tp - pos) * 2
				vel = tv:Lerp(vel, math.exp(-2 * dt))
				if math.random() < 0.01 then
					vel += Vector2.new(math.random(-64, 64), math.random(-64, 64))
				end
				if spike > 64 then
					vel += out * 64 * math.random()
				end
				pos += vel * dt
			else
				pos += Vector2.new(0, 10)
			end
			v[2], v[3] = pos, vel
			return Vector3.new(zind * pos.Magnitude / 6, pos.Y, pos.X)
		end,
		function(i, v, dt, pbl, spike)
			local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
			local a = i / ps
			local s = (a * 6) % 1
			local r = (a + s / 8) * 2 * math.pi + os.clock() * 2 + zind * math.pi * 0.125 * (pbl / 200) * (1 - s)
			pos = Vector2.new(math.sin(r), math.cos(r)) * s * (100 + pbl / 15)
			v[2], v[3] = pos, Vector2.zero
			return Vector3.new(0, pos.Y, pos.X)
		end,
		function(i, v, dt, pbl, spike)
			local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
			local a = i / ps
			local b = 1 / 3
			local c = math.sqrt(3) / 2
			local d = {
				{Vector2.new(0, b + c), Vector2.new(-0.5, b)},
				{Vector2.new(-0.5, b), Vector2.new(-1, b - c)},
				{Vector2.new(-1, b - c), Vector2.new(0, b - c)},
				{Vector2.new(0, b - c), Vector2.new(1, b - c)},
				{Vector2.new(1, b - c), Vector2.new(0.5, b)},
				{Vector2.new(0.5, b), Vector2.new(0, b - c)},
				{Vector2.new(0, b - c), Vector2.new(-0.5, b)},
				{Vector2.new(-0.5, b), Vector2.new(0.5, b)},
				{Vector2.new(0.5, b), Vector2.new(0, b + c)},
			}
			local t = a * #d
			local i = math.floor(t) + 1
			local u = t % 1
			if i > #d then
				i = #d
				u = 1
			end
			pos = d[i][1]:Lerp(d[i][2], u) * 150
			local r = os.clock() * 2
			pos = Vector2.new(
				pos.X * math.cos(r) - pos.Y * math.sin(r),
				pos.X * math.sin(r) + pos.Y * math.cos(r)
			)
			v[2], v[3] = pos, Vector2.zero
			return Vector3.new(0, pos.Y, pos.X)
		end,
	}
	local currentprocessor = 1

	AddToRenderStep(function(t, dt)
		if Util.IsGuiVisible(CracktroFrame) then
			local pp = PositionProcessor[currentprocessor]
			local CracktroFrameAbsoluteSize = CracktroFrame.AbsoluteSize
			Glowy.ImageColor3 = UITextColor.Value
			Glowy.ImageTransparency = 0.75 + math.sin(((os.clock() / 10) % 2) * math.pi) * 0.05
			local pbl = UISound.Music.PlaybackLoudness
			local spike = math.max(0, (pbl - oldpbl) - 16)
			oldpbl = pbl
			local trivelt = pbl * 2 * dt
			trivel = trivelt + (trivel - trivelt) * math.exp(-8 * dt)
			Triforce.Rotation = (Triforce.Rotation + trivel) % 360
			local ring = CFrame.Angles(
				0,
				math.cos(((t / 5) % 2) * math.pi) * math.pi * 0.5,
				(1 - math.cos(((t / 7) % 2) * math.pi)) * math.pi * 0.5
			)
			local fov = 220
			for i,v in particles do
				local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
				local sp = ring:VectorToWorldSpace(pp(i, v, dt, pbl, spike))
				local z = sp.Z
				local sc = fov / (z + fov)
				sp = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) * sc
				local nvis, nzind = lvis, lzind
				if z > 1 - fov then
					inst.Position = Util.Vector2ToUDim2Offset(sp + CracktroFrameAbsoluteSize / 2)
					inst.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sc * 2.5, sc * 2.5)
					--inst.BackgroundColor3 = psc:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), math.clamp(z / (fov * 2), 0, 1))
					nvis = true
					if z > 0 then
						nzind = -1
					else
						nzind = 1
					end
				else
					nvis = false
				end
				if lvis ~= nvis then
					inst.Visible = nvis
					v[5] = nvis
				end
				if lzind ~= nzind then
					inst.ZIndex = nzind
					v[6] = nzind
				end
			end
			local textsel = t % 9
			if IsUhhhhhhFullyLoaded then
				textsel = t % 12
			end
			textsel //= 3
			if text3mustchange ~= (textsel == 3) then
				text3mustchange = (textsel == 3)
				if text3mustchange then changequote() end
			end
			if textsel == 0 then
				text0.Visible = true
				text1.Visible = false
				text2.Visible = false
				text3.Visible = false
			elseif textsel == 1 then
				text0.Visible = false
				text1.Visible = true
				text2.Visible = false
				text3.Visible = false
			elseif textsel == 2 then
				text0.Visible = false
				text1.Visible = false
				text2.Visible = false
				text3.Visible = true
			else
				text0.Visible = false
				text1.Visible = false
				text2.Visible = true
				text3.Visible = false
			end
		else
			currentprocessor = math.random(1, #PositionProcessor)
		end
	end, CracktroFrame)
end
task.wait()

	UIList.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top

function UI.CreateText(parent, text, size, alignment)
	local margin = 5
	local Container = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
	Container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 65536)
	Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Container.LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren()
	local Text = Util.Instance("TextLabel", Container)
	Text.Position = UDim2.new(0, margin, 0, 0)
	Text.Size = UDim2.new(1, margin * -2, 1, -margin + 1)
	Text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Text.RichText = true
	Text.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	Text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Text.TextTransparency = 0
	Text.TextXAlignment = alignment
	Text.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	Text.TextWrapped = true
	Text.TextSize = size
	RegisterTextLabel(Text)
	local function update()
		local x = parent.AbsoluteSize.X
		local size = TextService:GetTextSize(Text.ContentText, Text.TextSize, Text.Font, Vector2.new(x - margin * 2, math.huge))
		Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, size.Y + margin)
	end
	Text.Text = text
	update()
	Text.Changed:Connect(update)
	return Text
end

function UI.CreateSwitch(parent, text, value)
	local margin = 5
	local switchsize = 50
	local Container = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
	Container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 10)
	Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Container.LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren()

	Button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)

	ButtonText.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)

	ButtonText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	ButtonText.RichText = true
	ButtonText.Font = Enum.Font.Code

	ButtonText.TextTransparency = 0

	ButtonText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	ButtonText.TextWrapped = true
	ButtonText.TextSize = 20
	RegisterTextLabel(ButtonText)
	local function update()
		local x = parent.AbsoluteSize.X
		local size = TextService:GetTextSize(ButtonText.ContentText, ButtonText.TextSize, ButtonText.Font, Vector2.new(x - margin * 3 - switchsize, math.huge))
		Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(35, size.Y))
	end
	ButtonText.Text = text
	update()
	ButtonText.Changed:Connect(update)
	local Switch = Util.Instance("Frame", Container)
	Switch.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	Switch.Position = UDim2.new(1, -margin, 0.5, 0)
	Switch.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 25)

	Switch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

	Util.Instance("UICorner", Switch).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
	Stylize(Switch)
	local SwitchDot = Util.Instance("Frame", Switch)
	SwitchDot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	SwitchDot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	SwitchDot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 19, 0, 19)
	SwitchDot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	SwitchDot.BackgroundColor3 = UITextColor.Value
	SwitchDot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Util.LinkDestroyI2C(SwitchDot, UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(val)
		SwitchDot.BackgroundColor3 = val
	end))
	Util.Instance("UICorner", SwitchDot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2)
	local Lever = Util.Instance("BoolValue")
	Lever.Value = value
	local function updatesw()
		SwitchDot.Visible = Lever.Value
	end
	Lever.Changed:Connect(updatesw)
	updatesw()
	Button.Activated:Connect(function()
		Lever.Value = not Lever.Value
	end)
	return Lever, ButtonText
end
function UI.CreateTextbox(parent, text, placeholder, size)
	local margin = 5
	local Container = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
	Container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 65536)
	Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Container.LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren()
	local Box = Util.Instance("Frame", Container)
	Box.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	Box.Position = UDim2.new(0, margin, 0, margin // 2)
	Box.Size = UDim2.new(1, margin * -2, 1, -margin)
	Box.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	Box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)
	Box.BorderSizePixel = 0
	local BoxText = Util.Instance("TextBox", Box)
	BoxText.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	BoxText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
	BoxText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -margin)
	BoxText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	BoxText.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	BoxText.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	BoxText.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
	BoxText.TextTransparency = 0
	BoxText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	BoxText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	BoxText.TextWrapped = true
	BoxText.TextSize = size
	BoxText.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	RegisterTextLabel(BoxText)
	BoxText.Focused:Connect(function()
		UISound.Click:Play()
	end)
	Stylize(Box, {
		Depthed = true,
	})
	local function update()
		local x = parent.AbsoluteSize.X
		if not BoxText.TextWrapped then
			x = math.huge
		end
		local t = BoxText.Text
		if t:len() == 0 then
			t = BoxText.PlaceholderText
		end
		local size = TextService:GetTextSize(t, BoxText.TextSize, BoxText.Font, Vector2.new(x - margin * 2, math.huge))
		Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, size.Y + margin * 2 + 2)
	end
	BoxText.Text = text
	BoxText.PlaceholderText = placeholder
	update()
	BoxText.Changed:Connect(update)
	return BoxText
end
function UI.CreateSlider(parent, text, value, min, max, step)
	min = min or 1
	max = max or 10
	step = math.abs(step or 0)
	assert(max > min)
	local margin = 5
	local Container = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
	Container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 65)
	Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Container.LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren()
	local Text = Util.Instance("TextLabel", Container)
	Text.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	Text.Position = UDim2.new(0, margin, 0, 0)
	Text.Size = UDim2.new(1, margin * -2, 0, 35)
	Text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Text.RichText = true
	Text.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	Text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Text.TextTransparency = 0
	Text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	Text.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	Text.TextWrapped = true
	Text.TextSize = 20
	Text.Text = text
	RegisterTextLabel(Text)
	local Box = Util.Instance("Frame", Container)
	Box.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	Box.Position = UDim2.new(1, -margin, 0, margin)
	Box.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 35 - margin * 2)
	Box.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	Box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Box.BorderSizePixel = 0
	local BoxText = Util.Instance("TextBox", Box)
	BoxText.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	BoxText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
	BoxText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -margin)
	BoxText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	BoxText.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	BoxText.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	BoxText.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
	BoxText.TextTransparency = 0
	BoxText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	BoxText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	BoxText.TextWrapped = true
	BoxText.TextSize = 15
	BoxText.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	RegisterTextLabel(BoxText)
	BoxText.Focused:Connect(function()
		UISound.Click:Play()
	end)
	Stylize(Box, {
		Depthed = true,
	})
	local SliderC = Util.Instance("TextButton", Container)
	SliderC.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	SliderC.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 40)
	SliderC.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	SliderC.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	SliderC.Text = ""
	SliderC.AutoButtonColor = true
	local SliderR = Util.Instance("Frame", SliderC)
	SliderR.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	SliderR.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	SliderR.Size = UDim2.new(1, margin * -2 - 18, 0, 5)
	SliderR.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	SliderR.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	SliderR.BorderSizePixel = 0
	local SliderB = Util.Instance("Frame", SliderR)
	SliderB.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	SliderB.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
	SliderB.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
	SliderB.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	SliderB.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	SliderB.BorderSizePixel = 0
	SliderB.ZIndex = 2
	Stylize(SliderR, {
		Depthed = true,
	})
	Stylize(SliderB)
	local range = max - min
	if step > 0 then
		if range / step < 20 then
			local i = min + step
			while i < max do
				local snaps = Util.Instance("Frame", SliderR)
				snaps.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
				snaps.Position = UDim2.new((i - min) / range, 0, 0, 1)
				snaps.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 3)
				snaps.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
				snaps.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				snaps.BorderSizePixel = 0
				i += step
			end
		end
	end
	local Select = Util.Instance("NumberValue")
	local function update()
		local str = string.format("%.3f", Select.Value)
		if str:find("%.") then
			while str:sub(-1) == "0" do
				str = str:sub(1, -2)
				if str:sub(-1) == "." then
					str = str:sub(1, -2)
					break
				end
			end
		end
		BoxText.Text = str
		SliderB.Position = UDim2.new(math.clamp((Select.Value - min) / (max - min), 0, 1), 0, 0.5, 0)
		if math.random(4) == 1 then
			if str:find("67") or str:find("6.7") then
				Util.UINotify("SIX SEVENNNN 67 67 67 67 OMG")
			end
		end
	end
	Select.Value = value
	Select.Changed:Connect(update)
	update()
	BoxText.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		Select.Value = tonumber(BoxText.Text) or Select.Value
		update()
	end)
	local function ondrag(x)
		local val = range * math.clamp((x - SliderR.AbsolutePosition.X) / SliderR.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
		if step > 0 then
			val = math.round(val / step) * step
		end
		val += min
		Select.Value = val
	end
	local dragref = nil
	local start = nil
	SliderC.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragref = input
			start = input.Position
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragref then
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and dragref == input) then
				if start then
					local delta = input.Position - start
					if delta.Magnitude > 10 then
						start = nil
						if math.abs(delta.X) < math.abs(delta.Y) then
							dragref = nil
						end
					end
				else
					ondrag(input.Position.X)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if dragref and dragref == input then
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				ondrag(input.Position.X)
				dragref = nil
			end
		end
	end)
	return Select
end
function UI.CreateDropdown(parent, text, array, value)
	value = value and math.clamp(value, 1, #array) or 1
	local margin = 5
	local Container = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
	Container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 10)
	Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Container.LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren()
	local Text = Util.Instance("TextLabel", Container)
	Text.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	Text.Position = UDim2.new(0, margin, 0, 0)
	Text.Size = UDim2.new(1, margin * -2, 1, 0)
	Text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Text.RichText = true
	Text.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	Text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Text.TextTransparency = 0
	Text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	Text.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	Text.TextWrapped = true
	Text.TextSize = 20
	RegisterTextLabel(Text)
	local Dropdown = Util.Instance("TextButton", Container)
	Dropdown.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	Dropdown.Position = UDim2.new(1, -margin, 0.5, 0)
	Dropdown.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -margin)
	Dropdown.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	Dropdown.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Dropdown.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Dropdown.Text = ""
	Dropdown.AutoButtonColor = true
	local DropdownText = Util.Instance("TextLabel", Dropdown)
	DropdownText.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	DropdownText.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	DropdownText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -margin * 2, 1, -margin)
	DropdownText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	DropdownText.RichText = true
	DropdownText.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	DropdownText.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	DropdownText.TextTransparency = 0
	DropdownText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	DropdownText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	DropdownText.TextWrapped = true
	DropdownText.TextSize = 15
	RegisterTextLabel(DropdownText)
	Stylize(Dropdown)
	local function update()
		local x = parent.AbsoluteSize.X
		local size1 = TextService:GetTextSize(Text.ContentText, Text.TextSize, Text.Font, Vector2.new(x - margin * 2, math.huge))
		local size2 = TextService:GetTextSize(DropdownText.ContentText, DropdownText.TextSize, DropdownText.Font, Vector2.new(x * 0.8 - margin * 2, math.huge))
		Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(35, size1.Y, size2.Y + margin * 2))
		Dropdown.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.max(60, size2.X + margin * 2 + 2), 0, math.max(25, size2.Y + margin * 2))
	end
	Text.Text = text
	DropdownText.Text = array[value]
	update()
	Text.Changed:Connect(update)
	DropdownText.Changed:Connect(update)
	local Select = Util.Instance("IntValue")
	Select.Value = value
	Select.Changed:Connect(function()
		DropdownText.Text = array[Select.Value]
	end)
	local Droplist = Util.Instance("ScrollingFrame", UIMainFrame)
	Droplist.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	Droplist.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	Droplist.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	Droplist.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	Droplist.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Droplist.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Droplist.Visible = false
	Droplist.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	Droplist.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	Droplist.ScrollBarThickness = 0
	Droplist.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
	local Padding = Util.Instance("UIPadding", Droplist)
	Padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5)
	Padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 5)
	Padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 0)
	Padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 0)
	local UIList = Util.Instance("UIListLayout", Droplist)
	UIList.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
	UIList.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	UIList.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
	UIList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 0)
	UIList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	Stylize(Droplist, {
		Glow = true
	})
	local items = {}
	local sizex = 60
	local interact = false
	local opened = false
	Util.LinkDestroyI2I(Dropdown, Droplist)
	for i,itemname in array do
		local Item = Util.Instance("TextButton", Droplist)
		Item.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
		Item.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		Item.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		Item.BorderSizePixel = 0
		Item.AutoButtonColor = true
		Item.LayoutOrder = i
		Item.Text = itemname
		Item.TextSize = 15
		Item.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		Item.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		Item.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		Item.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
		Item.TextWrapped = false
		RegisterTextLabel(Item)
		table.insert(items, Item)
		local size = TextService:GetTextSize(itemname, Item.TextSize, Item.Font, Vector2.new(math.huge, math.huge))
		sizex = math.max(sizex, size.X + 12)
		Item.Activated:Connect(function()
			Select.Value = i
			opened = false
			interact = true
		end)
		Item.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				interact = true
				UISound.Click:Play()
			end
		end)
	end
	Dropdown.Activated:Connect(function()
		opened = not opened
		interact = true
	end)
	local conn = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			task.wait()
			if not interact then
				opened = false
			end
			interact = false
		end
	end)
	Util.LinkDestroyI2C(Dropdown, conn)
	local scrollframe = Container:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
	if scrollframe then
		local conn = scrollframe:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()
			opened = false
		end)
	end
	local opentween = 0
	AddToRenderStep(function(t, dt)
		if opened then
			opentween = 1 + (opentween - 1) * math.exp(-32 * dt)
			Droplist.ZIndex = 4
			Droplist.Interactable = true
		else
			opentween *= math.exp(-32 * dt)
			Droplist.ZIndex = 3
			Droplist.Interactable = false
		end
		local ysize = math.round(math.min(90, #items * 20) * opentween)
		if ysize >= 1 then
			Droplist.Position = Util.Vector2ToUDim2Offset((Dropdown.AbsolutePosition + Vector2.new(0, Dropdown.AbsoluteSize.Y)) - UIMainFrame.AbsolutePosition)
			Droplist.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.max(Dropdown.Size.X.Offset, sizex), 0, ysize)
			Droplist.Visible = true
		else
			Droplist.Visible = false
		end
		local i1 = GetUIBGColor(t)
		local i2 = i1:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.1)
		for i,v in items do
			if i == Select.Value then
				v.BackgroundColor3 = i2
			else
				v.BackgroundColor3 = i1
			end
		end
	end, Droplist)
	Util.LinkDestroyI2I(Dropdown, Select)
	return Select, Text
end

function UI.CreateItemListItem(parent)
	local margin = 5
	local Container = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
	Container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
	Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Container.LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren()
	Container.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	local Padding = Util.Instance("UIPadding", Container)
	Padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2)
	Padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 2)
	Padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5)
	Padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 5)
	local ListBox = Util.Instance("TextButton", Container)
	ListBox.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	ListBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	ListBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
	ListBox.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	ListBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
	ListBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
	ListBox.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	ListBox.Text = ""
	Stylize(ListBox)
	Padding = Util.Instance("UIPadding", ListBox)
	Padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5)
	Padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 5)
	Padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 0)
	Padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 0)
	local UIList = Util.Instance("UIListLayout", ListBox)
	UIList.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
	UIList.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	UIList.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
	UIList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 0)
	UIList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	Util.LinkDestroyI2I(ListBox, Container)
	return ListBox
end

Util.FX.Bind({
	UI = UI, UISound = UISound, UIMainWindow = UIMainWindow, WindowContent = WindowContent,
	CracktroFrame = CracktroFrame, UITextColor = UITextColor, GetUIColor = GetUIColor, GetUIBGColor = GetUIBGColor,
	SaveData = SaveData, Time = function() return _totalrendertime end,
	IsLoaded = function() return IsUhhhhhhFullyLoaded end,
})

local MainPage = UI.CreatePage()
MainPage.Interactable = false
CracktroFrame.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if _totalrendertime < 1 then return end -- [v23] no longer waits for the modules
		if Util.FX.TriangleDown or os.clock() - (Util.FX.TriangleLast or 0) < 0.3 then return end -- that press was on the triangle
		CracktroFrame.Interactable = false
		CracktroFrame.Visible = true
		MainPage.Interactable = false
		local tween = TweenService:Create(CracktroFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -362, 0.5, 0),
		})
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Connect(function()
			CracktroFrame.Visible = false
			MainPage.Interactable = true
		end)
	end
end)
Util.EnterMainPage = function() -- [v23] same transition as tapping the home screen (used by the OPEN UI pill)
	if not CracktroFrame.Interactable or not CracktroFrame.Visible then return end
	CracktroFrame.Interactable = false
	MainPage.Interactable = false
	local tween = TweenService:Create(CracktroFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -362, 0.5, 0),
	})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		CracktroFrame.Visible = false
		MainPage.Interactable = true
	end)
end
do -- [v23] OPEN UI NOW pill + live module status (visible only while modules are still loading)
	local pill = Util.Instance("TextButton", UIMainFrame)
	pill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	pill.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -14)
	pill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(380, 34)
	pill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	pill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	pill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	pill.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	pill.TextSize = 13
	pill.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	pill.AutoButtonColor = false
	pill.ZIndex = 5000
	pill.Visible = false
	pill.Text = ""
	Util.Instance("UICorner", pill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 17)
	local pst = Util.Instance("UIStroke", pill)
	pst.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	pst.Thickness = 1
	pst.Transparency = 0.3
	pill.Activated:Connect(function()
		pcall(Util.EnterMainPage)
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while pill.Parent do
			local introOn = Util.FX and Util.FX.IntroActive
			local show = (not IsUhhhhhhFullyLoaded) and not introOn and CracktroFrame.Visible and CracktroFrame.Interactable
			pill.Visible = show and true or false
			if show then
				local ok, st = pcall(Util.GetModuleStatus)
				pill.Text = "OPEN UI NOW  >>  " .. ((ok and st) or "loading modules...")
				pst.Color = GetUIColor(_totalrendertime)
			end
			task.wait(0.15)
		end
	end)
end
do -- [V16] SEARCH EVERYTHING + SAVED SEARCHES (very top of the main page)
	-- V15 only found ON/OFF switches. V16 indexes every control the UI builds (switches, buttons, dropdowns, sliders,
	-- text boxes) plus the Movesets / Dances / Dance Keybinds / Marketplace / My Modules lists and every Script Hub
	-- button, and lets you use them straight from the results:
	--   switch   tap = flip it            button  tap = press it (hold = nothing)
	--   dropdown tap = next, hold = previous option
	--   slider / text box: a box appears in the result, type a value and press enter
	--   moveset  tap = use it, hold = open its settings      dance  tap = play / stop, hold = open its settings
	-- Searches you actually use are saved in SaveData.SearchHistory (tree.ehehetilde) and are listed when the box is focused
	-- and empty: tap = search again, hold = remove it. Risky buttons (reset / delete / kill / hop / run all ...) ask for a
	-- second tap. Result rows are created on demand and reused, and typing is debounced, so it stays light on weak devices.
	local built, buildErr = pcall(function()
		local S = {
			Entries = {},
			Items = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
			Headers = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
			Titles = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
			LastText = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
			Pools = {switch = {}, action = {}, input = {}},
			PageSize = 8,
			Limit = 8,
			MaxShown = 56,
			HistoryMax = 15,
			HistoryShow = 7,
			Risky = {"clear all", "delete", "reset", "kill all", "server hop", "rejoin", "run all", "respawn", "buy module", "redownload", "reload"},
		}
		Util.Search = S
		S.Titles[MainPage] = "Main"

		local function plain(t)
			t = tostring(t == nil and "" or t)
			t = t:gsub("<[^>]*>", "")
			t = t:gsub("&lt;", "<")
			t = t:gsub("&gt;", ">")
			t = t:gsub("&amp;", "&")
			t = t:gsub("%s+", " ")
			t = t:gsub("^ ", "")
			t = t:gsub(" $", "")
			return t
		end
		local function esc(t)
			t = tostring(t == nil and "" or t)
			t = t:gsub("&", "&amp;")
			t = t:gsub("<", "&lt;")
			t = t:gsub(">", "&gt;")
			return t
		end
		local function trim(t)
			t = tostring(t == nil and "" or t)
			t = t:gsub("^%s+", "")
			t = t:gsub("%s+$", "")
			return t
		end
		local function fmt(n)
			if type(n) ~= "number" then return tostring(n) end
			local s = string.format("%.3f", n)
			s = s:gsub("0+$", "")
			s = s:gsub("%.$", "")
			return s
		end
		local function safe(fn, ...)
			local ok, v = pcall(fn, ...)
			if ok then return v end
			return nil
		end

		-- ============================== saved searches ==============================
		local function H()
			local h = SaveData.SearchHistory
			if type(h) ~= "table" then
				h = {}
				SaveData.SearchHistory = h
			end
			return h
		end
		do -- clean whatever an older / hand edited save file contained
			local raw = H()
			local clean, seen = {}, {}
			for _, v in ipairs(raw) do
				if type(v) == "string" then
					local s = trim(v)
					local key = s:lower()
					if s ~= "" and not seen[key] and #clean < S.HistoryMax then
						seen[key] = true
						clean[#clean + 1] = s
					end
				end
			end
			SaveData.SearchHistory = clean
		end
		S.Remember = function(q)
			q = trim(q)
			if #q < 2 or #q > 60 then return end
			local h = H()
			local key = q:lower()
			for i = #h, 1, -1 do
				if type(h[i]) ~= "string" or h[i]:lower() == key then
					table.remove(h, i)
				end
			end
			table.insert(h, 1, q)
			while #h > S.HistoryMax do
				table.remove(h)
			end
		end
		S.Forget = function(q)
			local h = H()
			for i = #h, 1, -1 do
				if h[i] == q then
					table.remove(h, i)
				end
			end
		end
		S.ClearHistory = function()
			table.clear(H())
		end

		-- ============================== public helpers ==============================
		-- give a page a name for the "where" line of results (Util.Search.Titles[page] = "Name")
		-- or start a new section on a page (Util.Search.Section(page, "Name"))
		S.Section = function(parent, name)
			S.Headers[parent] = name
		end
		-- attach extra behaviour to an item-list entry (used by Movesets / Dances):
		-- Group = "moveset" | "dance", Use = function, State = function -> "ACTIVE" | nil, Hint = text
		S.Hook = function(item, data)
			pcall(function()
				local e = S.Items[item]
				if e then
					for k, v in pairs(data) do
						e[k] = v
					end
				end
			end)
		end

		-- ============================== registration wrappers ==============================
		-- the originals stay untouched; result rows below are built with the originals so they never index themselves
		local origText, origSwitch, origButton = UI.CreateText, UI.CreateSwitch, UI.CreateButton
		local origDropdown, origSlider, origTextbox = UI.CreateDropdown, UI.CreateSlider, UI.CreateTextbox
		local origItem = UI.CreateItemListItem

		local function reg(e)
			pcall(function()
				S.Entries[#S.Entries + 1] = e
			end)
		end
		local function skipLabel(l)
			if l == "" then return true end
			if l:sub(1, 1) == "<" then return true end -- "< Back", "< Hurry back"
			local ll = l:lower()
			if ll:find("hurry back", 1, true) or ll:find("back to cool scene", 1, true) then return true end
			return false
		end
		local function itemTexts(item)
			local list = {}
			for _, c in ipairs(item:GetChildren()) do
				if c:IsA("Frame") then
					local tl = c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
					if tl then
						list[#list + 1] = {o = c.LayoutOrder, t = plain(tl.Text)}
					end
				end
			end
			table.sort(list, function(a, b)
				return a.o < b.o
			end)
			return list
		end

		UI.CreateText = function(parent, text, size, alignment)
			local label = origText(parent, text, size, alignment)
			pcall(function()
				local raw = tostring(text)
				local head = raw:match("^%s*<b>(.-)</b>%s*$")
				if head then
					head = plain(head)
					if head ~= "" then
						S.Headers[parent] = head
						if S.Titles[parent] == nil then
							S.Titles[parent] = head
						end
					end
				end
				S.LastText[parent] = {Label = label, Text = plain(raw)}
			end)
			return label
		end
		UI.CreateSwitch = function(parent, text, value)
			local lever, label = origSwitch(parent, text, value)
			reg({Kind = "switch", Obj = label, Parent = parent, Section = S.Headers[parent], Lever = lever,
				GetName = function() return plain(label.Text) end})
			return lever, label
		end
		UI.CreateButton = function(parent, text, size)
			local button, label = origButton(parent, text, size)
			pcall(function()
				if not skipLabel(plain(text)) then
					reg({Kind = "button", Obj = label, Parent = parent, Section = S.Headers[parent], Button = button,
						GetName = function() return plain(label.Text) end})
				end
			end)
			return button, label
		end
		UI.CreateDropdown = function(parent, text, array, value)
			local sel, label = origDropdown(parent, text, array, value)
			reg({Kind = "dropdown", Obj = label, Parent = parent, Section = S.Headers[parent], Select = sel, Options = array,
				GetName = function() return plain(label.Text) end})
			return sel, label
		end
		UI.CreateSlider = function(parent, text, value, min, max, step)
			local sel = origSlider(parent, text, value, min, max, step)
			pcall(function()
				local kids = parent:GetChildren()
				local obj
				for i = #kids, 1, -1 do
					local k = kids[i]
					if k:IsA("GuiObject") and k.LayoutOrder == #kids then
						obj = k
						break
					end
				end
				obj = obj or kids[#kids]
				reg({Kind = "input", Sub = "slider", Obj = obj, Parent = parent, Section = S.Headers[parent], Select = sel,
					Min = min or 1, Max = max or 10, Step = math.abs(step or 0),
					GetName = function() return plain(text) end})
			end)
			return sel
		end
		UI.CreateTextbox = function(parent, text, placeholder, size)
			local box = origTextbox(parent, text, placeholder, size)
			pcall(function()
				local related
				local prev = S.LastText[parent]
				if prev and prev.Label and prev.Label.Parent then
					local cont = box.Parent and box.Parent.Parent
					if cont and cont.LayoutOrder == prev.Label.Parent.LayoutOrder + 1 then
						if prev.Text ~= "" and #prev.Text <= 45 then
							related = prev.Text
						end
					end
				end
				reg({Kind = "input", Sub = "textbox", Obj = box, Parent = parent, Section = S.Headers[parent], Box = box,
					GetName = function()
						if related then return related end
						local ph = plain(box.PlaceholderText)
						if ph ~= "" then return ph end
						return "Text box"
					end,
					GetExtra = function() return plain(box.PlaceholderText) end})
			end)
			return box
		end
		UI.CreateItemListItem = function(parent)
			local item = origItem(parent)
			pcall(function()
				local cache
				local e = {Kind = "item", Obj = item, Parent = parent, Button = item,
					GetName = function()
						if cache then return cache end
						local list = itemTexts(item)
						local n = list[1] and list[1].t or ""
						n = n:gsub("%s*>%s*$", "")
						if n ~= "" then cache = n end
						return n
					end,
					GetDesc = function()
						local list = itemTexts(item)
						return list[2] and list[2].t or ""
					end,
					GetExtra = function()
						local n = item.Parent and item.Parent.Name or ""
						local own = cache or ""
						if own ~= "" and #n < 1500 and n:lower():find(own:lower(), 1, true) then
							return n
						end
						local list = itemTexts(item)
						return list[2] and list[2].t or ""
					end}
				S.Items[item] = e
				reg(e)
			end)
			return item
		end

		-- ============================== lookup ==============================
		local function alive(e)
			local ok, res = pcall(function()
				return e.Obj:IsDescendantOf(UIMainFrame)
			end)
			return ok and res == true
		end
		local function whereOf(e)
			local page
			local p = e.Parent
			local guard = 0
			while p ~= nil and p ~= UIMainFrame and guard < 40 do
				local t = S.Titles[p]
				if t then
					page = t -- keep walking up: the outermost titled frame is the page itself
				end
				p = p.Parent
				guard += 1
			end
			local sec = e.Section
			if page and sec and sec ~= page then
				return page .. " > " .. sec
			end
			return sec or page or "Settings"
		end
		local function kindWord(e)
			if e.Kind == "switch" then return "switch toggle" end
			if e.Kind == "button" then return "button" end
			if e.Kind == "dropdown" then return "dropdown option" end
			if e.Kind == "input" then
				return e.Sub == "slider" and "slider" or "textbox input"
			end
			if e.Group == "moveset" then return "moveset" end
			if e.Group == "dance" then return "dance" end
			return "item"
		end
		local function isRisky(e)
			if e.Kind ~= "button" then return false end
			local l = (safe(e.GetName) or ""):lower()
			for _, w in ipairs(S.Risky) do
				if l:find(w, 1, true) then return true end
			end
			return false
		end
		local function find(query)
			local q = query:lower()
			local words = {}
			for w in q:gmatch("%S+") do
				words[#words + 1] = w
			end
			local live, out = {}, {}
			for idx, e in ipairs(S.Entries) do
				if alive(e) then
					live[#live + 1] = e
					local okN, label = pcall(e.GetName)
					if okN and type(label) == "string" and label ~= "" then
						local where = whereOf(e)
						local extra = ""
						if e.GetExtra then
							local ex = safe(e.GetExtra)
							if type(ex) == "string" then
								extra = ex:sub(1, 600)
							end
						end
						local hay = (label .. " " .. where .. " " .. kindWord(e) .. " " .. extra):lower()
						local hit = true
						for _, w in ipairs(words) do
							if not hay:find(w, 1, true) then
								hit = false
								break
							end
						end
						if hit then
							local ll = label:lower()
							local score = 3
							if ll:sub(1, #q) == q then
								score = 1
							elseif ll:find(q, 1, true) then
								score = 2
							end
							out[#out + 1] = {Entry = e, Label = label, Score = score, Idx = idx}
						end
					end
				end
			end
			if #S.Entries - #live > 40 then
				S.Entries = live -- drop controls whose page was rebuilt / destroyed
			end
			table.sort(out, function(a, b)
				if a.Score ~= b.Score then
					return a.Score < b.Score
				end
				local la, lb = a.Label:lower(), b.Label:lower()
				if la ~= lb then
					return la < lb
				end
				return a.Idx < b.Idx
			end)
			return out
		end

		-- ============================== actions ==============================
		local function trigger(signal, ...)
			local args = table.pack(...)
			task.spawn(function()
				local fired = false
				if type(firesignal) == "function" then
					fired = pcall(firesignal, signal, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
				end
				if not fired and type(getconnections) == "function" then
					local ok, conns = pcall(getconnections, signal)
					if ok and type(conns) == "table" then
						for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
							local okc = pcall(function()
								c:Fire(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
							end)
							if okc then fired = true end
						end
					end
				end
				if not fired then
					Util.Notify("Your executor can't press buttons from the search (needs firesignal or getconnections).")
				end
			end)
		end
		local function applyInput(e, txt)
			if e.Sub == "slider" then
				local n = tonumber(txt)
				if not n then
					Util.Notify("That is not a number.")
					return
				end
				if e.Step and e.Step > 0 then
					n = e.Min + math.round((n - e.Min) / e.Step) * e.Step
				end
				e.Select.Value = math.clamp(n, e.Min, e.Max)
			else
				e.Box.Text = txt
				trigger(e.Box.FocusLost, true)
			end
		end

		-- ============================== UI: search box + results ==============================
		local SearchBox = origTextbox(MainPage, "", "Search everything... (fly, dance, hub)", 15)
		local Results = Util.Instance("Frame", MainPage)
		Results.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		Results.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		Results.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		Results.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		Results.LayoutOrder = #MainPage:GetChildren()
		Results.Visible = false
		local ResultsList = Util.Instance("UIListLayout", Results)
		ResultsList.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
		ResultsList.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
		ResultsList.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
		ResultsList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 0)
		ResultsList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

		local Status = origText(Results, "", 11, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
		local StatusBox = Status.Parent
		StatusBox.Visible = false
		local before = {}
		for _, c in ipairs(Results:GetChildren()) do
			before[c] = true
		end
		UI.CreateSeparator(Results)
		for _, c in ipairs(Results:GetChildren()) do
			if not before[c] and c:IsA("Frame") then
				c.LayoutOrder = 100000
			end
		end

		local refresh, render, runEntry
		local historyOpen = false

		local function newSwitchRow()
			local lever, label = origSwitch(Results, "", false)
			local button = label.Parent
			local row = {Type = "switch", Lever = lever, Label = label, Container = button.Parent, Conns = {}}
			row.Container.Visible = false
			button.Activated:Connect(function()
				local e = row.Target
				if e and e.Lever then
					S.Remember(SearchBox.Text)
					e.Lever.Value = not e.Lever.Value -- the real switch's own handlers do the rest
				end
			end)
			return row
		end
		local function newActionRow()
			local button, label = origButton(Results, "", 15)
			label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			local pad = Util.Instance("UIPadding", label)
			pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
			pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
			local row = {Type = "action", Button = button, Label = label, Container = button.Parent, Conns = {}}
			row.Container.Visible = false
			button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				local t = input.UserInputType
				if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
					row.PressAt = os.clock()
				end
			end)
			button.Activated:Connect(function()
				local held = row.PressAt ~= nil and (os.clock() - row.PressAt) >= 0.5
				row.PressAt = nil
				local e = row.Target
				if e then
					local ok, err = pcall(runEntry, e, held, row)
					if not ok then
						warn("[Uhhhhhh] Search action failed: " .. tostring(err))
					end
				end
			end)
			return row
		end
		local function newInputRow()
			local box = origTextbox(Results, "", "", 14)
			local row = {Type = "input", Box = box, Container = box.Parent.Parent, Conns = {}}
			row.Container.Visible = false
			box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local txt = trim(box.Text)
				box.Text = ""
				local e = row.Target
				if e and txt ~= "" then
					local ok, err = pcall(applyInput, e, txt)
					if not ok then
						warn("[Uhhhhhh] Search input failed: " .. tostring(err))
					end
					S.Remember(SearchBox.Text)
					pcall(render, row, e)
				end
			end)
			return row
		end
		local used = {}
		local function acquire(kind)
			local pool = S.Pools[kind]
			local n = (used[kind] or 0) + 1
			local row = pool[n]
			if not row then
				if kind == "switch" then
					row = newSwitchRow()
				elseif kind == "action" then
					row = newActionRow()
				else
					row = newInputRow()
				end
				pool[n] = row
			end
			used[kind] = n
			return row
		end
		local function fit(row)
			pcall(function()
				if row.Type == "input" then return end
				local x = Results.AbsoluteSize.X
				if x < 120 then
					x = MainPage.AbsoluteSize.X
				end
				if row.Type == "switch" then
					local sz = TextService:GetTextSize(row.Label.ContentText, row.Label.TextSize, row.Label.Font, Vector2.new(math.max(60, x - 65), math.huge))
					row.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(35, sz.Y))
				else
					local sz = TextService:GetTextSize(row.Label.ContentText, row.Label.TextSize, row.Label.Font, Vector2.new(math.max(60, x - 24), math.huge))
					row.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(35, sz.Y + 14))
				end
			end)
		end
		local function sub(t, warnColor)
			if warnColor then
				return "\n<font size=\"11\" color=\"" .. warnColor .. "\">" .. esc(t) .. "</font>"
			end
			return "\n<font size=\"11\" transparency=\"0.5\">" .. esc(t) .. "</font>"
		end
		local function armed(e)
			return e.ArmedUntil ~= nil and os.clock() <= e.ArmedUntil
		end
		local function actionText(e)
			local k = e.Kind
			if k == "history" then
				return esc(e.Query) .. sub("recent search  -  tap = search again, hold = remove")
			elseif k == "clear" then
				return "Clear search history" .. sub("removes every saved search")
			elseif k == "more" then
				return "Show more results" .. sub(e.Count .. " more match")
			end
			local label = safe(e.GetName) or ""
			local where = whereOf(e)
			if armed(e) then
				return esc(label) .. sub("TAP AGAIN TO CONFIRM", "#FF5555")
			end
			if k == "dropdown" then
				local cur = e.Options[e.Select.Value]
				return esc(label) .. ": <b>" .. esc(tostring(cur)) .. "</b>" .. sub(where .. "  -  tap = next, hold = previous")
			end
			local state = e.State and safe(e.State)
			local head = esc(label)
			if state then
				head = head .. "  <b>[" .. esc(state) .. "]</b>"
			end
			local hint
			if k == "button" then
				hint = "tap to run"
			elseif e.Use then
				hint = e.Hint or "tap = use, hold = open"
			else
				hint = "tap to open"
			end
			return head .. sub(where .. "  -  " .. hint)
		end
		local function inputPlaceholder(e)
			local label = safe(e.GetName) or ""
			local where = whereOf(e)
			if e.Sub == "slider" then
				return "Set " .. label .. " = " .. fmt(e.Select.Value) .. "  (" .. fmt(e.Min) .. " to " .. fmt(e.Max) .. ")  -  " .. where
			end
			local cur = e.Box.Text or ""
			if #cur > 24 then
				cur = cur:sub(1, 24) .. "..."
			end
			return "Set " .. label .. (cur ~= "" and (" = " .. cur) or "") .. "  -  " .. where
		end
		render = function(row, e)
			if row.Type == "switch" then
				row.Lever.Value = e.Lever.Value
				row.Label.Text = esc(safe(e.GetName) or "") .. sub(whereOf(e))
			elseif row.Type == "action" then
				row.Label.Text = actionText(e)
			else
				row.Box.PlaceholderText = inputPlaceholder(e)
			end
			fit(row)
		end

		runEntry = function(e, alt, row)
			local k = e.Kind
			if k == "history" then
				if alt then
					S.Forget(e.Query)
					refresh()
				else
					SearchBox.Text = e.Query -- the text-changed signal runs the search
				end
				return
			elseif k == "clear" then
				S.ClearHistory()
				refresh()
				return
			elseif k == "more" then
				S.Limit = math.min(S.Limit + S.PageSize, S.MaxShown)
				refresh()
				return
			end
			if isRisky(e) and not armed(e) then
				e.ArmedUntil = os.clock() + 3
				render(row, e)
				task.delay(3.1, function()
					if row.Target == e then
						pcall(render, row, e)
					end
				end)
				return
			end
			e.ArmedUntil = nil
			S.Remember(SearchBox.Text)
			if k == "dropdown" then
				local n = #e.Options
				if n > 0 then
					local dir = alt and -1 or 1
					e.Select.Value = ((e.Select.Value - 1 + dir) % n) + 1
				end
			elseif k == "button" then
				trigger(e.Button.Activated)
			elseif k == "item" then
				if e.Use and not alt then
					e.Use()
				else
					trigger(e.Button.Activated)
				end
			end
			render(row, e)
		end

		local function resetRows()
			for _, pool in pairs(S.Pools) do
				for _, r in ipairs(pool) do
					for _, c in ipairs(r.Conns) do
						c:Disconnect()
					end
					table.clear(r.Conns)
					r.Target = nil
					r.Container.Visible = false
				end
			end
			table.clear(used)
			StatusBox.Visible = false
		end
		local function place(entry, order)
			local kind = "action"
			if entry.Kind == "switch" then
				kind = "switch"
			elseif entry.Kind == "input" then
				kind = "input"
			end
			local okR, row = pcall(acquire, kind)
			if not okR or not row then
				warn("[Uhhhhhh] Search row failed: " .. tostring(row))
				return nil
			end
			row.Target = entry
			row.Container.LayoutOrder = order
			row.Container.Visible = true
			if kind == "switch" then
				table.insert(row.Conns, entry.Lever.Changed:Connect(function(v)
					row.Lever.Value = v -- keep the row in sync if the switch is flipped somewhere else
				end))
			end
			local okD, err = pcall(render, row, entry)
			if not okD then
				warn("[Uhhhhhh] Search render failed: " .. tostring(err))
			end
			return row
		end

		refresh = function()
			resetRows()
			local query = trim(SearchBox.Text)
			local placed = {}
			if query == "" then
				local h = H()
				if #h == 0 or not (historyOpen or SearchBox:IsFocused()) then
					Results.Visible = false
					return
				end
				Results.Visible = true
				Status.Text = "Recent searches"
				StatusBox.LayoutOrder = 0
				StatusBox.Visible = true
				for i = 1, math.min(#h, S.HistoryShow) do
					local r = place({Kind = "history", Query = h[i]}, i)
					if r then placed[#placed + 1] = r end
				end
				local r = place({Kind = "clear"}, S.HistoryShow + 1)
				if r then placed[#placed + 1] = r end
			else
				Results.Visible = true
				local found = find(query)
				local shown = math.min(#found, S.Limit)
				for i = 1, shown do
					local r = place(found[i].Entry, i)
					if r then placed[#placed + 1] = r end
				end
				if shown == 0 then
					Status.Text = "No matching options. Try another word."
					StatusBox.LayoutOrder = 90000
					StatusBox.Visible = true
				elseif #found > shown then
					local r = place({Kind = "more", Count = #found - shown}, shown + 1)
					if r then placed[#placed + 1] = r end
				end
			end
			task.delay(0.06, function()
				for _, r in ipairs(placed) do
					fit(r) -- measure again once the layout has settled
				end
			end)
		end
		S.Refresh = refresh

		SearchBox.Focused:Connect(function()
			historyOpen = true
			pcall(refresh) -- show saved searches / pick up pages that were rebuilt while the same words were in the box
		end)
		SearchBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
			local q = trim(SearchBox.Text)
			if enterPressed and q ~= "" then
				local ok, found = pcall(find, q)
				if ok and #found > 0 then
					S.Remember(q)
				end
			end
			task.delay(1.2, function()
				if trim(SearchBox.Text) == "" and not SearchBox:IsFocused() then
					historyOpen = false
					pcall(refresh) -- hides the saved searches again
				end
			end)
		end)
		local token = 0
		SearchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
			token += 1
			local mine = token
			S.Limit = S.PageSize
			task.delay(0.12, function()
				if mine == token then
					local ok, err = pcall(refresh)
					if not ok then
						warn("[Uhhhhhh] Feature search failed: " .. tostring(err))
					end
				end
			end)
		end)
	end)
	if not built then
		warn("[Uhhhhhh] Search bar failed to build: " .. tostring(buildErr))
	end
end

			for y=0, 64 do

	local function switchart()
		if AsciiTextartsw then return end
		AsciiTextartsw = true
		local function animation(art, inv)
			local transmap = AsciiTextarttr[math.random(1, #AsciiTextarttr)]
			local rot = math.random(0, 3)
			local st = os.clock()
			repeat
				local t = os.clock() - st
				local i = math.clamp(math.floor(t * 60) + 1, 1, 60)
				local render = {}
				for iy=1, #art do
					local y = (iy - 1) / #art
					local conc = ""
					local txt = art[iy]
					for ix=1, #txt do
						local x = (ix - 1) / #txt
						local ch = string.sub(txt, ix, ix)
						local b = 0
						if rot == 0 then
							b = transmap[i][math.floor(y * 64) + 1][math.floor(x * 64) + 1]
						elseif rot == 1 then
							b = transmap[i][math.floor(x * 64) + 1][64 - math.floor(y * 64)]
						elseif rot == 2 then
							b = transmap[i][64 - math.floor(y * 64)][64 - math.floor(x * 64)]
						elseif rot == 3 then
							b = transmap[i][64 - math.floor(x * 64)][math.floor(y * 64) + 1]
						end
						if inv then b = 3 - b end
						if b == 1 then
							if (ch == ch:upper() and ch ~= ch:lower()) or ch == "8" or ch == "0" then
								ch = "?"
							elseif ch == ":" or ch == ";" or ch == "_" then
								ch = "."
							elseif ch == "." or ch == "," or ch == " " then
								ch = " "
							else
								ch = ":"
							end
						elseif b == 2 then
							if (ch == ch:upper() and ch ~= ch:lower()) or ch == "8" or ch == "0" then
								ch = ":"
							elseif ch == ":" or ch == ";" or ch == "_" or ch == "." or ch == "," or ch == " " then
								ch = " "
							else
								ch = "."
							end
						elseif b == 3 then
							ch = " "
						end
						conc ..= ch
					end
					table.insert(render, conc)
				end
				AsciiText.Text = table.concat(render, "\n")
				task.wait()
			until os.clock() > st + 1
		end
		local source = string.split(AsciiText.Text, "\n")
		local target = source
		while table.concat(source, "\n") == table.concat(target, "\n") do
			task.wait()
			target = AsciiTextarts[math.random(1, #AsciiTextarts)]
		end
		animation(source, false)
		animation(target, true)
		AsciiText.Text = table.concat(target, "\n")
		AsciiTextartsw = false
	end
	local AsciiTextartin = nil
	AsciiText.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			AsciiTextartin = input
		end
	end)
	AsciiText.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if AsciiTextartin == input then
			AsciiTextartin = nil
			switchart()
		end
	end)
	switchart()
end)

	})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		CracktroFrame.Interactable = true
	end)
end)
UI.CreateSwitch(MainPage, "Skip Intro", SaveData.SkipIntro).Changed:Connect(function(value)
	SaveData.SkipIntro = value
end)

	SaveData.FXBlur = value
	Util.FX.Settings.Blur = value
end)

	SaveData.FXTransitions = value
	Util.FX.Settings.Transitions = value
end)

	SaveData.FXSounds = value
	Util.FX.Settings.ExtraSounds = value
end)

	SaveData.FXAmbient = value
	Util.FX.Settings.Ambient = value
end)
-- ═════ COLOUR PICKER WIDGET: saturation/value square + hue bar + presets (no typing) ═════
-- returns a StringValue holding "#RRGGBB" (or "" when allowTheme and the user pressed "Use theme"); .Changed fires like the other widgets
function UI.CreateColorPicker(parent, text, hex, allowTheme)
	local margin = 5
	local Container = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
	Container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 205)
	Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Container.LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren()
	local Title = Util.Instance("TextLabel", Container)
	Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, margin, 0, 0)
	Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, margin * -2, 0, 24)
	Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Title.RichText = true
	Title.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	Title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	Title.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	Title.TextWrapped = true
	Title.TextSize = 13
	Title.Text = text
	RegisterTextLabel(Title)
	local Value = Util.Instance("StringValue")
	local cur = Util.ParseHex(hex or "")
	local h, s, v = 0, 0, 1
	if cur then h, s, v = cur:ToHSV() end
	Value.Value = cur and ("#" .. cur:ToHex():upper()) or (allowTheme and "" or "#FFFFFF")

	local SV = Util.Instance("TextButton", Container)
	SV.Position = UDim2.new(0, margin, 0, 28)
	SV.Size = UDim2.new(0.56, -margin, 0, 110)
	SV.Text = ""
	SV.AutoButtonColor = false
	SV.BorderSizePixel = 0
	SV.ClipsDescendants = true
	SV.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1)
	local White = Util.Instance("Frame", SV)
	White.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	White.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	White.BorderSizePixel = 0
	White.Interactable = false
	local wg = Util.Instance("UIGradient", White)
	wg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
	local Black = Util.Instance("Frame", SV)
	Black.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	Black.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	Black.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Black.Interactable = false
	local bg = Util.Instance("UIGradient", Black)
	bg.Rotation = 90
	bg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1, 0)
	local Knob = Util.Instance("Frame", SV)
	Knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	Knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
	Knob.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Knob.ZIndex = 3
	Knob.Interactable = false
	Util.Instance("UICorner", Knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	local ks = Util.Instance("UIStroke", Knob)
	ks.Thickness = 2
	ks.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Stylize(SV, {Depthed = true})

	local Hue = Util.Instance("TextButton", Container)
	Hue.Position = UDim2.new(0.56, 6, 0, 28)
	Hue.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 110)
	Hue.Text = ""
	Hue.AutoButtonColor = false
	Hue.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Hue.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local hg = Util.Instance("UIGradient", Hue)
	hg.Rotation = 90
	local keys = {}
	for i = 0, 6 do keys[#keys + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i / 6, Color3.fromHSV(i / 6 % 1 + (i == 6 and 0.9999 or 0), 1, 1)) end
	hg.Color = ColorSequence.new(keys)
	local HKnob = Util.Instance("Frame", Hue)
	HKnob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	HKnob.Size = UDim2.new(1, 6, 0, 5)
	HKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	HKnob.BorderSizePixel = 0
	HKnob.ZIndex = 3
	HKnob.Interactable = false
	Stylize(Hue, {Depthed = true})

	local Side = Util.Instance("Frame", Container)
	Side.Position = UDim2.new(0.56, 36, 0, 28)
	Side.Size = UDim2.new(0.44, -36 - margin, 0, 110)
	Side.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	local Swatch = Util.Instance("Frame", Side)
	Swatch.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
	Swatch.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Stylize(Swatch, {Depthed = true})
	local HexLbl = Util.Instance("TextLabel", Side)
	HexLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 48)
	HexLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	HexLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	HexLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	HexLbl.TextSize = 14
	HexLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	RegisterTextLabel(HexLbl)

	local function refreshVisual()
		local col = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
		SV.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1)
		Knob.Position = UDim2.new(s, 0, 1 - v, 0)
		HKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, h, 0)
		ks.Color = (v > 0.6 and s < 0.5) and Color3.new(0, 0, 0) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		if Value.Value == "" then
			HexLbl.Text = "theme"
		else
			Swatch.BackgroundColor3 = col
			HexLbl.Text = Value.Value
		end
	end
	local function commit()
		local col = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
		Value.Value = "#" .. col:ToHex():upper()
		refreshVisual()
	end
	if Value.Value == "" then
		Swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
		AddToRenderStep(function() if Value.Value == "" then Swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Util.Color.Cur end end, Container)
	end
	refreshVisual()
	if allowTheme then
		local ThemeBtn = Util.Instance("TextButton", Side)
		ThemeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 74)
		ThemeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
		ThemeBtn.Text = ""
		ThemeBtn.AutoButtonColor = true
		ThemeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		ThemeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local tl = Util.Instance("TextLabel", ThemeBtn)
		tl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tl.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		tl.TextSize = 12
		tl.Text = "Use theme"
		tl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		RegisterTextLabel(tl)
		Stylize(ThemeBtn)
		ThemeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			Value.Value = ""
			refreshVisual()
			AddToRenderStep(function() if Value.Value == "" then Swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Util.Color.Cur end end, Container)
		end)
	end

	-- presets
	local presets = {"#FF3B30", "#FF9500", "#FFD60A", "#34C759", "#00C7BE", "#32ADE6", "#0A84FF", "#BF5AF2", "#FF2D92", "#FFFFFF"}
	for i, ph in ipairs(presets) do
		local b = Util.Instance("TextButton", Container)
		b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		b.Position = UDim2.new((i - 0.5) / #presets, 0, 0, 148)
		b.Size = UDim2.new(1 / #presets, -6, 0, 26)
		b.Text = ""
		b.AutoButtonColor = true
		b.BorderSizePixel = 0
		b.BackgroundColor3 = Util.ParseHex(ph)
		Stylize(b)
		b.Activated:Connect(function()
			h, s, v = Util.ParseHex(ph):ToHSV()
			commit()
		end)
	end
	local pal = Util.Instance("TextButton", Container)
	pal.Position = UDim2.new(0, margin, 0, 178)
	pal.Size = UDim2.new(1, margin * -2, 0, 24)
	pal.Text = ""
	pal.AutoButtonColor = true
	pal.BorderSizePixel = 0
	pal.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local pl = Util.Instance("TextLabel", pal)
	pl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	pl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	pl.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	pl.TextSize = 12
	pl.Text = "Sample current palette accent"
	pl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	RegisterTextLabel(pl)
	Stylize(pal)
	pal.Activated:Connect(function()
		h, s, v = Util.Color.Cur:ToHSV()
		commit()
	end)

	-- dragging (works with mouse and touch; the page does not scroll while a drag is active)
	local drag, dragInput = nil, nil
	local function scrollParent()
		local p = Container.Parent
		while p do
			if p:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then return p end
			p = p.Parent
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function setScroll(on)
		local sf = scrollParent()
		if sf then sf.ScrollingEnabled = on end
	end
	local function applyPos(x, y)
		if drag == "sv" then
			s = math.clamp((x - SV.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, SV.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
			v = 1 - math.clamp((y - SV.AbsolutePosition.Y) / math.max(1, SV.AbsoluteSize.Y), 0, 1)
		elseif drag == "hue" then
			h = math.clamp((y - Hue.AbsolutePosition.Y) / math.max(1, Hue.AbsoluteSize.Y), 0, 0.9999)
		end
		commit()
	end
	local function begin(kind)
		return function(input)
			if input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return end
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				drag, dragInput = kind, input
				setScroll(false)
				applyPos(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
			end
		end
	end
	SV.InputBegan:Connect(begin("sv"))
	Hue.InputBegan:Connect(begin("hue"))
	Util.LinkDestroyI2C(Container, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if drag and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input == dragInput)) then
			applyPos(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		end
	end))
	Util.LinkDestroyI2C(Container, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if drag and (input == dragInput or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
			drag, dragInput = nil, nil
			setScroll(true)
		end
	end))
	return Value
end

-- ═════ EXTRA UI OPTIONS (v24): scale, font, animation speed, ambient particles, accent sheen, cursor trail ═════
Util.UIPlus = (function()
	local P = {}
	local FONTS = {Enum.Font.Code, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Enum.Font.SciFi, Enum.Font.Arcade, Enum.Font.Ubuntu, Enum.Font.RobotoMono, Enum.Font.Fantasy}
	P.FontNames = {"Code (default)", "Gotham", "Sci-Fi", "Arcade", "Ubuntu", "Roboto Mono", "Fantasy"}
	local function cfg() return Util.FX.Cfg end
	local function fontFor(o)
		if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then
			local f = FONTS[cfg().UIFont or 1] or FONTS[1]
