				MobileShiftlock.Visible = false
				return
			end
			local touchFrame = touchGui and touchGui:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
			local jumpButton = touchFrame and touchFrame:FindFirstChild("JumpButton")
			if not jumpButton then
				MobileShiftlock.Visible = false
				return
			end
			if state ~= Reanimate.Shiftlocked then
				state = Reanimate.Shiftlocked
				MobileShiftlock.Image = states[state]
			end
			MobileShiftlock.Visible = not not Reanimate.Character
			local pos = jumpButton.AbsolutePosition - SCREENGUI.AbsolutePosition
			local size = jumpButton.AbsoluteSize
			local ratio = 4 / 7
			pos += Vector2.new(-size.X * (ratio + 0.2), size.Y * (1 - ratio))
			size *= ratio
			MobileShiftlock.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y)
			MobileShiftlock.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X, size.Y)
		end)
		MobileShiftlock.Activated:Connect(function()
			Reanimate.Shiftlocked = Reanimate.ShiftlockEnabled and not Reanimate.Shiftlocked
		end)
		RunService:BindToRenderStep("Uhhhhhh_Camera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
			self.VRMode = VRService.VREnabled
			if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
				resetInputDevices()
			end
			if self.Inputs.KB.Left then
				self:OnPanInput(Vector2.new(math.rad(-120) * dt, 0), true)
			end
			if self.Inputs.KB.Right then
				self:OnPanInput(Vector2.new(math.rad(120) * dt, 0), true)
			end
			self:OnPanInput(self.Inputs.GP.DJ * Vector2.new(1, 0.77) * math.rad(4) * 60 * dt * GameSettings.GamepadCameraSensitivity, true)
			local input = self.Input * Vector3.new(1, GameSettings:GetCameraYInvertValue(), 1)
			self.Input = Vector3.zero
			local zoomDelta = input.Z
			if math.abs(zoomDelta) > 0 then
				if zoomDelta > 0 then
					self.Zoom += zoomDelta * (1 + self.Zoom * 0.5)
				else
					self.Zoom = (self.Zoom + zoomDelta) / (1 - zoomDelta * 0.5)
				end
			end
			self.Zoom = math.clamp(self.Zoom, 0.5, 100000)
			local rzoom = self.Zoom
			if self.FPSLocked then
				self.Zoom = 0.5
				rzoom = 0.5
			end
			if self.VRMode then
				input *= Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
				rzoom *= Reanimate.CharacterScale
				self._Zoom = rzoom
			end
			self._Zoom = rzoom + (self._Zoom - rzoom) * math.exp(-32 * dt)
			local ltm = Reanimate.LocalTransparencyModifier
			local tltm = 0
			local sltm = dt * 3
			if not self.Scriptable then
				if self:IsFirstPerson() then
					tltm = 1
				elseif rzoom < 1.5 * Reanimate.CharacterScale then
					tltm = 0.5
				end
			end
			if math.abs(ltm - tltm) <= sltm then
				ltm = tltm
			elseif ltm < tltm then
				ltm += sltm
			else
				ltm -= sltm
			end
			Reanimate.LocalTransparencyModifier = ltm
			if not Reanimate.ShiftlockEnabled and Reanimate.Shiftlocked then
				Reanimate.Shiftlocked = false
			end
			if Reanimate.Character then
				local targetMouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
				if self:IsMousePanning() then
					if self:IsMouseLocked() then
						if UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
							targetMouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition
						else
							targetMouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
						end
					else
						targetMouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition
					end
				end
				if UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= targetMouseBehavior then
					UserInputService.MouseBehavior = targetMouseBehavior
				end
				local targetMouseIcon = ""
				if Reanimate.Shiftlocked then
					targetMouseIcon = "rbxasset://textures/Cursors/CrossMouseIcon.png"
				end
				if UserInputService.MouseIcon ~= targetMouseIcon then
					UserInputService.MouseIcon = targetMouseIcon
				end
				if GameSettings.RotationType ~= Enum.RotationType.MovementRelative then
					GameSettings.RotationType = Enum.RotationType.MovementRelative
				end
				local Humanoid = Reanimate.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local RootPart = Reanimate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if Humanoid and RootPart and Camera.CameraSubject == Humanoid then
					if self.Scriptable then
						Camera.FieldOfView = self.FieldOfView
						Camera.FieldOfViewMode = "Vertical"
					else
						Camera.FieldOfView = 70
						Camera.FieldOfViewMode = "Vertical"
						local newCameraCFrame, newCameraFocus = self.CFrame, self.Focus
						local subjectPosition = RootPart.Position + RootPart.CFrame.UpVector * 1.5
						if not self.VRMode then subjectPosition += RootPart.CFrame.Rotation * Humanoid.CameraOffset end
						local currLookVector = suppliedLookVector or newCameraCFrame.LookVector
						local currPitchAngle = math.asin(currLookVector.Y)
						local constrainedRotateInput = Vector2.new(input.X, math.clamp(input.Y, math.rad(-80) + currPitchAngle, math.rad(80) + currPitchAngle))
						local startCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, currLookVector)
						local newLookCFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, -constrainedRotateInput.X, 0) * startCFrame * CFrame.Angles(-constrainedRotateInput.Y, 0, 0)
						local newLookVector = newLookCFrame.LookVector
						if self.VRMode then
							newLookVector = (newLookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Unit
							if newLookVector.Magnitude == 0 or newLookVector ~= newLookVector then
								newLookVector = Vector3.zAxis
							end
						end
						if self:IsMouseLocked() and not self:IsFirstPerson() then
							local cameraRelativeOffset = newLookCFrame * Vector3.new(1.7, 0, 0)
							if cameraRelativeOffset == cameraRelativeOffset then
								subjectPosition += cameraRelativeOffset
							end
						end
						newCameraFocus = CFrame.new(subjectPosition)
						local cameraFocusP = newCameraFocus.Position
						if self.VRMode then
							cameraFocusP += newLookVector * 0.5
						end
						newCameraCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cameraFocusP - newLookVector * self._Zoom, cameraFocusP)
						self.CFrame, self.Focus = newCameraCFrame, newCameraFocus
					end
					Camera.CFrame, Camera.Focus = self.CFrame, self.Focus
				end
				for _,v in Reanimate.CharacterLTMs do
					v.LocalTransparencyModifier = ltm
				end
			end
			pcall(function() CoreGui.TopBarApp.TopBarApp.FullScreenFrame.HurtOverlay.Visible = false end)
		end)
	end
end
Reanimate.CameraLockCharacter = function()
	local RCRootPart = Reanimate.Character and Reanimate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if RCRootPart and RCRootPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		local ccf = Reanimate.Camera:GetMovementCFrame()
		local rcf = RCRootPart.CFrame
		local ax, ay, az = ccf:ToEulerAngles(Enum.RotationOrder.YXZ)
		local bx, by, bz = rcf:ToEulerAngles(Enum.RotationOrder.YXZ)
		RCRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.fromEulerAngles(bx, ay, bz, Enum.RotationOrder.YXZ) + rcf.Position
	end
end
Reanimate.CreateCharacter = function(InitCFrame)
	local RC = Reanimate.Character
	local cf = CFrame.new(Camera.Focus.Position)
	if RC then
		local r = RC:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if r then
			cf = r.CFrame
		end
		RC:Destroy()
	elseif Player.Character then
		local r = Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if r then
			cf = r.CFrame
		end
	end
	if InitCFrame then
		cf = InitCFrame
	end
	Reanimate.Camera.CFrame, Reanimate.Camera.Focus = Camera.CFrame, Camera.Focus
	Reanimate.Camera:OnReset()
	RC = CreateHumanoidCharacter()
	RC.ModelStreamingMode = "Persistent"
	Player.ReplicationFocus = workspace
	local ltmparts = Reanimate.CharacterLTMs
	table.clear(ltmparts)
	local function OnDescendant(v)
		local exist = pcall(function()
			return v.LocalTransparencyModifier
		end)
		if exist then
			table.insert(ltmparts, v)
			local conn = nil
			conn = v.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				if not v:IsDescendantOf(RC) then
					local i = table.find(ltmparts, v)
					if i then
						table.remove(ltmparts, i)
					end
					conn:Disconnect()
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	RC.DescendantAdded:Connect(OnDescendant)
	for _,v in RC:GetDescendants() do
		task.spawn(OnDescendant, v)
	end
	RC:ScaleTo(Reanimate.CharacterScale)
	local RCHumanoid, RCRootPart = RC.Humanoid, RC.HumanoidRootPart
	local RCHead, RCTorso, RCRootJoint, RCNeck = RC.Head, RC.Torso, RCRootPart.RootJoint, RC.Torso.Neck
	--[[local Anchor = Instance.new("Part", RCRootPart)
	Anchor.Name = "i can take explosions >:3"
	Anchor.Transparency = 1
	Anchor.Anchored = false
	Anchor.CanCollide = false
	Anchor.CanQuery = false
	Anchor.CanTouch = false
	Anchor.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(100, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	Anchor.Size = Vector3.new(2048, 2048, 2048)
	local AnchorWeld = Instance.new("Weld")]]
	local BodyForce = Instance.new("BodyForce")
	BodyForce.Parent = RCRootPart
	BodyForce.Force = Vector3.zero
	RC.Parent = workspace
	RCRootPart.RootPriority = 67
	RCRootPart.CFrame = cf
	local SafeY = cf.Y
	local IsFloat = false
	local SeatWeld = nil
	local LastJumpOffSeat = 0
	RCHumanoid.Touched:Connect(function(part, limb)
		if Reanimate.SeatSit and part:IsA("Seat") and not RCHumanoid.Sit and os.clock() - LastJumpOffSeat > 2 then
			RCHumanoid.Sit = true
			if SeatWeld ~= nil then
				SeatWeld = SeatWeld:Destroy()
			end
			SeatWeld = Instance.new("Weld")
			SeatWeld.Name = "hell yeah!! :3"
			SeatWeld.Parent = RCRootPart
			SeatWeld.Part0 = part
			SeatWeld.Part1 = RCRootPart
			SeatWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2, 0)
			SeatWeld.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -1.5 * RC:GetScale(), 0)
			Util.LinkDestroyI2C(SeatWeld, RCHumanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Jump"):Connect(function()
				if RCHumanoid.Jump then
					RCHumanoid.Sit = false
					SeatWeld:Destroy()
				end
			end))
		end
		if part.Name == "Handle" and part.Parent:IsA("Tool") and not part.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
			if Reanimate.ToolGrab then
				if Player.Character then
					local Humanoid = Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if Humanoid then
						Humanoid:EquipTool(part.Parent)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	RCHumanoid.Seated:Connect(function(active)
		if not active then
			if SeatWeld ~= nil then
				SeatWeld = SeatWeld:Destroy()
			end
			LastJumpOffSeat = os.clock()
		end
	end)
	local LastJump = false
	local RCP = RaycastParams.new()
	RCP.RespectCanCollide = true
	RCP.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	RCP.FilterDescendantsInstances = {RC}
	local noclipStates = {"Running", "Jumping", "Freefall", "Landed", "Climbing", "Swimming"}
	local fallingStates = {"Jumping", "Freefall", "PlatformStanding", "Physics", "Ragdoll", "GettingUp", "Seated", "Flying", "FallingDown"}
	local LastSafest = RCRootPart.CFrame
	local CMove, CJump = Vector3.zero, false
	Util.LinkDestroyI2C(RC, RunService.PreAnimation:Connect(function(dt)
		local control = Reanimate.Control
		CMove, CJump = (control and control.Move) or Vector3.zero, (control and control.Jump) or false
		local movementCamera = Reanimate.Camera
		local CamCF = movementCamera and movementCamera.GetMovementCFrame and movementCamera:GetMovementCFrame() or (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame) or CFrame.new()
		local _,x,_ = CamCF:ToEulerAngles(Enum.RotationOrder.YXZ)
		local MoveCF = CFrame.Angles(0, x, 0)
		pcall(sethiddenproperty, RCRootPart, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil)
		local scale = Reanimate.CharacterScale
		if scale ~= RC:GetScale() then
			RC:ScaleTo(scale)
		end
		local force = Vector3.zero
		local RCHumanoidState = RCHumanoid:GetState().Name
		if RCHumanoidState == "Swimming" then
			force += Vector3.new(0, workspace.Gravity * 0.5, 0) * RCRootPart.AssemblyMass
		end
		local gravaff = not not table.find(fallingStates, RCHumanoidState)
		if gravaff then
			if Reanimate.ScaleGravity and not RCRootPart:IsGrounded() then
				force += Vector3.new(0, -workspace.Gravity * (scale - 1), 0) * RCRootPart.AssemblyMass
			end
		end
		if LastJump ~= CJump then
			if CJump then
				if Reanimate.InfiniteJump and RCHumanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and RCHumanoid.JumpPower > 0 then
					RCRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(
						RCRootPart.Velocity.X, RCHumanoid.JumpPower, RCRootPart.Velocity.Z
					)
				end
			end
		end
		LastJump = CJump
		local TargetCameraPosition = RCRootPart.CFrame * Vector3.new(0, 1.5 * scale, 0)
		if RCRootJoint.Active then
			TargetCameraPosition = RCTorso.CFrame * Vector3.new(0, 1.5 * scale, 0)
			if RCNeck.Active then
				TargetCameraPosition = RCHead.Position
			end
		end
		local TargetCameraOffset = (RCRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)):PointToObjectSpace(TargetCameraPosition)
		if not Reanimate.SmoothCam then
			TargetCameraOffset = Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0) + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0) * scale
		end
		RCHumanoid.CameraOffset = TargetCameraOffset:Lerp(RCHumanoid.CameraOffset, math.exp(-9.8 * dt))
		if RCHumanoidState == "Swimming" then
			RCHumanoid:Move(CamCF:VectorToWorldSpace(CMove))
		else
			RCHumanoid:Move(MoveCF:VectorToWorldSpace(CMove))
		end
		RCHumanoid.Jump = CJump
		BodyForce.Force = force
		if RCRootPart.Position.Y < FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 3 * Reanimate.CharacterScale then
			RCRootPart.CFrame = LastSafest
			RCRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
			RCRootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end))
	Util.LinkDestroyI2C(RC, RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
		local RCHumanoidState = RCHumanoid:GetState().Name
		local clip = not table.find(noclipStates, RCHumanoidState)
		for _,v in RC:GetChildren() do
			if v:IsA("BasePart") then
				v.CanCollide = clip or (not Reanimate.Noclip and v == RCRootPart)
			end
		end
	end))
	Util.LinkDestroyI2C(RC, RunService.PostSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
		RCHumanoid.Jump = CJump
		local tcf, pos = RCRootPart.CFrame.Rotation, RCRootPart.CFrame.Position
		local RCHumanoidState = RCHumanoid:GetState().Name
		local safe = true
		local void = true
		for i=1, 8 do
			local off = CFrame.Angles(0, (i / 4) * math.pi, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.5))
			local r = workspace:Raycast(RCRootPart.Position + off, Vector3.new(0, -65536, 0), RCP)
			if r then
				void = false
				if r.Distance > 3 * Reanimate.CharacterScale + 8 + RCHumanoid.HipHeight then
					safe = false
				end
			else
				safe = false
			end
		end
		if safe then
			LastSafest = RCRootPart.CFrame
		end
		if RCHumanoidState == "Climbing" or not void then
			SafeY = pos.Y
			IsFloat = false
		else
			IsFloat = true
		end
		if Reanimate.PatchmaVoidFloat and IsFloat then
			pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, SafeY, pos.Z)
			RCRootPart.Velocity *= Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		end
		RCRootPart.CFrame = tcf + pos
		if Reanimate:ShouldRotationType() then
			Reanimate:CameraLockCharacter()
		end
	end))
	Reanimate.Character = RC
	_G_Uhhhhhh.Character = RC
end
Reanimate.DestroyCharacter = function()
	if Reanimate.Character then
		Reanimate.Character = Reanimate.Character:Destroy()
		_G_Uhhhhhh.Character = nil
	end
end

do
	local AntiflingHumanoids = {}
	local AntiflingBaseParts = {}
	local OnStepped = function()
		for i,v in AntiflingBaseParts do
			if v:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				if v.CanCollide then v.CanCollide = false end
				v.AssemblyLinearVelocity, v.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
			else
				table.remove(AntiflingBaseParts, i)
			end
		end
		for i,v in AntiflingHumanoids do
			if v:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				if v.EvaluateStateMachine then v.EvaluateStateMachine = false end
			else
				table.remove(AntiflingHumanoids, i)
			end
		end
	end
	RunService.PreAnimation:Connect(OnStepped)
	RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(OnStepped)
	RunService.Stepped:Connect(OnStepped)
	local OnBasePart = function(v)
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			v.CanCollide = false
			if not table.find(AntiflingBaseParts, v) then
				table.insert(AntiflingBaseParts, v)
			end
		end
		if v:IsA("Humanoid") then
			v.EvaluateStateMachine = false
			if not table.find(AntiflingHumanoids, v) then
				table.insert(AntiflingHumanoids, v)
			end
		end
	end
	local OnCharacter = function(character)
		character.DescendantAdded:Connect(OnBasePart)
		for _,v in character:GetDescendants() do
			OnBasePart(v)
		end
	end
	local OnPlayer = function(player)
		if player == Player then return end
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(OnCharacter)
		if player.Character then OnCharacter(player.Character) end
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(OnPlayer)
	for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		OnPlayer(player)
	end
end

local HumanoidLASetHookState
if ismissing(hookmetamethod) or ismissing(hookfunction) then
	HumanoidLASetHookState = function(hooked) end
else
	local LoadAnimation_old = nil
	local function LoadAnimation_new(animation)
		local char = Instance.new("Model")
		char.Parent = workspace
		local hum = Instance.new("Humanoid")
		hum.Parent = char
		local anim = LoadAnimation_old(hum, animation)
		hum.Parent = nil
		char:Destroy()
		--warn("LoadAnimation prevented!")
		return anim
	end
	local LoadAnimation_nc = nil
	local _HumanoidDummy = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	local _HumanoidLA = _HumanoidDummy.LoadAnimation
	local newloadanimation = newcclosure(function(self, animation)
		if not checkcaller() and typeof(self) == "Instance" and (self:IsA("Humanoid") or self:IsA("Animator")) and typeof(animation) == "Instance" and animation:IsA("Animation") then
			return LoadAnimation_new(animation)
		end
		return LoadAnimation_old(self, animation)
	end)
	local newnamecall = newcclosure(function(...)
		local method = getnamecallmethod()
		if not checkcaller() and method and (method == "LoadAnimation" or method == "loadAnimation") then
			local self, animation = ...
			if typeof(self) == "Instance" and (self:IsA("Humanoid") or self:IsA("Animator")) and typeof(animation) == "Instance" and animation:IsA("Animation") then
				return LoadAnimation_new(animation)
			end
		end
		return LoadAnimation_nc(...)
	end)
	HumanoidLASetHookState = function(hooked)
		if hooked then
			if not LoadAnimation_old then
				LoadAnimation_old = hookfunction(_HumanoidLA, clonefunction(newloadanimation))
			end
			if not LoadAnimation_nc then
				LoadAnimation_nc = hookmetamethod(_HumanoidDummy, "__namecall", clonefunction(newnamecall))
			end
		else
			if LoadAnimation_old then
				hookfunction(_HumanoidLA, LoadAnimation_old)
				LoadAnimation_old = nil
			end
			if LoadAnimation_nc then
				hookmetamethod(_HumanoidDummy, "__namecall", LoadAnimation_nc)
				LoadAnimation_nc = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

Util.SetMotor6DTransform = function(motor, transform)
	local name = motor.Name
	motor.MaxVelocity = 9e9
	local _, _, angle = transform:ToEulerAngles(Enum.RotationOrder.ZYX)
	motor.DesiredAngle = angle
	motor:SetDesiredAngle(angle)
	local axis, angle = transform:ToAxisAngle()
	local newangle = axis * angle
	pcall(sethiddenproperty, motor, "ReplicateCurrentOffset6D", transform.Position)
	pcall(sethiddenproperty, motor, "ReplicateCurrentAngle6D", newangle)
end
Util.SetMotor6DOffset = function(motor, offset)
	Util.SetMotor6DTransform(motor, motor.C0:Inverse() * offset * motor.C1)
end

Util.ShowPartHitbox = function(part)
	local w = Instance.new("WireframeHandleAdornment")
	w.Name = "TempWireframe"
	w.Adornee = part
	w.Color3 = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)
	w.Transparency = 0
	w.ZIndex = 10
	w.AlwaysOnTop = true
	w.Thickness = 1
	w.Parent = SCREENGUI
	local hs = part.Size / 2
	local verts = {
		Vector3.new(-hs.X, -hs.Y, -hs.Z),
		Vector3.new( hs.X, -hs.Y, -hs.Z),
		Vector3.new( hs.X,  hs.Y, -hs.Z),
		Vector3.new(-hs.X,  hs.Y, -hs.Z),
		Vector3.new(-hs.X, -hs.Y,  hs.Z),
		Vector3.new( hs.X, -hs.Y,  hs.Z),
		Vector3.new( hs.X,  hs.Y,  hs.Z),
		Vector3.new(-hs.X,  hs.Y,  hs.Z),
	}
	w:AddLine(verts[1], verts[2])
	w:AddLine(verts[2], verts[3])
	w:AddLine(verts[3], verts[4])
	w:AddLine(verts[4], verts[1])
	w:AddLine(verts[5], verts[6])
	w:AddLine(verts[6], verts[7])
	w:AddLine(verts[7], verts[8])
	w:AddLine(verts[8], verts[5])
	w:AddLine(verts[1], verts[5])
	w:AddLine(verts[2], verts[6])
	w:AddLine(verts[3], verts[7])
	w:AddLine(verts[4], verts[8])
	Debris:AddItem(w, 1)
end

local RIGHTGRIP_C0 = CFrame.new(0, -1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, -1, 0)
Util.PredictionFling = function(target)
	if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
		if target:IsA("Model") then
			target = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.PrimaryPart or target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
		end
		if target and target:IsA("BasePart") then
			if not target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				return CFrame.identity, true
			end
			local t = os.clock()
			local t2 = math.sin(t * 15) + 1
			local cf = target.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(1.57, 0, 0)
			if not Util.Fling.UseGlue() then
				cf += target.AssemblyLinearVelocity * t2 + Vector3.new(0, -workspace.Gravity * 0.5 * t2 * t2 + math.sin(t * 60), 0)
				if cf.Position.Y < target.Position.Y - 1 then
					cf = cf.Rotation + Vector3.new(cf.Position.X, target.Position.Y - 1, cf.Position.Z)
				end
			end
			--cf += Vector3.new(0, -0.5, 0)
			local oldpos = target:GetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_LastPosition")
			if not oldpos then
				oldpos = target.Position
				target:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_LastPosition", oldpos)
			end
			if (target.Position - oldpos).Magnitude > 200 then
				target:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_LastPosition", nil)
				return cf, true
			end
			return cf, false
		end
	end
	if typeof(target) == "CFrame" then
		return target, false
	end
	if typeof(target) == "Vector3" then
		return CFrame.new(target), false
	end
	return CFrame.identity, true
end
Util.PredictionFlingPart = function(target)
	if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
		if target:IsA("Model") then
			target = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.PrimaryPart or target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
		end
		if target and target:IsA("BasePart") then
			return target
		end
	end
end

-- [nooby mod] FLING METHODS ---------------------------------------------------
-- 1 = Default Fling, 2 = Weak Fling, 3 = Nooby's Method, 4 = NaN State Fling
Util.Fling = {}
Util.Fling.Names = {
	"Default Fling",
	"Weak Fling (just trips them)",
	"Nooby's Method (clip + nullzone)",
	"NaN State Fling",
	"Fling 1 (Nameless / Source)",
	"Fling 2 (Carpet)",
	"Fling 3 (Hidden / Flight)",
}
Util.Fling.Descriptions = {
	"default fling: spins into the target at crazy velocity and sends them flying",
	"weak fling: only trips people over, doesn't send them to the void",
	"nooby's method: clips inside their HumanoidRootPart, flings them to the nullzone and stays attached until they die",
	"NaN state fling: sticks to their root with a NaN humanoid state, falls back to a velocity fling if they only get pushed",
	"Fling 1: adapted from Nameless Admin's classic high-velocity multi-position fling sequence",
	"Fling 2: adapted from the carpet-animation target-following fling sequence",
	"Fling 3: adapted from the hidden-fling target sweep + flight sequence",
}
Util.Fling.WeakDuration = 0.4        -- how long a weak fling lasts (seconds)
Util.Fling.NaNWindow = 0.6           -- seconds to wait for the NaN state to work before escalating
Util.Fling.NaNEscalateDistance = 60  -- target moved less than this = it only got pushed
Util.Fling.NoobyMaxTime = 15         -- safety cap for nooby's method (god-mode targets can't die)
-- GitHub/legacy fling variants are kept inside the shared method engine so the
-- external Uh Admin exposes walkfling only; these three are dropdown methods.
Util.Fling.SourceFling1Duration = 2.0
Util.Fling.SourceFling2Duration = 0.9
Util.Fling.SourceFling3Duration = 1.35
do
	local saved = SaveData.FlingMethod
	if type(saved) ~= "number" then
		saved = (SaveData.Reanimator and SaveData.Reanimator.LimbUseNaNFling) and 4 or 1
	end
	Util.Fling.Method = math.clamp(math.floor(saved), 1, #Util.Fling.Names)
end
Util.Fling.SetMethod = function(m)
	m = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(m) or 1), 1, #Util.Fling.Names)
	Util.Fling.Method = m
	SaveData.FlingMethod = m
	SaveData.Reanimator = SaveData.Reanimator or {}
	SaveData.Reanimator.LimbUseNaNFling = (m == 4) -- keeps old saves in sync
	Util.Notify("Fling method: " .. Util.Fling.Names[m])
end
Util.Fling.GetPart = function(target)
	if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
		if target:IsA("Model") then
			local hum = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			target = (hum and hum.RootPart) or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.PrimaryPart or target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
		end
		if target and target:IsA("BasePart") then
			return target
		end
	end
	return nil
end
Util.Fling.TargetAlive = function(target)
	if typeof(target) ~= "Instance" then return true end
	if not target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
	if target:IsA("Model") then
		local hum = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum and hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
	end
	local part = Util.Fling.GetPart(target)
	if not part then return false end
	local p = part.Position
	if p.X ~= p.X or p.Y ~= p.Y or p.Z ~= p.Z then return false end
	if p.Y < FallenPartsDestroyHeight - 100 then return false end
	return true
end
-- [fling debug] set to false to silence the "fling start" diagnostics
Util.Fling.Debug = true
-- "Use Physics Glue" needs sethiddenproperty(part, "PhysicsRepRootPart", ...) to work. If the executor
-- can't set it, glue-mode flings (0.1-0.5s, no velocity prediction) just miss, so fall back to the
-- prediction fling instead.
Util.Fling.GlueState = nil -- nil = not probed yet
Util.Fling.UseGlue = function()
	if not Reanimate.UsePhysicsRepRootPart then return false end
	if Util.Fling.GlueState == nil then
		local root = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then return true end -- nothing to probe with yet, don't cache
		local ok = pcall(sethiddenproperty, root, "PhysicsRepRootPart", root)
		pcall(sethiddenproperty, root, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil)
		Util.Fling.GlueState = ok and true or false
		if not ok then
			Util.Notify("Physics Glue isn't supported by your executor, using prediction fling instead")
		end
	end
	return Util.Fling.GlueState
end
Util.Fling.ReportStart = function(ft)
	if not Util.Fling.Debug then return end
	task.spawn(function()
		pcall(function()
			local root = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local owned = root and root.ReceiveAge == 0
			Util.Notify(string.format(
				"fling start: method=%s glue=%s rootOwned=%s",
				tostring(ft.Mode), tostring(Util.Fling.UseGlue()), tostring(owned)
			))
		end)
	end)
end
-- Picks the queue's first target and works out where to put the RootPart.
-- returns: target entry (or nil when finished), CFrame, "target was flung away"
Util.Fling.Step = function(queue, t, defaultduration)
	local ft = queue[1]
	if not ft then return nil, CFrame.identity, false end
	local isinstance = typeof(ft.Target) == "Instance"
	local part = Util.Fling.GetPart(ft.Target)
	if not ft.Time then
		ft.Mode = Util.Fling.Method
		ft.Start = t
		ft.StartPos = part and part.Position or nil
		local dur = ft.Duration
		if not dur then
			if ft.Mode == 2 then
				dur = Util.Fling.WeakDuration
			elseif ft.Mode == 3 and isinstance then
				dur = Util.Fling.NoobyMaxTime
			elseif ft.Mode == 4 then
				dur = math.max(defaultduration, Util.Fling.NaNWindow + 1)
			elseif ft.Mode == 5 then
				dur = Util.Fling.SourceFling1Duration
			elseif ft.Mode == 6 then
				dur = math.max(defaultduration, Util.Fling.SourceFling2Duration, 2.5)
			elseif ft.Mode == 7 then
				dur = Util.Fling.SourceFling3Duration
			else
				dur = defaultduration
			end
		end
		ft.Time = t + dur
		Util.Fling.ReportStart(ft)
	elseif t > ft.Time then
		table.remove(queue, 1)
		return nil, CFrame.identity, false
	end
	if isinstance then
		if not part or not part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			table.remove(queue, 1)
			return nil, CFrame.identity, false
		end
		local p = part.Position
		if p.X ~= p.X or p.Y ~= p.Y or p.Z ~= p.Z then -- target got NaN'd: it's gone, don't follow it (would NaN our own RootPart)
			table.remove(queue, 1)
			return nil, CFrame.identity, true
		end
		if ft.Mode == 3 and not Util.Fling.TargetAlive(ft.Target) then -- nooby's method: until they die
			table.remove(queue, 1)
			return nil, CFrame.identity, true
		end
		-- Fling 2 (carpet): once they are launched far from where we started, count it as flung
		if ft.Mode == 6 and ft.StartPos and t - ft.Start > 0.15 and (p - ft.StartPos).Magnitude > 150 then
			table.remove(queue, 1)
			return nil, CFrame.identity, true
		end
		-- NaN state fling only pushed them? escalate to a velocity fling so they actually fly
		if ft.Mode == 4 and not ft.Escalated and t - ft.Start > Util.Fling.NaNWindow then
			local moved = ft.StartPos and (p - ft.StartPos).Magnitude or math.huge
			if moved < Util.Fling.NaNEscalateDistance then
				ft.Escalated = true
				ft.Mode = 1
				ft.Time = math.max(ft.Time, t + 1)
			end
		end
	end
	local flingcf, flinged
	if isinstance and (ft.Mode == 2 or ft.Mode == 3 or ft.Mode == 4 or ft.Mode == 5 or ft.Mode == 6 or ft.Mode == 7) then
		-- Modes 2-7 deliberately use the target's current replicated position. This avoids
		-- feeding a stale prediction into the source-style sequences and keeps NaN-safe modes
		-- isolated from the player's own RootPart.
		if ft.Mode == 2 then
			flingcf = CFrame.new(part.Position + Vector3.new(0, -2, 0))
		elseif ft.Mode == 6 then
			local speed = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
			if speed <= 28 then
				flingcf = CFrame.new(part.Position + part.AssemblyLinearVelocity * 0.5)
			else
				flingcf = part.CFrame
			end
			if speed > 1e4 then flingcf = CFrame.new(part.Position) end -- already launched: don't chase a huge velocity
		elseif ft.Mode == 5 then
			local hum = ft.Target:IsA("Model") and ft.Target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
			local moveDir = hum and hum.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero
			local speed = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
			local elapsed = math.max(0, t - ft.Start)
			local interval = 0.075
			local lowSpeedOffsets = {
				Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0),
				Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0),
				Vector3.new(2.25, 1.5, -2.25),
				Vector3.new(-2.25, -1.5, 2.25),
				Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0),
				Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0),
			}
			local highSpeedOffsets = {
				Vector3.new(0, 1.5, hum and hum.WalkSpeed or 16),
				Vector3.new(0, -1.5, -(hum and hum.WalkSpeed or 16)),
				Vector3.new(0, 1.5, hum and hum.WalkSpeed or 16),
				Vector3.new(0, 1.5, speed / 1.25),
				Vector3.new(0, -1.5, -speed / 1.25),
				Vector3.new(0, 1.5, speed / 1.25),
				Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0),
				Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0),
				Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0),
				Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0),
			}
			local offsets = speed < 50 and lowSpeedOffsets or highSpeedOffsets
			local index = (math.floor(elapsed / interval) % #offsets) + 1
			local extra = moveDir * math.min(speed, 100) / 1.25
			local offset = offsets[index] + extra
			local angle = math.rad(math.floor(elapsed / interval) * 100)
			flingcf = CFrame.new(part.Position + offset) * CFrame.Angles(angle, 0, 0)
		elseif ft.Mode == 7 then
			local offsets = {
				Vector3.new(0, 0, 4),
				Vector3.new(0, 0, -2),
				Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
				Vector3.new(0, 0, -3),
				Vector3.new(0, 0, 2),
				Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
				Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
				Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
			}
			local interval = 0.04
			local elapsed = math.max(0, t - ft.Start)
			local index = (math.floor(elapsed / interval) % #offsets) + 1
			flingcf = part.CFrame * CFrame.new(offsets[index])
		else
			flingcf = part.CFrame
		end
		flinged = false
	else
		flingcf, flinged = Util.PredictionFling(ft.Target)
	end
	if flinged then
		table.remove(queue, 1)
		return nil, CFrame.identity, true
	end
	return ft, flingcf, false
end
Util.Fling.ApplyRoot = function(RootPart, ft, flingcf)
	local mode = ft.Mode or 1
	local t = os.clock()
	local jitter = Vector3.new(0, 0, math.random(0, 1) * 0.005)
	if mode == 4 then
		-- NaN state fling: stay inside their root, velocity stays clean, the NaN comes from the humanoid state
		RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(flingcf.Position + jitter) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * 15, 0)
		RootPart.Velocity, RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	elseif mode == 2 then
		-- weak fling: low speed shove at leg height, enough to trip, not enough to launch
		RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(flingcf.Position + jitter) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * 10, 0)
		RootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(math.sin(t * 25) * 22, 0, math.cos(t * 25) * 22)
		RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 30, 0)
	elseif mode == 3 and typeof(ft.Target) == "Instance" then
		-- nooby's method: clipped inside their HumanoidRootPart, re-attached every frame while they fall
		RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(flingcf.Position + jitter) * CFrame.Angles(t * 31, t * 47, 0)
		RootPart.Velocity, RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -16384, 0), Vector3.one * 16384
	elseif mode == 5 then
		-- Fling 1: source-style high-velocity position cycling.
		RootPart.CFrame = flingcf + jitter
		RootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e7, 9e8, 9e7)
		RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
	elseif mode == 6 then
		-- Fling 2: carpet-style target follow (position comes from Util.Fling.Step) PLUS real
		-- fling velocity. The old version zeroed the velocity, so the RootPart just sat inside
		-- the target and never launched anyone. The velocity flips direction every frame so the
		-- push still lands after the carpet position update.
		local frame = math.floor(t * 120)
		local flip = (frame % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
		-- sweep through the target's hitbox in all 3 axes so every frame has a fresh contact point
		local sweep = Vector3.new(
			math.sin(t * 90) * 1.6,
			math.cos(t * 70) * 2,
			math.sin(t * 110) * 1.6
		)
		RootPart.CFrame = flingcf * CFrame.Angles(t * 53, t * 71, t * 37) + sweep + jitter
		RootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(flip * 9e8, flip * 9e8, -flip * 9e8)
		RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, -9e8 * flip, 9e8)
	elseif mode == 7 then
		-- Fling 3: source-style rapid target sweep, with the flight velocity used by sFLY.
		RootPart.CFrame = flingcf + jitter
		RootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e7, 9e8, 9e7)
		RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
	else
		-- default fling
		RootPart.CFrame = flingcf + jitter
		RootPart.Velocity, RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -16384, 0), Vector3.one * 16384
	end
end
Util.Fling.ApplyHumanoid = function(Humanoid, ft, lastspawn)
	local nan = (ft and ft.Mode or Util.Fling.Method) == 4
	if nan then
		if os.clock() - lastspawn > 0.1 then
			pcall(sethiddenproperty, Humanoid, "MoveDirectionInternal", Vector3.new(0/0, 0/0, 0/0))
		else
			pcall(sethiddenproperty, Humanoid, "MoveDirectionInternal", Vector3.zero)
		end
		pcall(sethiddenproperty, Humanoid, "NetworkHumanoidState", Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall.Value)
	else
		pcall(sethiddenproperty, Humanoid, "NetworkHumanoidState", Enum.HumanoidStateType.Flying.Value)
	end
end

SaveData.Reanimator = SaveData.Reanimator or {}

local LimbReanimator = {}
LimbReanimator.Name = "Limbs"
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbMode = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbMode or 0
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbVelocity = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbVelocity or 0
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbInitMode = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbInitMode or 2
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbReplicateFPS10 = not not SaveData.Reanimator.LimbReplicateFPS10
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbRoleplay = not not SaveData.Reanimator.LimbRoleplay
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbUseNaNFling = not not SaveData.Reanimator.LimbUseNaNFling
LimbReanimator.Mode = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbMode
if LimbReanimator.Mode >= 7 then LimbReanimator.Mode = 2 end -- plugin mode: resolved by name once plugins load
-- 0 = hide rootpart (defaults to 2 when streaming is enabled)
-- 1 = put rootpart just under void (defaults to 2 when streaming is enabled)
-- 2 = keep rootpart streamed, puts rootpart below character
-- 3 = currentangle styled
-- 4 = rootpart is torso (most interpolated mode)
-- 5 = rootpart in the sky (defaults to 2 when streaming is enabled)
-- 6 = rootpart in the very sky (defaults to 2 when streaming is enabled)
-- 7+ = user plugins from UhhhhhhReanim/Plugins
LimbReanimator.Velocity = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbVelocity
-- 0 = no velocity
-- 1 = copy from fake character
-- 2 = fling-y velocity
LimbReanimator.InitMode = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbInitMode
-- 0 = just reset
-- 1 = time permadeath, and reset
-- 2 = time permadeath, "without reset"
LimbReanimator.ReplicateFPS10 = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbReplicateFPS10
LimbReanimator.FlingEnabled = not SaveData.Reanimator.LimbRoleplay
-- [nooby mod] NaN fling is now Util.Fling.Method == 4 (Fling Method dropdown on the main page)
LimbReanimator.FlingTargets = {}
LimbReanimator._TempNotFling = {}
LimbReanimator.BuiltinModeNames = {"RootPart in very void", "RootPart in void", "Keep RootPart Streamed", "CurrentAngle Style", "RootPart is Torso", "RootPart in sky", "RootPart in very sky"}
LimbReanimator.PluginModes = {}
function LimbReanimator.GetModeNames()
	local names = table.clone(LimbReanimator.BuiltinModeNames)
	for _,pm in LimbReanimator.PluginModes do
		table.insert(names, pm.Name)
	end
	return names
end
function LimbReanimator.RegisterMode(def, file)
	if type(def) ~= "table" then error("plugin must return a table") end
	if def.Name == nil and #def > 0 then
		for _,d in ipairs(def) do LimbReanimator.RegisterMode(d, file) end
		return
	end
	if type(def.Name) ~= "string" or type(def.GetRootCFrame) ~= "function" then
		error("plugin needs Name (string) and GetRootCFrame (function)")
	end
	table.insert(LimbReanimator.PluginModes, {Name = def.Name, GetRootCFrame = def.GetRootCFrame, File = file})
end
function LimbReanimator.ResolveSavedMode()
	local saved = SaveData.Reanimator.LimbModeName
	if type(saved) ~= "string" then return end
	for i,pm in LimbReanimator.PluginModes do
		if pm.Name == saved then
			LimbReanimator.Mode = 6 + i
			SaveData.Reanimator.LimbMode = LimbReanimator.Mode
			return
		end
	end
end
function LimbReanimator.ShowHitboxes()
	Util.UINotify("Just a useless option")
	pcall(function()
		Util.ShowPartHitbox(Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart)
	end)
end
function LimbReanimator.Fling(target, duration)
	if not LimbReanimator.FlingEnabled then return end
	if not target then return false end
	for _,v in LimbReanimator.FlingTargets do
		if v.Target == target then
			return false
		end
	end
	if target == Reanimate.Character then return false end
	if target == Player.Character then return false end
	if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
		if LimbReanimator._TempNotFling[target] then return end
		LimbReanimator._TempNotFling[target] = true
		task.delay(1, function()
			LimbReanimator._TempNotFling[target] = nil
		end)
	end
	table.insert(LimbReanimator.FlingTargets, {
		Target = target,
		Duration = duration
	})
	if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
		if target:IsA("Model") then
			local h = Util.Instance("Highlight")
			h.Adornee = target
			h.FillColor = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
			h.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
			h.FillTransparency = 0.5
			h.OutlineTransparency = 0
			h.Parent = target
			TweenService:Create(h, TweenInfo.new(5), {
				FillTransparency = 1,
				OutlineTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
			game.Debris:AddItem(h, 5)
		end
	end
	return true
end
function LimbReanimator.SetRootPartMode(mode)
	assert(typeof(mode) == "number")
	LimbReanimator.Mode = mode
end
-- [v29] Limb Reanimation Compatibility Checker. Checks exactly five things:
--   1. Game-made animations  (Not Compatible)
--   2. Other players in voice chat (Not Compatible if confirmed, Partial if only suspected)
--   3. Dynamic faces         (Partial - may still work)
--   4. Game environment      (anchoring / streaming / spawning)
--   5. R6 vs R15             (R15 = Not Compatible)
-- Everything lives inside functions so no new top-level locals are added to the main chunk.
function LimbReanimator.RunCompatCheck(overrides)
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

	local STATUS_COMPATIBLE = "Compatible!"
	local STATUS_PARTIAL = "Partially compatible: please check."
	local STATUS_INCOMPATIBLE = "Not compatible: *NOT ACCURATE PLEASE CHECK IF SO.*"

	local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
		Character = nil, -- optional Model override (defaults to LocalPlayer.Character)
		AnimationWatchTime = 1, -- seconds to watch the character for animation tracks being played
		VoiceQueryTimeout = 1.5, -- seconds to wait for voice chat queries
		MaxListedItems = 5,
		Print = false,
	}

	-- Animation ids used by Roblox's stock R6 Animate script. Anything else on the character is game-made.
	local DEFAULT_ANIMATION_IDS = {}
	for _, id in {
		180435571, 180435792, -- idle
		180426354, -- walk / run
		125750702, -- jump
		180436148, -- fall
		180436334, -- climb
		178130996, -- sit
		182393478, 129967390, 129967478, -- tool none / slash / lunge
		128777973, 128853357, 129423131, 129423030, -- wave / point / laugh / cheer
		182435998, 182491037, 182491065, -- dance
		182436842, 182491248, 182491277, -- dance2
		182436935, 182491368, 182491423, -- dance3
	} do
		DEFAULT_ANIMATION_IDS[tostring(id)] = true
	end

	local R6_PARTS = table.freeze({ "Head", "Torso", "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg" })
	local R15_PARTS = table.freeze({
		"UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "LeftUpperArm", "RightUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "RightLowerArm",
		"LeftHand", "RightHand", "LeftUpperLeg", "RightUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "RightLowerLeg",
		"LeftFoot", "RightFoot",
	})

	local SEVERITY_WEIGHT = { FAIL = 1, REVIEW = 2, PASS = 3 }
	local SEVERITY_TAG = { PASS = "[PASS]  ", FAIL = "[FAIL]  ", REVIEW = "[REVIEW]" }

	local function getEnv()
		local ok, env = pcall(function()
			return typeof(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or getfenv()
		end)
		return if ok and type(env) == "table" then env else {}
	end

	local function capability(env, name)
		local value = env[name]
		return if typeof(value) == "function" then value else nil
	end

	local function read(instance, property)
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			return instance[property]
		end)
		return if ok then value else nil
	end

	local function isA(instance, className)
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return instance:IsA(className)
		end)
		return ok and result == true
	end

	local function findClass(instance, className, recursive)
		local ok, found = pcall(function()
			return instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(className, recursive)
		end)
		return if ok then found else nil
	end

	local function getService(name)
		local ok, service = pcall(function()
			return game:GetService(name)
		end)
		return if ok then service else nil
	end

	local function summarizeList(items, limit)
		local count = #items
		if count <= limit then
			return table.concat(items, ", ")
		end
		return string.format("%s (+%d more)", table.concat(items, ", ", 1, limit), count - limit)
	end

	-- Returns the numeric asset id when the animation is NOT one of Roblox's stock ones.
	local function customAnimationId(animationId)
		local id = string.match(tostring(animationId or ""), "%d+")
		if id == nil or DEFAULT_ANIMATION_IDS[id] then
			return nil
		end
		return id
	end

	local function formatReport(status, flags, counts, criticalFailures)
		local sorted = table.clone(flags)
		table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
			local wa, wb = SEVERITY_WEIGHT[a.Severity], SEVERITY_WEIGHT[b.Severity]
			if wa ~= wb then
				return wa < wb
			end
			if a.Critical ~= b.Critical then
				return a.Critical
			end
			return a.Index < b.Index
		end)

		local lines = table.create(#sorted * 2 + 4)
		lines[#lines + 1] = "=== Limb Reanimation Compatibility Check ==="
		lines[#lines + 1] = "Status: " .. status
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(
			"Passed: %d | Failed: %d (critical: %d) | Manual review: %d",
			counts.PASS,
			counts.FAIL,
			criticalFailures,
			counts.REVIEW
		)
		for _, flag in sorted do
			lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(
				"%s %s/%s%s - %s",
				SEVERITY_TAG[flag.Severity],
				flag.Category,
				flag.Id,
				if flag.Critical then " (critical)" else "",
				flag.Message
			)
			if flag.Detail then
				lines[#lines + 1] = "           " .. flag.Detail
			end
		end
		return table.concat(lines, "\n")
	end

	local cfg = table.clone(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
	if type(overrides) == "table" then
		for key, value in overrides do
			cfg[key] = value
		end
	end

	local env = getEnv()
	local flags = {}
	local counts = { PASS = 0, FAIL = 0, REVIEW = 0 }
	local criticalFailures = 0

	local function add(category, id, severity, critical, message, detail)
		local index = #flags + 1
		flags[index] = {
			Index = index,
			Category = category,
			Id = id,
			Severity = severity,
			Critical = critical,
			Message = message,
			Detail = detail,
		}
		counts[severity] += 1
		if severity == "FAIL" and critical then
			criticalFailures += 1
		end
	end
	local function pass(category, id, message, detail)
		add(category, id, "PASS", false, message, detail)
	end
	local function fail(category, id, critical, message, detail)
		add(category, id, "FAIL", critical, message, detail)
	end
	local function review(category, id, message, detail)
		add(category, id, "REVIEW", false, message, detail)
	end
	local function section(category, fn)
		local ok, err = pcall(fn)
		if not ok then
			review(category, "internal_error", "Check section errored; verify manually", tostring(err))
		end
	end

	local limit = cfg.MaxListedItems
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local character, humanoid
	local targets = {} -- ordered { Name, Part } for physics checks

	-- Resolve the character once; every other check uses it ----------------------
	section("Character", function()
		if not player then
			return
		end
		local candidate = cfg.Character or player.Character
		if typeof(candidate) ~= "Instance" or not candidate:IsA("Model") then
			return
		end
		character = candidate
		humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		for _, child in character:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") then
				targets[#targets + 1] = { Name = child.Name, Part = child }
			end
		end
	end)

	-- 5. R6 / R15 --------------------------------------------------------------
	section("Rig", function()
		if not character then
			review("Rig", "rig_type", "Rig type could not be checked", "No character is loaded. Spawn a character, then run the check again.")
			return
		end

		local r15Found, r6Missing = {}, {}
		for _, name in R15_PARTS do
			if character:FindFirstChild(name) then
				r15Found[#r15Found + 1] = name
			end
		end
		for _, name in R6_PARTS do
			local part = character:FindFirstChild(name)
			if not (part and part:IsA("BasePart")) then
				r6Missing[#r6Missing + 1] = name
			end
		end

		local rigType = humanoid and read(humanoid, "RigType")
		local isR15 = (rigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) or #r15Found > 0

		if isR15 then
			fail("Rig", "rig_type", true, "R15 game: limb reanimation needs R6",
				if #r15Found > 0 then "R15 parts found: " .. summarizeList(r15Found, limit) else "Humanoid.RigType is R15.")
		elseif not humanoid then
			fail("Rig", "rig_type", true, "No Humanoid: cannot confirm an R6 rig")
		elseif #r6Missing > 0 then
			fail("Rig", "rig_type", true, "Character is not a complete R6 rig", "Missing: " .. summarizeList(r6Missing, limit))
		else
			pass("Rig", "rig_type", "R6 rig detected")
		end
	end)

	-- 1. Game-made animations ----------------------------------------------------
	section("Animation", function()
		local function scan(root, anims, toolAnims, systems)
			local n = 0
			for _, d in root:GetDescendants() do
				n += 1
				if n % 1500 == 0 then
					task.wait()
				end
				if isA(d, "Animation") then
					local id = customAnimationId(read(d, "AnimationId"))
					if id then
						local entry = string.format("%s/%s (%s)", d.Parent and d.Parent.Name or "?", d.Name, id)
						if toolAnims and d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Tool") then
							toolAnims[#toolAnims + 1] = entry
						else
							anims[#anims + 1] = entry
						end
					end
				elseif systems and (isA(d, "AnimationController") or isA(d, "KeyframeSequence")
					or (isA(d, "Animator") and not (d.Parent and isA(d.Parent, "Humanoid")))) then
					systems[#systems + 1] = d.ClassName .. "/" .. d.Name
				end
			end
		end

		local charAnims, toolAnims, systems, animScripts = {}, {}, {}, {}

		-- (a) Everything on the character right now (this includes StarterCharacterScripts clones)
		if character then
			scan(character, charAnims, toolAnims, systems)
			for _, child in character:GetDescendants() do
				if isA(child, "LuaSourceContainer") and child.Name ~= "Animate"
					and string.find(string.lower(child.Name), "anim", 1, true) then
					animScripts[#animScripts + 1] = child.Name
				end
			end
		end
		local starter = getService("StarterPlayer")
		local starterChar = starter and starter:FindFirstChild("StarterCharacterScripts")
		if starterChar then
			scan(starterChar, charAnims, nil, nil)
		end

		-- (b) Tools the player carries
		local backpack = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		if backpack then
			scan(backpack, {}, toolAnims, nil)
		end

		-- (c) Tracks that are actually playing on the character (also watches for new ones)
		local customTracks, seen = {}, {}
		local function inspectTrack(track)
			if seen[track] then
				return
			end
			seen[track] = true
			local label = tostring(read(track, "Name") or "track")
			local anim = read(track, "Animation")
			if typeof(anim) ~= "Instance" then
				customTracks[#customTracks + 1] = label .. " (no Animation instance)"
				return
			end
			local id = customAnimationId(read(anim, "AnimationId"))
			if id then
				customTracks[#customTracks + 1] = label .. " (" .. id .. ")"
			end
		end

		if humanoid then
			local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
			local connection
			local okSignal, signal = pcall(function()
				return if animator then animator.AnimationPlayed else humanoid.AnimationPlayed
			end)
			if okSignal and signal then
				connection = signal:Connect(inspectTrack)
			end

			local deadline = os.clock() + cfg.AnimationWatchTime
			repeat
				local okH, list = pcall(humanoid.GetPlayingAnimationTracks, humanoid)
				if okH and type(list) == "table" then
					for _, track in list do
						inspectTrack(track)
					end
				end
				if animator then
					local okA, list2 = pcall(animator.GetPlayingAnimationTracks, animator)
					if okA and type(list2) == "table" then
						for _, track in list2 do
							inspectTrack(track)
						end
					end
				end
				task.wait(0.1)
			until os.clock() >= deadline
			if connection then
				connection:Disconnect()
			end
		end

		-- (d) Animation assets shipped to the client (game plays them from its own scripts)
		local shipped = {}
		for _, name in { "ReplicatedStorage", "ReplicatedFirst" } do
			local service = getService(name)
			if service then
				scan(service, shipped, nil, nil)
			end
		end
		local starterScripts = starter and starter:FindFirstChild("StarterPlayerScripts")
		if starterScripts then
			scan(starterScripts, shipped, nil, nil)
		end
		local playerScripts = player and player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
		if playerScripts then
			scan(playerScripts, shipped, nil, nil)
		end

		-- Verdicts
		if #charAnims > 0 or #customTracks > 0 then
			local parts = {}
			if #charAnims > 0 then
				parts[#parts + 1] = "On character: " .. summarizeList(charAnims, limit)
			end
			if #customTracks > 0 then
				parts[#parts + 1] = "Playing: " .. summarizeList(customTracks, limit)
			end
			fail("Animation", "game_animations", true, "Game makes its own animations", table.concat(parts, " | "))
		else
			pass("Animation", "game_animations", "No game-made animations on the character")
		end

		if #systems > 0 then
			fail("Animation", "animation_systems", true, "Custom animation objects on the character", summarizeList(systems, limit))
		end

		if #animScripts > 0 then
			review("Animation", "animation_scripts", "Animation-related scripts inside the character", summarizeList(animScripts, limit))
		end

		if #toolAnims > 0 then
			review("Animation", "tool_animations", "Held/owned tools carry their own animations", summarizeList(toolAnims, limit))
		end

		if #shipped > 0 then
			review("Animation", "shipped_animations", "Game ships its own animation assets to the client",
				summarizeList(shipped, limit) .. ". It probably plays them on your character.")
		end
	end)

	-- 2. Other players + voice chat ---------------------------------------------
	section("Voice", function()
		if not player then
			return
		end

		local others = {}
		for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if p ~= player then
				others[#others + 1] = p
			end
		end

		local voiceService = getService("VoiceChatService")
		local results, pending = {}, 0
		local function ask(userId)
			pending += 1
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, enabled = pcall(function()
					return voiceService:IsVoiceEnabledForUserIdAsync(userId)
				end)
				if ok and type(enabled) == "boolean" then
					results[userId] = enabled
				end
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
		if voiceService then
			ask(player.UserId)
			for i, p in others do
				if i > 40 then
					break
				end
				ask(p.UserId)
			end
			local deadline = os.clock() + cfg.VoiceQueryTimeout
			while pending > 0 and os.clock() < deadline do
				task.wait(0.05)
			end
		end

		local strong, weak = {}, {}
		for _, p in others do
			local hasInput = findClass(p, "AudioDeviceInput", true) ~= nil
			local char = p.Character
			local hasEmitter = char ~= nil and findClass(char, "AudioEmitter", true) ~= nil
			if results[p.UserId] == true or hasInput then
				strong[#strong + 1] = p.Name
			elseif hasEmitter then
				weak[#weak + 1] = p.Name
			end
		end

		local placeVoice = results[player.UserId] == true or #strong > 0
			or findClass(player, "AudioDeviceInput", true) ~= nil

		if #others == 0 then
			pass("Voice", "voice_players", "No other players in the server",
				if placeVoice then "Voice chat is available here. Run the check again if players join." else nil)
		elseif #strong > 0 then
			fail("Voice", "voice_players", true, "Other players are using voice chat",
				summarizeList(strong, limit) .. ". Voice chat ruins limb reanimation.")
		elseif #weak > 0 then
			review("Voice", "voice_players", "Other players may be using voice chat", summarizeList(weak, limit))
		elseif placeVoice then
			review("Voice", "voice_players", "Voice chat is enabled and other players are present",
				"Could not confirm whether any of them are using voice.")
		else
			pass("Voice", "voice_players", "Other players are present but no voice chat was detected")
		end
	end)

	-- 3. Dynamic faces ------------------------------------------------------------
	section("Face", function()
		if not character then
			review("Face", "dynamic_face", "Dynamic face could not be checked", "No character is loaded.")
			return
		end
		local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if not head then
			review("Face", "dynamic_face", "Dynamic face could not be checked", "Head not found.")
			return
		end

		local signs = {}
		if findClass(head, "FaceControls", true) then
			signs[#signs + 1] = "FaceControls"
		end
		if findClass(head, "Bone", true) then
			signs[#signs + 1] = "Bones in head"
		end
		if findClass(head, "WrapTarget", true) then
			signs[#signs + 1] = "WrapTarget"
		end
		if findClass(character, "FaceControls", true) and #signs == 0 then
			signs[#signs + 1] = "FaceControls (on character)"
		end

		if #signs > 0 then
			review("Face", "dynamic_face", "Dynamic face detected: incompatible, but it may still work",
				table.concat(signs, ", "))
		else
			pass("Face", "dynamic_face", "No dynamic face")
		end
	end)

	-- 4. Game environment -----------------------------------------------------------
	section("Environment", function()
		local okActive, active = pcall(function()
			return Reanimate.Character ~= nil
		end)
		if okActive and active then
			review("Environment", "reanimation_active", "Reanimation is currently running",
				"Results describe the live character; stop reanimating for a clean pre-flight check.")
		end

		if player then
			pass("Environment", "client_context", "Running on the client with a LocalPlayer")
		else
			fail("Environment", "client_context", true, "LocalPlayer unavailable", "This checker must run on the client.")
			return
		end

		if read(Players, "CharacterAutoLoads") ~= false then
			pass("Environment", "auto_spawn", "Game respawns characters normally")
		else
			review("Environment", "auto_spawn", "Game controls character spawning (CharacterAutoLoads is off)",
				"Reset-based init modes may not bring the character back.")
		end

		if Workspace.StreamingEnabled then
			review("Environment", "streaming", "StreamingEnabled is on",
				"Parts placed far from the character may stream out and lose replication.")
		else
			pass("Environment", "streaming", "StreamingEnabled is off")
		end

		if not character then
			review("Environment", "character", "Character-based environment checks skipped", "No character is loaded.")
			return
		end

		if character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
			pass("Environment", "in_workspace", "Character is in Workspace")
		else
			fail("Environment", "in_workspace", true, "Character is not in Workspace", "It may be respawning or destroyed.")
			return
		end

		if humanoid and (humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead) then
			review("Environment", "alive", "Humanoid is dead", "Wait for the respawn to finish, then run the check again.")
		end

		if #targets == 0 then
			return
		end

		local anchored, grounded = {}, {}
		for _, target in targets do
			if read(target.Part, "Anchored") == true then
				anchored[#anchored + 1] = target.Name
			else
				local ok, isGrounded = pcall(target.Part.IsGrounded, target.Part)
				if ok and isGrounded == true then
					grounded[#grounded + 1] = target.Name
				end
			end
		end

		if #anchored > 0 then
			fail("Environment", "anchored", true, "Character parts are anchored", summarizeList(anchored, limit))
		else
			pass("Environment", "anchored", "No anchored character parts")
		end
		if #grounded > 0 then
			fail("Environment", "grounded", true, "Character is welded to anchored geometry", summarizeList(grounded, limit))
		else
			pass("Environment", "grounded", "Character is not welded to anchored geometry")
		end

		local getHidden = capability(env, "gethiddenproperty")
		if getHidden then
			local ok, radius = pcall(getHidden, player, "SimulationRadius")
			if ok and type(radius) == "number" and radius <= 0 then
				fail("Environment", "simulation_radius", false, "SimulationRadius is zero or negative",
					"The client may not simulate nearby parts.")
			end
		end
	end)

	local status
	if criticalFailures > 0 then
		status = STATUS_INCOMPATIBLE
	elseif counts.FAIL > 0 or counts.REVIEW > 0 then
		status = STATUS_PARTIAL
	else
		status = STATUS_COMPATIBLE
	end

	local summary = formatReport(status, flags, counts, criticalFailures)
	if cfg.Print then
		print(summary)
	end

	return {
		Status = status,
		Flags = flags,
		Counts = counts,
		CriticalFailures = criticalFailures,
		Summary = summary,
	}
end
function LimbReanimator.FormatCompatRich(report)
	local COLORS = { PASS = "#55ff7f", FAIL = "#ff5555", REVIEW = "#ffd24d" }
	local WEIGHT = { FAIL = 1, REVIEW = 2, PASS = 3 }
	local function esc(s)
		return (string.gsub(string.gsub(string.gsub(tostring(s), "&", "&amp;"), "<", "&lt;"), ">", "&gt;"))
	end
	local statusColor = COLORS.REVIEW
	if report.Status == "Compatible!" then
		statusColor = COLORS.PASS
	elseif report.Status == "Not compatible: *NOT ACCURATE PLEASE CHECK IF SO.*" then
		statusColor = COLORS.FAIL
	end
	local sorted = table.clone(report.Flags)
	table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
		local wa, wb = WEIGHT[a.Severity], WEIGHT[b.Severity]
		if wa ~= wb then return wa < wb end
		if a.Critical ~= b.Critical then return a.Critical end
		return a.Index < b.Index
	end)
	local lines = {
		string.format('<font color="%s"><b>%s</b></font>', statusColor, esc(report.Status)),
		string.format("Passed: %d | Failed: %d (critical: %d) | Review: %d",
			report.Counts.PASS, report.Counts.FAIL, report.CriticalFailures, report.Counts.REVIEW),
		"",
	}
	for _, flag in sorted do
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.format('<font color="%s">[%s]</font> %s/%s%s - %s',
			COLORS[flag.Severity], flag.Severity, esc(flag.Category), esc(flag.Id),
			flag.Critical and " (critical)" or "", esc(flag.Message))
		if flag.Detail then
			lines[#lines + 1] = '    <font color="#aaaaaa">' .. esc(flag.Detail) .. "</font>"
		end
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
function LimbReanimator.Config(parent)
	UI.CreateText(parent, "as mentioned in the README, this only works for SOME games,\nbecause 'modern' games create the Animator automatically which breaks limb reanimation", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
	local modenames = LimbReanimator.GetModeNames()
	local dmode = UI.CreateDropdown(parent, "RootPart Mode", modenames, LimbReanimator.Mode + 1)
	local dvel = UI.CreateDropdown(parent, "RootPart Velocity", {"No Velocity", "Follow Character", "Fling-like"}, LimbReanimator.Velocity + 1)
	local dinit = UI.CreateDropdown(parent, "Init Mode", {"Reset Character", "CDSB + Reset", "CDSB + SSE + Kill"}, LimbReanimator.InitMode + 1)
	dmode.Changed:Connect(function(val)
		LimbReanimator.Mode = val - 1
		SaveData.Reanimator.LimbMode = val - 1
		SaveData.Reanimator.LimbModeName = modenames[val]
	end)
	dvel.Changed:Connect(function(val)
		LimbReanimator.Velocity = val - 1
		SaveData.Reanimator.LimbVelocity = val - 1
	end)
	dinit.Changed:Connect(function(val)
		LimbReanimator.InitMode = val - 1
		SaveData.Reanimator.LimbInitMode = val - 1
	end)
	UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Show me how I look!", LimbReanimator.ReplicateFPS10).Changed:Connect(function(val)
		LimbReanimator.ReplicateFPS10 = val
		SaveData.Reanimator.LimbReplicateFPS10 = val
	end)
	UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Target Fling Enabled", LimbReanimator.FlingEnabled).Changed:Connect(function(val)
		LimbReanimator.FlingEnabled = val
		SaveData.Reanimator.LimbRoleplay = not val
	end)
	UI.CreateText(parent, "vvv touch player = they lose ownership vvv", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
	UI.CreateText(parent, "fling style is chosen with the 'Fling Method' dropdown on the main page\n(Default / Weak / Nooby's / NaN State / Fling 1 / Fling 2 / Fling 3)", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
	UI.CreateSeparator(parent)
	UI.CreateText(parent, "-=+ Compatibility Checker +=-", 12, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
	local checkBtn, checkBtnText = UI.CreateButton(parent, "Check Limb Compatibility", 16)
	local checkResult = UI.CreateText(parent, "Spawn a character, then press the button to check game animations, voice chat players, dynamic faces, the game environment and R6/R15.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
	local checking = false
	checkBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		if checking then return end
		checking = true
		checkBtnText.Text = "Checking..."
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return LimbReanimator.FormatCompatRich(LimbReanimator.RunCompatCheck())
		end)
		pcall(function()
			checkResult.Text = ok and result or ("Checker failed: " .. tostring(result):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;"))
			checkBtnText.Text = "Check Limb Compatibility"
		end)
		checking = false
	end)
	Util.LinkDestroyI2C(dmode, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		dmode.Value = math.min(LimbReanimator.Mode + 1, #modenames)
		dvel.Value = LimbReanimator.Velocity + 1
		dinit.Value = LimbReanimator.InitMode + 1
	end))
end
function LimbReanimator.Start()
	local LimbNames = {"Head", "Torso", "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg"}
	local rootposition = Vector3.new(
		math.random(-65536, 65536),
		math.random(-70000, -60000),
		math.random(-65536, 65536)
	)
	local rootposition2 = Vector3.new(
		math.random(-2048, 2048),
		math.random(-500, -100) + FallenPartsDestroyHeight,
		math.random(-2048, 2048)
	)
	local skyposition = Vector3.new(
		math.random(-2048, 2048),
		math.random(1000, 2000),
		math.random(-2048, 2048)
	)
	local veryskyposition = Vector3.new(
		math.random(-65536, 65536),
		math.random(60000, 70000),
		math.random(-65536, 65536)
	)
	local InitCFrame = nil
	if Player.Character then
		local h = Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if h and h.RootPart then
			local r = h.RootPart
			InitCFrame = r.CFrame
			if h:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
				h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
				h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
			end
		end
	end

	local LimbMapping = loadstring(readfile("UhhhhhhReanim/BuiltinModules/d_limbmap.lua"))()

	local FakeTools = {}
	local function CreateFakeTool()
		local FakeTool = Instance.new("Tool")
		FakeTool.Name = "faketool"
		local FakeToolHandle = Instance.new("Part")
		FakeToolHandle.Name = "Handle"
		FakeToolHandle.Transparency = 1
		FakeToolHandle.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 1)
		FakeToolHandle.CanCollide = false
		FakeToolHandle.Massless = true
		FakeToolHandle.Parent = FakeTool
		FakeTool.Parent = Reanimate.Character
		local RightGrip = Instance.new("Weld")
		RightGrip.Name = "RightGrip"
		RightGrip.Parent = FakeToolHandle
		RightGrip.Part0 = Reanimate.Character and Reanimate.Character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
		RightGrip.Part1 = FakeToolHandle
		RightGrip.C0 = RIGHTGRIP_C0
		Util.LinkDestroyI2C(FakeTool, FakeTool:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Grip"):Connect(function()
			RightGrip.C1 = FakeTool.Grip
		end))
		RightGrip.C1 = FakeTool.Grip
		return FakeTool
	end

	local BaseParts = {}
	local UnknownMotor6Ds = {}
	local CharOnDesc = function(v)
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			if not table.find(BaseParts, v) then
				table.insert(BaseParts, v)
				v.CanCollide = false
				v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"):Connect(function()
					if v.CanCollide then v.CanCollide = false end
				end)
			end
		elseif v:IsA("Motor6D") then
			repeat task.wait() until (not v:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) or (v.Part0 and v.Part1)
			if not v:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
			local p0, p1 = v.Part0, v.Part1
			if p0 and p1 then
				p0, p1 = p0.Name, p1.Name
				for _,map in LimbMapping do
					if map.Part0 == p0 and map.Part1 == p1 then
						map.Reference = v
						return
					end
				end
			end
			table.insert(UnknownMotor6Ds, v)
		elseif v:IsA("Animator") then
			task.defer(v.Destroy, v)
		elseif v:IsA("LocalScript") and v.Parent == Player.Character then
			v.Enabled = false
			v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
				if v.Enabled then v.Enabled = false end
			end)
			v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Disabled"):Connect(function()
				if not v.Disabled then v.Disabled = true end
			end)
		elseif v:IsA("Tool") and v.Parent == Player.Character then
			if not FakeTools[v] then
				FakeTools[v] = true
				local fake = CreateFakeTool()
				fake.Grip = v.Grip
				local h = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
				if h ~= nil then
					fake.Handle.Size = h.Size
				end
				Util.LinkDestroyI2C(fake, RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
					if v.Parent == Player.Character then
						fake.Grip = v.Grip
						local h = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
						if h ~= nil then
							fake.Handle.Size = h.Size
						end
					else
						fake:Destroy()
						FakeTools[v] = nil
					end
				end))
				Util.LinkDestroyI2C(fake, v.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v)
					if v.ClassName == "StringValue" and v.Name == "toolanim" then
						local w = Instance.new("StringValue")
						w.Name = "toolanim"
						w.Value = v.Value
						w.Parent = fake
						Debris:AddItem(v, 1)
						Debris:AddItem(w, 1)
					end
				end))
				fake.Handle.Touched:Connect(function(t)
					local h = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
					if h and t and h:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and t:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						h.CanTouch = true
						pcall(firetouchinterest, h, t, 0)
					end
				end)
				fake.Handle.TouchEnded:Connect(function(t)
					local h = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
					if h and t and h:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and t:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						h.CanTouch = true
						pcall(firetouchinterest, h, t, 1)
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end
	local lastspawn = 0
	local CharConn = Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		local camcfr = Camera.CFrame
		RunService.PreRender:Once(function()
			RunService.PreAnimation:Wait()
			Camera.CFrame = camcfr
		end)
		lastspawn = os.clock()
		table.clear(BaseParts)
		table.clear(UnknownMotor6Ds)
		for _,map in LimbMapping do
			map.Reference = nil
		end
		character.DescendantAdded:Connect(CharOnDesc)
		for _,v in character:GetDescendants() do
			task.spawn(CharOnDesc, v)
		end
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
		local stupid = humanoid:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator")
		if stupid then
			stupid:Destroy()
		end
		if not Reanimate.UseLoadAnimationHook then
			stupid = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
			while not stupid do
				character.ChildAdded:Wait()
				stupid = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
			end
			stupid:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	Reanimate.CreateCharacter(InitCFrame)

	local lastrep = 0
	local function UpdateTransforms(ReanimCharacter, RootPart, rootcf, rootvel, flingtarget, flingcf)
		if not RootPart:IsGrounded() then
			if flingtarget then
				Util.Fling.ApplyRoot(RootPart, flingtarget, flingcf)
				pcall(sethiddenproperty, RootPart, "PhysicsRepRootPart", Util.Fling.UseGlue() and Util.PredictionFlingPart(flingtarget.Target) or nil)
			else
				RootPart.CFrame = rootcf + Vector3.new(0, 0, math.random(0, 1) * 0.005)
				RootPart.Velocity, RootPart.RotVelocity = rootvel, Vector3.zero
				pcall(sethiddenproperty, RootPart, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil)
			end
		end
		local dorep = true
		if LimbReanimator.ReplicateFPS10 then
			dorep = false
			local b = os.clock()
			local a = b - lastrep
			if a >= 1 / 10 then
				dorep = true
				a %= 1 / 10
				lastrep = b - a
			end
		end
		for _,v in UnknownMotor6Ds do
			Util.SetMotor6DTransform(v, CFrame.identity)
		end
		for _,map in LimbMapping do
			local v = map.Reference
			if v then
				if flingtarget then
					Util.SetMotor6DTransform(v, CFrame.identity)
				else
					local cf = CFrame.identity
					local p0, p1 = ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChild(map.RPart0), ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChild(map.RPart1)
					if map.RPart0 == "ROOT" then
						p0 = RootPart
					end
					if p0 and p1 then
						if map.Type == 1 then
							cf = p0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p1.CFrame)
						end
						if map.Type == 2 then
							local offset = map.Offset or CFrame.identity
							local c0, c1 = CFrame.new(map.C0), CFrame.new(map.C1)
							local transform = offset * (p0.CFrame * c0):ToObjectSpace(p1.CFrame * c1) * offset:Inverse()
							cf = v.C0 * transform * v.C1:Inverse()
						end
					end
					if dorep or not map.CFrame then
						map.CFrame = cf
					end
					Util.SetMotor6DOffset(v, map.CFrame)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	Reanimate.Starting = false
	while not Reanimate.Stopping do
		RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
		workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0/0
		local ReanimOkay = false
		local Character, Humanoid, RootPart = Player.Character, nil, nil
		if Character then
			Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if Humanoid then
				Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
				if Humanoid.WalkSpeed < 1 then
					Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
				end
				if Humanoid.JumpPower < 1 then
					Humanoid.JumpPower = 50
				end
				RootPart = Humanoid.RootPart
				if RootPart and Humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
					Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
					ReanimOkay = LimbReanimator.FlingTargets[1] == nil
				end
			end
		end
		local rootcf = CFrame.new(LimbReanimator.Mode == 5 and skyposition or LimbReanimator.Mode == 6 and veryskyposition or rootposition)
		local rootvel = Vector3.zero
		local ltm = Reanimate.LocalTransparencyModifier
		local ReanimCharacter = Reanimate.Character
		if ReanimCharacter then
			local RCHumanoid = ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local RCRootPart = ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local RCTorso = ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChild("Torso")
			if Camera then
				Camera.CameraSubject = RCHumanoid
			end
			for _,v in BaseParts do
				v.CanCollide = false
				v.Velocity = Vector3.zero
				v.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
				if not v:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Tool") then
					local lltm = ltm
					if Reanimate.FirstPersonBody then
						lltm = 0
						if v.Name == "Head" then
							lltm = ltm
						else
							local lol = v:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld")
							if lol and lol:IsA("Weld") and lol.Part1 and lol.Part1.Name == "Head" then
								lltm = ltm
							end
						end
					end
					v.LocalTransparencyModifier = lltm
				end
			end
			for _,v in ReanimCharacter:GetChildren() do
				if v:IsA("BasePart") then
					if table.find(LimbNames, v.Name) then
						v.Transparency = ReanimOkay and 1 or Reanimate.PlaceholderTransparency
					end
				end
			end
			if Character and Humanoid and RootPart then
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				local t = os.clock()
				if RCRootPart and RCTorso then
					if LimbReanimator.Mode == 1 then
						rootcf = CFrame.new(rootposition2)
					end
					if LimbReanimator.Mode == 5 then
						rootcf = CFrame.new(skyposition)
					end
					if LimbReanimator.Mode == 6 then
						rootcf = CFrame.new(veryskyposition)
					end
					if LimbReanimator.Mode == 2 or workspace.StreamingEnabled then
						rootcf = CFrame.new(RCRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, -16, 0))
					end
					if LimbReanimator.Mode == 3 then
						rootcf = RCRootPart.CFrame
					end
					if LimbReanimator.Mode == 4 then
						rootcf = RCTorso.CFrame
					end
					if LimbReanimator.Velocity == 1 then
						rootvel = RCRootPart.Velocity
					elseif LimbReanimator.Velocity == 2 then
						rootvel = Vector3.new(0, 16384, 0)
					end
					if LimbReanimator.Mode >= 7 then
						local pm = LimbReanimator.PluginModes[LimbReanimator.Mode - 6]
						local usedplugin = false
						if pm and not pm.Failed then
							local ok, pcf, pvel = pcall(pm.GetRootCFrame, {
								RootPart = RCRootPart,
								Torso = RCTorso,
								Character = ReanimCharacter,
								Time = t,
								FallenPartsDestroyHeight = FallenPartsDestroyHeight,
								Streaming = workspace.StreamingEnabled,
							})
							if ok and typeof(pcf) == "CFrame" then
								rootcf = pcf
								if typeof(pvel) == "Vector3" then rootvel = pvel end
								usedplugin = true
							else
								pm.Failed = true
								Util.Notify("Plugin '" .. pm.Name .. "' failed and was disabled: " .. tostring(ok and "GetRootCFrame must return a CFrame" or pcf))
							end
						end
						if not usedplugin then
							rootcf = CFrame.new(RCRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, -16, 0))
						end
					end
				end
				local flingtarget, flingcf = Util.Fling.Step(LimbReanimator.FlingTargets, t, Util.Fling.UseGlue() and 0.5 or 2)
				UpdateTransforms(ReanimCharacter, RootPart, rootcf, rootvel, flingtarget, flingcf)
				Util.Fling.ApplyHumanoid(Humanoid, flingtarget, lastspawn)
			end
			RunService.PreRender:Wait()
			if Reanimate:ShouldRotationType() then
				Reanimate:CameraLockCharacter()
			end
			if Character and Humanoid and RootPart then
				-- render/physics pass: the fling is only applied in the Heartbeat pass above (that is the state
				-- that gets sent to the server). Here the RootPart goes back to its hidden position so your own
				-- client never simulates the RootPart inside the target (that is a client-only fling).
				UpdateTransforms(ReanimCharacter, RootPart, rootcf, rootvel, nil, CFrame.identity)
			end
		end
	end
	CharConn:Disconnect()
	if Player.Character then
		local h = Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
		if h then
			h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
			h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
		end
	end
	Reanimate.Stopping = false
	Reanimate.DestroyCharacter()
end

function HatReanimator.ShowHitboxes()
	if Player.Character then
		for _,v in Player.Character:GetChildren() do
			if v:IsA("Accessory") then
				local handle = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
				if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
					if handle:GetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_HasCollide") then
						Util.ShowPartHitbox(handle)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
HatReanimator.FlingTargets = {}
HatReanimator._TempNotFling = {}
HatReanimator.BuiltinFlingNames = {"Disabled (RP)", "Classic Respawn", "Biggest Hat", "All Hats", "Use Tool Handle"}
HatReanimator.PluginFlingMethods = {}
function HatReanimator.GetFlingNames()
	local names = table.clone(HatReanimator.BuiltinFlingNames)
	for _,fm in HatReanimator.PluginFlingMethods do
		table.insert(names, fm.Name)
	end
	return names
end
function HatReanimator.RegisterFlingMethod(def, file)
	if type(def) ~= "table" then error("fling method must return a table") end
	if def.Name == nil and #def > 0 then
		for _,d in ipairs(def) do HatReanimator.RegisterFlingMethod(d, file) end
		return
	end
	if type(def.Name) ~= "string" or type(def.Run) ~= "function" then
		error("fling method needs Name (string) and Run (function)")
	end
	table.insert(HatReanimator.PluginFlingMethods, {Name = def.Name, Run = def.Run, File = file})
end
function HatReanimator.ResolveSavedFling()
	local saved = SaveData.Reanimator.HatsFlingMethodName
	if type(saved) ~= "string" then return end
	for i,fm in HatReanimator.PluginFlingMethods do
		if fm.Name == saved then
			HatReanimator.FlingMethod = 3 + i
			SaveData.Reanimator.HatsFlingMethod = HatReanimator.FlingMethod
			return
		end
	end
end
function HatReanimator.Fling(target, duration)
	if HatReanimator.FlingMethod == -1 then return end
	if not target then return false end
	for _,v in HatReanimator.FlingTargets do
		if v.Target == target then
			return false
		end
	end
	if target == Reanimate.Character then return false end
	if target == Player.Character then return false end
	if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
		if HatReanimator._TempNotFling[target] then return end
		HatReanimator._TempNotFling[target] = true
		task.delay(1, function()
			HatReanimator._TempNotFling[target] = nil
		end)
	end
	table.insert(HatReanimator.FlingTargets, {
		Target = target,
		Duration = duration
	})
	if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
		if target:IsA("Model") then
			local h = Util.Instance("Highlight")
			h.Adornee = target
			h.FillColor = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
			h.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
			h.FillTransparency = 0.5
			h.OutlineTransparency = 0
			h.Parent = target
			TweenService:Create(h, TweenInfo.new(5), {
				FillTransparency = 1,
				OutlineTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
			game.Debris:AddItem(h, 5)
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- Kills the real character so the game respawns you. Works even while stuck with dolteddown's pd
-- (which disables the Dead state), because it re-enables it first.
HatReanimator.LastForceRespawn = 0
function HatReanimator.ForceRespawn(reason)
	local char = Player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	HatReanimator.LastForceRespawn = os.clock()
	HatReanimator.Status.Permadeath = reason or "Force respawn!"
	if not hum then return false end
	pcall(function()
		hum.EvaluateStateMachine = true
		hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = true
		hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing, true)
		hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
		hum.Health = 0
		hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
	end)
	pcall(replicatesignal, hum.ServerBreakJoints)
	pcall(function() char:BreakJoints() end)
	return true
end
